data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

证据法：笔迹认证 (Authentication)
正确答案 选项 C (Yes)

应准许，因为陪审员被允许通过与经认证的样本进行比较来确定笔迹样本的真实性。

⚖️ 法律依据 (Legal Rule)

本题考查的是 联邦证据规则 901 (FRE 901) 关于书面证据的认证，特别是笔迹认证的方法。

FRE 901(b)(3) - 专家或事实审理者的比较
Comparison by an Expert Witness or the Trier of Fact

法律允许通过将有争议的样本与已经确认真实的样本（Exemplars）进行比较来认证笔迹。这种比较可以由以下两类主体进行：
  1. 专家证人 (Expert Witness)
  2. 事实审理者 (Trier of Fact)，即陪审团 (Jury) 或法官 (Judge)。
🔍 案情分析 (Analysis)

在本案中，认证过程分为两步：

第一步：确立基准样本 (The Exemplars)
同案被告（目击者）作证说他亲眼看到被告签署了5张支票。这属于通过“有亲身感知的证人证词” (Testimony of a Witness with Knowledge) 进行认证。因此，这5张支票是已认证的样本。

第二步：比较分析 (Comparison)
检察官希望陪审团将这5张已认证的支票与另外70张有争议的支票进行比对。根据 FRE 901(b)(3)，陪审团作为事实审理者，完全有权进行这种比较，无需专家介入。

📊 笔迹认证的三种方式
方式 谁来执行？ 要求/限制
非专家意见
Lay Opinion		 普通证人 必须基于诉讼前已有的熟悉度。不能为了作证而临时去熟悉笔迹。
比较分析
Comparison		 专家 (Expert) 专家可以在法庭上将争议文件与样本进行比对。
比较分析
Comparison		 陪审团 (Jury) 陪审团可以将争议文件与已认证的样本进行比对（本题考点）。
❌ 为什么其他选项错误？
  • 选项 A & B 错： 它们错误地声称比较“只能”由专家进行。法律明确规定陪审团（非专家）也可以进行比对。
  • 选项 D 错： 法院不需要对那70张争议支票做初步裁定。法院只需要确保作为基准的那5张支票已初步认证（本案中已通过证人证词完成），剩下的比较工作由陪审团完成。
💡MBE 考试技巧
在处理笔迹认证问题时，记住这个区别：
  • 普通证人 (Lay Witness) 靠的是“记忆”和“熟悉度”（不能现场比对）。
  • 专家 (Expert) 和 陪审团 (Jury) 靠的是“现场比对” (Side-by-side comparison)。
只要有一份确定的真迹（Exemplar），陪审团就可以自己动手比对！

questions.question:
A defendant has been charged with war crimes. The prosecution alleges that, before immigrating to the United States under an alias, the defendant was a high-ranking official in a brutal foreign regime. At trial, the prosecution seeks to introduce a diamond-encrusted pendant found among the defendant's possessions after his arrest. The prosecution claims that such pendants were only given to high-ranking officials of the regime.
The defendant has objected to the introduction of the pendant, arguing lack of authentication. In response, the prosecution has produced a pendant obtained from a human rights museum, which has been authenticated as formerly belonging to a general of the regime. The prosecution has requested that both pendants be conditionally admitted so that the jury can compare them.
Should the court admit the pendants?

choices.a: No, because comparison of the pendants for authentication purposes must be done by an expert.
choices.b: No, because the authenticity of physical evidence must be established by testimony of a witness with personal knowledge of the object.
choices.c: Yes, because the jury may properly compare the pendants for authentication purposes.
choices.d: Yes, provided the court is satisfied the pendants are of sufficient similarity to allow for jury comparison.

data.questionStem:
Q87216

A defendant has been charged with war crimes. The prosecution alleges that, before immigrating to the United States under an alias, the defendant was a high-ranking official in a brutal foreign regime. At trial, the prosecution seeks to introduce a diamond-encrusted pendant found among the defendant's possessions after his arrest. The prosecution claims that such pendants were only given to high-ranking officials of the regime.

The defendant has objected to the introduction of the pendant, arguing lack of authentication. In response, the prosecution has produced a pendant obtained from a human rights museum, which has been authenticated as formerly belonging to a general of the regime. The prosecution has requested that both pendants be conditionally admitted so that the jury can compare them.

Should the court admit the pendants?

一名被告被控犯有战争罪。控方指控，在用化名移民美国之前，该被告是一个残暴外国政权的高级官员。在审判中，控方试图呈交一枚在被告被捕后于其财物中发现的镶钻吊坠。控方声称，此类吊坠仅授予该政权的高级官员。

被告对呈交该吊坠提出反对，理由是缺乏认证。作为回应，控方出示了一枚从人权博物馆获得的吊坠，该吊坠已被认证为曾属于该政权的一位将军。控方请求有条件地接纳这两枚吊坠，以便陪审团可以进行比较。

法院是否应接纳这些吊坠？
options:
A. No, because comparison of the pendants for authentication purposes must be done by an expert.
不应，因为出于认证目的对吊坠进行的比较必须由专家进行。

B. No, because the authenticity of physical evidence must be established by testimony of a witness with personal knowledge of the object.
不应，因为实物证据的真实性必须由对该物品有亲身认知的证人通过证言来确立。

C. Yes, because the jury may properly compare the pendants for authentication purposes.
应，因为陪审团可以为认证目的适当地比较这些吊坠。

D. Yes, provided the court is satisfied the pendants are of sufficient similarity to allow for jury comparison.
应，前提是法院确信这些吊坠具有足够的相似性，可以允许陪审团进行比较。
data.explanation:
Authenticating physical objects

(FRE 901)
Personal knowledgeTestimony by witness with personal knowledge of object (or that reproduction depicts original object)

Most common method of authentication
ComparisonComparison of object or writing against authenticated specimen by expert or trier of fact
Distinctive characteristicsTestimony on object's appearance, contents, substance, internal patterns, or other distinctive characteristics
Chain of custodySubstantially unbroken account of object's whereabouts from time it was obtained until introduction at trial

Required method for authenticating objects that could easily be tampered with or confused with similar item (eg, blood sample)
X-ray images &electrocardiogramsEvidence showing accurate process was used, machine was working properly, machine operator was qualified & chain of custody

Required method for authenticating physical representations of things that cannot otherwise be seen
FRE = Federal Rule of Evidence.

A physical object must be authenticated before it can be admitted at trial. Authentication requires a prima facie showing that the object is what the proponent claims it to be. One method of authentication involves comparing an object that the proponent seeks to admit (defendant's pendant) with one that has been authenticated as genuine (museum's pendant). The comparison may be made by an expert or the trier of fact (Choice A). Therefore, the court should admit both pendants so that the jury, as the trier of fact, can compare them.

(Choice B) An object can be authenticated by testimony from a witness with personal knowledge of the object, but this is not the only available method of authentication.

(Choice D) There is no requirement that the court be satisfied that the items are of sufficient similarity to allow for jury comparison. However, as a practical matter, the items will often bear strong similarities.

Educational objective: A physical object may be authenticated by comparison to another that has been authenticated as genuine. Such a comparison may be made by either an expert or the trier of fact.

选项正确率统计：A选项 7%，B选项 21%，C选项 46%（正确选项），D选项 24%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

认证实物证据

(FRE 901)
亲身认知由对物品有亲身认知的证人提供的证言（或证言证明复制品描绘了原始物品）

最常见的认证方法
比较由专家或事实审理者将物品或文件与已认证的样本进行比较
独有特征关于物品外观、内容、物质、内部图案或其他独有特征的证言
监管链关于物品从获取到在审判中呈交期间所处位置的、基本不间断的记录

认证容易被篡改或与类似物品混淆的物品（例如血样）所要求的方法
X光图像与心电图证明使用了准确的程序、机器工作正常、机器操作员合格以及监管链的证据

认证那些无法以其他方式看到的事物的物理再现所要求的方法
FRE = 《联邦证据规则》（Federal Rule of Evidence）。

实物证据在审判中被接纳前必须经过认证。认证要求初步证明该物品确系呈交方所声称之物。一种认证方法涉及将呈交方试图呈交的物品（被告的吊坠）与已被认证为真品的物品（博物馆的吊坠）进行比较。该比较可由专家或事实审理者进行（选项A）。因此，法院应接纳这两枚吊坠，以便作为事实审理者的陪审团可以对它们进行比较。

（选项B） 物品可以通过对该物品有亲身认知的证人的证言进行认证，但这不是唯一可用的认证方法。

（选项D） 法律并未要求法院必须确信物品具有足够的相似性才允许陪审团进行比较。然而，在实践中，这些物品通常会具有高度的相似性。

教学目的： 实物证据可以通过与另一件已被认证为真品的物品进行比较来认证。这种比较可以由专家或事实审理者进行。

References

Fed. R. Evid. 901 (authenticating or identifying evidence).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Evidence / Authentication

核心考点：FRE 901(b)(3)
实物证据的认证（Authentication）可以通过比较（Comparison）来完成。这种比较可以由专家证人（Expert Witness）进行，也可以由事实审理者（Trier of Fact，即陪审团）直接进行。
案情分析逻辑
本题的核心在于如何证明被告持有的“镶钻吊坠”是真品（即属于该外国政权高官的物品）。
💎❓ 被告的吊坠
(待认证证据)
VS
🏛️✅ 博物馆吊坠
(已认证样本)
控方已经提供了一个已认证的样本（Authenticated Specimen，即博物馆的吊坠）。现在的法律问题是：
谁有资格通过比较这两者来判定被告的吊坠是否真实？
✅ 正确答案：选项 C
Yes, because the jury may properly compare the pendants for authentication purposes.
根据《联邦证据规则》FRE 901(b)(3)，通过与已确认为真实的样本进行比较来认证证据时，这种比较不需要仅限于专家。陪审团作为事实审理者（Trier of Fact），完全有资格通过观察和对比两个物体，来决定它们是否来自同一来源或具有相同的特征。
为什么其他选项是错的？
❌ 选项 A (Expert only)
错误点： 法律不要求必须由专家进行比较。虽然专家可以做，但陪审团同样有权做。除非涉及极其复杂的科学比对（如DNA），否则普通物品的外观比对属于陪审团的能力范围。
❌ 选项 B (Personal Knowledge only)
错误点： “亲身认知”（Personal Knowledge）确实是认证的一种方式（FRE 901(b)(1)），但它不是唯一的方式。不能因为没有目击证人就排除其他认证手段（如比较法）。
❌ 选项 D (Court Satisfaction)
错误点： 这是一个干扰项。认证的标准是“低门槛”的（Prima Facie Showing）。法官只需判断是否有“足够的证据支持陪审团认定其为真”即可（FRE 104(b) Conditional Relevancy）。法官不需要自己先确信它们“足够相似”，这是留给陪审团去权衡（Weight of Evidence）的问题。
💡 考试技巧 (Exam Tip)
在 MBE 证据法题目中，Authentication（认证） 的门槛通常很低。只要有一点证据能证明“这东西是它声称的那个东西”，通常就足以让证据Admissible（可采纳）。至于它是否可信，那是陪审团决定的Weight（证明力）问题。

记住：Comparison by Jury = OK!
© MBE 备考助手 | Reference: FRE 901

questions.question:
At a student's trial for stealing an automobile, the student called his college professor as a character witness. The professor testified that the student had an excellent reputation for honesty. In rebuttal, the prosecutor calls one of the student's classmates to testify that he recently saw the student cheat on a college examination.
Is the classmate's testimony admissible?

choices.a: No, because it has no probative value on any issue in the case.
choices.b: No, because the student's cheating can be inquired into only on cross-examination of the college professor.
choices.c: Yes, because the cheating involves "dishonesty or false statement."
choices.d: Yes, because the student "opened the door" to the prosecutor's proof of bad-character evidence.

data.questionStem:
Q87226

At a student's trial for stealing an automobile, the student called his college professor as a character witness. The professor testified that the student had an excellent reputation for honesty. In rebuttal, the prosecutor calls one of the student's classmates to testify that he recently saw the student cheat on a college examination.

Is the classmate's testimony admissible?

在一起学生盗窃汽车的审判中，该学生传唤其大学教授作为品格证人。教授作证称，该学生在诚实方面声誉卓著。作为反驳，检察官传唤了该学生的一名同学，以作证其最近看到该学生在一次大学考试中作弊。

该同学的证词是否可被采纳？
options:
A. No, because it has no probative value on any issue in the case.
否，因为它对案件中的任何争议点均不具有证明价值。

B. No, because the student's cheating can be inquired into only on cross-examination of the college professor.
否，因为只能在对大学教授进行交叉询问时，才能对学生的作弊行为进行质询。

C. Yes, because the cheating involves "dishonesty or false statement."
是，因为作弊行为涉及“不诚实或虚假陈述”。

D. Yes, because the student "opened the door" to the prosecutor's proof of bad-character evidence.
是，因为该学生为检察官提出不良品格证据“敞开了大门”。
data.explanation:
A criminal defendant may offer evidence of his/her good character if that trait is pertinent to the crime charged - eg, a defendant's peaceful nature is pertinent to a violent crime. This can be accomplished by calling a character witness to provide reputation or opinion testimony about that character trait. But once this testimony is admitted, the defendant opens the door for the prosecution to rebut it by introducing:
  • reputation or opinion testimony from its own witness about the defendant's pertinent character trait or
  • specific instances of conduct involving that trait - but only while cross-examining the defendant's character witness (ie, no extrinsic evidence).
Here, the student called his professor to testify to the student's excellent reputation for honesty - a character trait pertinent to vehicle theft. This testimony opened the door for the prosecution to offer rebuttal evidence showing the student's bad character for honesty (Choice D). But since evidence that the student had cheated on a college exam is a specific instance of conduct, it can only be admitted on cross-examination of the professor - not through extrinsic evidence like the classmate's testimony. Therefore, the classmate's testimony is inadmissible.

(Choice A) Evidence is probative when it tends to make a material fact more or less probable. Cheating on the exam is probative of the student's character for truthfulness, but it can only be admitted if it complies with other evidentiary rules.

(Choice C) Since the student's cheating involves dishonesty or a false statement, the prosecution can use this evidence to rebut the student's evidence showing his honest character. But the prosecution can only inquire into this specific instance of conduct while cross-examining the professor.

Educational objective: A criminal defendant may call a character witness to testify about a character trait that is pertinent to the crime charged. If the defendant does so, the prosecution can rebut that evidence by introducing (1) reputation or opinion testimony from any witness or (2) specific instances of conduct while cross-examining the defendant's witness.



选项正确率统计：A选项 2%，B选项 30%（正确选项），C选项 12%，D选项 54%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

刑事被告人可以提供其良好品格的证据，前提是该品格特征与被指控的罪行相关——例如，被告人的和平品性与暴力犯罪相关。这可以通过传唤品格证人就该品格特征提供声誉或意见证词来实现。但一旦该证词被采纳，被告人就为检方反驳敞开了大门，检方可以通过提出以下证据进行反驳：
  • 己方证人就被告人的相关品格特征提供的声誉或意见证词或
  • 涉及该品格特征的特定行为事例——但这只能在对被告方的品格证人进行交叉询问时提出（即，不得使用外部证据）。
在本案中，学生传唤其教授为其在诚实方面的卓著声誉作证——这是一个与车辆盗窃罪相关的品格特征。该证词为检方提供了反驳证据，以证明该学生品格不诚实，从而为检方敞开了大门（选项D）。但由于学生在大学考试中作弊的证据属于特定行为事例，因此只能在对教授进行交叉询问时方可被采纳——而不能通过诸如同学证词之类的外部证据来提出。因此，该同学的证词是不可采纳的。

（选项A）如果证据倾向于使某一重要事实变得更可能或更不可能，则该证据具有证明价值。考试作弊确实能证明该学生的诚实品格，但只有在符合其他证据规则的情况下才能被采纳。

（选项C）由于学生的作弊行为涉及不诚实或虚假陈述，检方可以使用此证据来反驳学生证明其诚实品格的证据。但检方只能在对教授进行交叉询问时，才能对这一特定行为事例进行质询。

教学目标：刑事被告人可以传唤品格证人就与被指控罪行相关的品格特征作证。如果被告人这样做，检方可以通过以下方式反驳该证据：（1）由任何证人提供声誉或意见证词，或（2）在对被告方的证人进行交叉询问时，提出特定行为事例。

References

  • Fed. R. Evid. 404 (character evidence).
  • Fed. R. Evid. 405 (methods of proving character).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Evidence: Character Evidence (品格证据)
核心规则：FRE 405 在刑事案件中，当被告人主动提出良好品格证据（Good Character）后，检方如何进行反驳（Rebuttal）？

关键限制：检方在反驳时，证明品格的方法受到严格限制。
本案逻辑链条
1
被告方行动：
传唤教授证明“诚实的好名声”。
(符合 FRE 404(a)(2)(A) - 开启大门)
2
检方反驳意图：
想证明被告曾“考试作弊”（特定行为）。
3
检方错误操作：
传唤新证人（同学）来作证该行为。
❌ 禁止外部证据 (No Extrinsic Evidence)

⚖️ 法律依据解析

根据 Federal Rules of Evidence (FRE) 405(a)，证明品格有两种途径：

  1. 声誉或意见 (Reputation or Opinion)： 任何时候都可以用。
  2. 特定行为事例 (Specific Instances of Conduct)： 仅限于在交叉询问 (Cross-Examination) 环节中向品格证人提问。

考点核心： 检方不能通过传唤新的证人（外部证据，Extrinsic Evidence）来证明被告过去的特定不良行为。检方只能在盘问被告的教授时问：“你听说过他作弊吗？”(Did you know/Have you heard...?)。

如果教授否认，检方必须接受这个答案，不能再叫同学上来“打脸”。

✅ 正确答案：B

"No, because the student's cheating can be inquired into only on cross-examination of the college professor."

否，因为只能在对大学教授进行交叉询问时，才能对学生的作弊行为进行质询。

🚫 为什么其他选项是错的？

选项 A (无证明价值)： 错误。作弊确实与“诚实”相关，具有证明价值 (Probative Value)，只是被证据规则 405 条在程序上禁止了。
选项 C (涉及不诚实)： 错误。虽然作弊涉及不诚实，但这通常用于弹劾证人 (Impeachment, FRE 608)，或者作为交叉询问的素材。它不能作为绕过“禁止外部证据”规则的理由来引入新证人。
选项 D (敞开大门)： 错误。被告确实“敞开了大门”(Opened the door)，但这只意味着检方可以反驳，并不意味着检方可以使用任何形式的证据。检方必须遵守 FRE 405 关于反驳形式的限制（即：只能交叉询问，不能用外部证据）。
💡 考试技巧 (Exam Tip)
看到 Character Witness + Specific Act (特定行为) 的组合时，立即警惕：
如果是 Cross-Exam → ✅ 允许提问。
如果是 New Witness/Extrinsic Evidence → ❌ 禁止。

questions.question:
A defendant is on trial for kidnapping. The victim has testified that one of the kidnappers referred to the other as "Speed." The prosecutor calls a jail employee to testify that, while the defendant was in jail awaiting trial, other inmates addressed the defendant as "Speed."
Is the jail employee's testimony admissible?

choices.a: No, because it is hearsay not within any exception.
choices.b: No, because it is substantially more prejudicial than probative.
choices.c: Yes, as circumstantial evidence that the defendant was one of the kidnappers.
choices.d: Yes, to support the truthfulness of the victim.

data.questionStem:
Q87808 A defendant is on trial for kidnapping. The victim has testified that one of the kidnappers referred to the other as "Speed." The prosecutor calls a jail employee to testify that, while the defendant was in jail awaiting trial, other inmates addressed the defendant as "Speed."

Is the jail employee's testimony admissible? 一名被告因绑架案正在受审。受害人作证称，其中一名绑架者称另一名为“Speed”。检察官传唤一名监狱雇员作证，称当被告在监狱候审期间，其他囚犯称被告为“Speed”。

该监狱雇员的证言是否可采纳？
options:
A. No, because it is hearsay not within any exception.
不可采纳，因为它是传闻证据，且不属于任何例外情况。

B. No, because it is substantially more prejudicial than probative.
不可采纳，因为其不公平的偏见性实质上大于其证明价值。

C. Yes, as circumstantial evidence that the defendant was one of the kidnappers.
可采纳，作为证明被告是绑架者之一的间接证据。

D. Yes, to support the truthfulness of the victim.
可采纳，用以支持受害人的可信度。
data.explanation:
Evidence is only admissible if it is relevant—ie, tends to make a material fact more or less probable—and is not barred by other evidentiary rules. For example, Federal Rule of Evidence 403 requires the exclusion of relevant evidence when its probative value (ie, degree of relevance) is substantially outweighed by the danger of any of the following:

unfair prejudice – evidence tends to encourage the jury to decide the case on improper grounds confusing the issues – evidence leads the jury to focus on a nonmaterial matter misleading the jury - evidence creates misconceptions in the jurors' minds undue delay or wasting time – presentation of the evidence will cause unnecessary delay or waste time needless cumulation – similar evidence on the same issue has already been admitted

Here, the victim testified that one of the kidnappers referred to the other as "Speed." The jail employee now plans to testify that other inmates called the defendant "Speed." The jail employee's testimony is highly relevant because it provides circumstantial evidence that connects the defendant to the kidnapping—making the material fact that the defendant was a kidnapper more probable. As a result, it is unlikely that the danger of unfair prejudice substantially outweighs the testimony's high probative value, and this testimony should be admitted (Choice B).

(Choice A) Hearsay is an out-of-court statement offered to prove the truth of the matter asserted therein. But the mere use of a person's name or nickname (as seen here) is not a "statement" under this rule because those words are not intended to convey an assertion.

(Choice D) A party may support a witness's character for truthfulness only when (1) that witness's character for truthfulness has been attacked and (2) that support comes in the form of reputation or opinion testimony—neither of which is the case here.



证据只有在具有相关性——即，倾向于使重要事实的可能性或多或少地增加——并且不被其他证据规则所禁止时，才是可采纳的。例如，《联邦证据规则》第403条要求，当相关证据的证明价值（即相关性程度）被以下任一危险实质上超过时，应排除该证据：

不公平的偏见 – 证据倾向于鼓励陪审团基于不正当的理由对案件作出裁决 混淆争议点 – 证据导致陪审团关注非重要事项 误导陪审团 - 证据在陪审员心中造成误解 不当延误或浪费时间 – 证据的呈示将导致不必要的延误或浪费时间 不必要的累积 – 关于同一争议点的类似证据已被采纳

在本案中，受害人作证说，其中一名绑架者称另一名为“Speed”。现在，监狱雇员计划作证说，其他囚犯称被告为“Speed”。监狱雇员的证言高度相关，因为它提供了将被告与绑架案联系起来的间接证据——这使得被告是绑架者这一重要事实更具可能性。因此，不公平偏见的危险不大可能实质上超过该证言的高度证明价值，故此证言应被采纳（选项B）。

（选项A）传闻证据是指在庭外作出的、为证明其所主张事项的真实性而提出的陈述。但仅仅使用一个人的名字或昵称（如本案所示）并不属于此规则下的“陈述”，因为这些词语并非意在传达一项主张。

（选项D）一方当事人只有在（1）该证人的诚信品格受到攻击，且（2）支持证据是以声誉或意见证言的形式出现时，才能支持该证人的诚信品格——本案中的情况两者皆不符合。

Educational objective:
Federal Rule of Evidence 403 requires the exclusion of relevant evidence when its probative value (ie, degree of relevance) is substantially outweighed by the danger of unfair prejudice, confusing the issues, misleading the jury, undue delay/waste of time, or needless cumulation of evidence.

References
Fed. R. Evid. 401 (test for relevant evidence).
Fed. R. Evid. 403 (excluding relevant evidence for certain dangers).

MBE 考点解析

Evidence (证据法) - Q87808
正确答案：C (间接证据)
1. 身份识别的间接证据 (Circumstantial Evidence of Identity)

本题的核心逻辑链条非常清晰：

  • 事实 A：受害人听到绑架者叫同伙 "Speed"。
  • 事实 B：被告在监狱里被叫作 "Speed"。
  • 推论：被告很可能就是那个绑架者。
根据 FRE 401，证据只要有任何倾向使重要事实（被告是否为绑架者）更可能或更不可能，即具有相关性 (Relevance)。

这种证据被称为“间接证据”，因为它不直接证明犯罪行为，而是通过推论建立联系。在MBE中，独特的昵称（Nickname）是证明身份的强有力证据。

2. 为什么这不是传闻 (Hearsay)?

这是本题最大的陷阱（选项A）。许多考生看到“狱友说...”就会立刻联想到传闻证据。

⚠️ 关键区分：断言 (Assertion)

传闻 (Hearsay) 定义为：庭外陈述，被提出用于证明其所主张事项的真实性 (offered to prove the truth of the matter asserted)。

在此处，狱友叫被告 "Speed"：

  • 不是断言：仅仅呼唤某人的名字或昵称通常不被视为一种事实主张（Assertion）。它更像是一个标签或口头行为。
  • 不为证明真实性：即使将其视为陈述，检察官也不是为了证明“他的法定名字真的是Speed”，而是为了证明“他回应这个名字”或“他被认知为这个名字”。
Reference: FRE 801(a) & (c)
3. FRE 403 平衡测试

选项B 提到了“不公平的偏见” (Unfair Prejudice)。虽然提及被告“在监狱候审”确实对被告形象不利，但证据法要求排除证据的标准极高：

偏见性必须 实质上超过 (Substantially Outweigh) 证明价值 (Probative Value)。

在本案中，"Speed" 这个昵称对于确认罪犯身份（Identity）具有极高的证明价值。这种价值通常会压倒附带的偏见风险。因此，法院不会依据 FRE 403 排除此证据。

💡 MBE 实战技巧
  • 看到“昵称” (Nickname)：首先考虑身份识别 (Identity) 的相关性。通常不是传闻，因为名字不是 Assertion。
  • 区分“相关性”与“可信度”：选项D 提到支持受害人的可信度 (Truthfulness)。除非受害人的诚实受到攻击（Impeachment），否则不能主动支持（Bolster）。本题是被告身份问题，而非受害人是否撒谎的问题。
  • FRE 403 很少是正确答案：除非证据的证明价值极低且偏见极高，否则在MBE中，证据通常倾向于可采纳 (Admissible)。

questions.question: Under the rule allowing exclusion of relevant evidence because its probative value is substantially outweighed by other considerations, which of the following is NOT to be considered?

choices.a: The evidence is likely to arouse unfair prejudice on the part of the jury.
choices.b: The jury may be confused about the appropriate application of the evidence to the issues of the case.
choices.c: The opponent is surprised by the evidence and not fairly prepared to meet it.
choices.d: The trial will be extended and made cumbersome by hearing evidence of relatively trivial consequence.

data.questionStem:
Q87178

Under the rule allowing exclusion of relevant evidence because its probative value is substantially outweighed by other considerations, which of the following is NOT to be considered?

根据规则，当相关证据的证明价值因被其他考量因素实质性地超过而允许被排除时，下列哪一项不属于这些考量因素？
options:
A. The evidence is likely to arouse unfair prejudice on the part of the jury.
该证据很可能引起陪审团的不公平偏见。

B. The jury may be confused about the appropriate application of the evidence to the issues of the case.
陪审团可能会对该证据如何适用于案件争议点感到混淆。

C. The opponent is surprised by the evidence and not fairly prepared to meet it.
对方当事人对该证据感到意外，且未能充分准备以应对。

D. The trial will be extended and made cumbersome by hearing evidence of relatively trivial consequence.
听取后果相对微不足道的证据将导致审判延长并变得繁琐。
data.explanation:
Under Federal Rule of Evidence (FRE) 403, a court may exclude relevant evidence if its probative value is substantially outweighed by a danger of one or more of the following:

  • unfair prejudice - evidence tends to encourage the jury to decide the case on improper grounds (Choice A)
  • confusing the issues - evidence leads the jury to focus on a nonmaterial matter (Choice B)
  • misleading the jury - evidence creates misconceptions in the jurors' minds
  • undue delay or wasting time - presenting the evidence will cause unnecessary delay or waste time (Choice D)
  • needless cumulation - similar evidence on the same issue has already been admitted


Therefore, in applying FRE 403, the court cannot consider whether a party is surprised by the evidence and not fairly prepared to meet it.

Educational objective: A court may exclude relevant evidence when its probative value is substantially outweighed by a danger of unfair prejudice, confusing the issues, misleading the jury, undue delay, wasting time, or needless cumulation of evidence.



选项正确率统计：A选项 3%，B选项 5%，C选项 80%（正确选项），D选项 11%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

根据《联邦证据规则》(Federal Rule of Evidence, FRE) 第403条，如果相关证据的证明价值被以下一种或多种风险实质性地超过，法院可以排除该相关证据：

  • 不公平偏见 - 证据倾向于鼓励陪审团基于不正当理由对案件作出裁决（选项A）
  • 混淆争议点 - 证据导致陪审团关注非实质性事项（选项B）
  • 误导陪审团 - 证据在陪审员心中造成错误观念
  • 不当延误或浪费时间 - 出示证据将导致不必要的延误或时间浪费（选项D）
  • 不必要的累积 - 关于同一争议点的类似证据已被采纳


因此，在适用 FRE 403 时，法院不能考虑一方当事人是否因证据而感到意外，以及是否未能充分准备以应对。

教学目标：当相关证据的证明价值被不公平偏见、混淆争议点、误导陪审团、不当延误、浪费时间或不必要的证据累积等风险实质性地超过时，法院可以排除该证据。

References

Fed. R. Evid. 403 (exclusion of relevant evidence).

MBE 考点解析

Evidence Law | FRE 403

本题考察的是美国联邦证据规则中最核心的权衡测试（Balancing Test）。

核心规则：FRE 403 根据《联邦证据规则》第403条，如果相关证据的证明价值probative value被以下一种或多种危险实质性地超过substantially outweighed，法院可以排除该证据。

FRE 403 明确列出了以下6种可以排除相关证据的理由：

  • ✔
    不公平偏见Unfair prejudice
    选项 A 属于此项
  • ✔
    混淆争议点Confusing the issues
    选项 B 属于此项
  • ✔
    误导陪审团Misleading the jury
  • ✔
    不当延误Undue delay
  • ✔
    浪费时间Wasting time
    选项 D 属于此项
  • ✔
    不必要的证据累积Needlessly presenting cumulative evidence
为什么选 C？

"意外" Surprise 不是排除证据的理由。

虽然早期的普通法可能将“意外”作为排除证据的理由，但现代的《联邦证据规则》明确将其剔除。

法律逻辑：如果一方对某个证据感到意外（Surprise），法院认为适当的补救措施是延期审理Continuance，让该方有时间去准备，而不是直接排除Exclude该证据。

其他选项分析：

题目是一个“否定式”问题（NOT to be considered）。选项 A、B 和 D 都是 FRE 403 明确列出的可以排除证据的理由，因此它们不是本题的正确答案。

🎓 MBE 备考锦囊

1. 背诵列表： 牢记 FRE 403 的6个排除理由。

2. 识别陷阱： "Surprise" 是 MBE 考试中关于 FRE 403 最常见的干扰项。只要看到 "Surprise" 作为排除相关证据的理由，通常都是错误的。

3. 关键词： 注意规则中的 "Substantially Outweighed"（实质性超过）。如果证明价值和偏见风险仅仅是相等，证据通常应当被采纳（Admissible）。

questions.question:
A plaintiff sues the defendant for breach of a promise made in a letter allegedly written by the defendant to the plaintiff. The defendant denies writing the letter.
Which of the following would NOT be a sufficient basis for admitting the letter into evidence?

choices.a: Comparison by the trier of fact of the letter with an admitted signature of the defendant.
choices.b: Evidence that the letter was written in response to one written by the plaintiff to the defendant.
choices.c: Opinion testimony of a non-expert witness based upon familiarity acquired to authenticate the signature.
choices.d: Testimony by the plaintiff that she is familiar with the defendant's signature and recognizes it on the letter.

data.questionStem:
Q87210

A plaintiff sues the defendant for breach of a promise made in a letter allegedly written by the defendant to the plaintiff. The defendant denies writing the letter.

Which of the following would NOT be a sufficient basis for admitting the letter into evidence?

原告起诉被告违反承诺，该承诺据称是被告写给原告的一封信中所作。被告否认书写了该信件。

以下哪项不足以作为采纳该信件为证据的充分依据？
options:
A. Comparison by the trier of fact of the letter with an admitted signature of the defendant.
由事实审理者将被告已承认的签名与该信件进行比对。

B. Evidence that the letter was written in response to one written by the plaintiff to the defendant.
证明该信件是为回复原告写给被告的信件而作出的证据。

C. Opinion testimony of a non-expert witness based upon familiarity acquired to authenticate the signature.
非专家证人基于为鉴定该签名而获得的熟悉程度所作的意见证言。

D. Testimony by the plaintiff that she is familiar with the defendant's signature and recognizes it on the letter.
原告作证称其熟悉被告的签名，并能从信件上辨认出该签名。
data.explanation:
Authenticating documents (FRE 901)


Common methodsStipulation or eyewitness testimony
Ancient documents & data compilationAt least 20 years old when offered condition creates no suspicion about authenticity and was in place where authentic document would likely be
Public recordsRecord was recorded or filed in public office as authorized by law or in office where that type of item is kept
Reply letterDocument written in response to communication and contents make it unlikely response was written by someone other than recipient of first communication
HandwritingComparison - expert witness or trier of fact compares authenticated against disputed handwriting (or fingerprints, hair, cloth fibers) or Non-expert opinion - witness with personal knowledge of authentic handwriting not acquired for litigation gives opinion on disputed handwriting
Self-authenticatingPublic documents with official's signature & authorized by official or seal Certified copies of public records & records of regularly conducted activities Newspapers, periodicals & official publications Documents with trade inscription Acknowledged documents Commercial papers, including signature & related documents
FRE = Federal Rule of Evidence.

Documentary evidence (eg, letters) must be authenticated before it can be admitted at trial. This requires the proponent to produce sufficient evidence to support a finding that the thing is what the proponent claims it to be. Documentary evidence is often authenticated through handwriting verification , which can be achieved in two ways:

  • Non-expert opinion - a lay witness with personal knowledge of the claimed author's handwriting ( not acquired for the current litigation ) testifies that a document is in the author's handwriting (Choice D)
  • Comparison - an expert witness or the trier of fact compares the writing in question (eg, the defendant's alleged letter) with another writing that has been authenticated (Choice A)


Therefore, the testimony of a non-expert witness who acquired familiarity with the defendant's handwriting only to authenticate the signature is not a sufficient basis for admitting the letter into evidence.

(Choice B) Documentary evidence can be authenticated by evidence that it was written in response to another communication (ie, a reply letter). However, the contents must make it unlikely that the response was written by someone other than the recipient of the first communication.

Educational objective: Documentary evidence can be authenticated by having a lay witness with personal knowledge of the claimed author's handwriting - not acquired for the current litigation - testify that the document is in the author's handwriting.

选项正确率统计：A选项 12%，B选项 16%，C选项 51%（正确选项），D选项 19%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

文件认证 (FRE 901)


常用方法约定或目击证人证言
古老文件与数据汇编提交时已存在至少20年，其状况未引起对真实性的怀疑 并且 处于真实文件可能存放的地方
公共记录记录已依法在公共部门记录或存档，或存放在保管该类物品的部门
回复信件文件是为回应某一通信而书写，并且其内容使得回应不大可能由第一封通信的收件人以外的任何人书写
笔迹比对 - 专家证人或事实审理者将已认证的笔迹与有争议的笔迹（或指纹、毛发、布料纤维）进行比对 或 非专家意见 - 对真实笔迹有亲身了解（非为本次诉讼而获得）的证人，对有争议的笔迹提供意见
自我认证带有官员签名并经官员或公章授权的公共文件；公共记录和日常业务活动记录的核证副本；报纸、期刊和官方出版物；带有商业标记的文件；经公证的文件；商业票据，包括签名和相关文件
FRE = 《联邦证据规则》(Federal Rule of Evidence)。

书面证据（例如，信件）在审判中被采纳前必须经过认证。这要求证据提出方出示足够的证据，以支持“该物品即为其所声称之物”的认定。书面证据通常通过笔迹验证进行认证，这可以通过两种方式实现：

  • 非专家意见 - 对声称的作者的笔迹有亲身了解（非为本次诉讼而获得）的普通证人，作证证明某文件是该作者的笔迹（选项D）
  • 比对 - 专家证人或事实审理者将有争议的笔迹（例如，被告的所称信件）与另一份已经认证的笔迹进行比对（选项A）


因此，非专家证人仅为鉴定签名而获得对被告笔迹的熟悉，其证言不足以作为采纳该信件为证据的依据。

（选项B）书面证据可以通过证明其是为回应另一通信（即回复信件）而书写的证据进行认证。然而，其内容必须使得该回应不大可能由第一封通信的收件人以外的任何人书写。

教学目标：书面证据可以通过让对声称的作者的笔迹有亲身了解（非为本次诉讼而获得）的普通证人作证，证明文件是该作者的笔迹，从而进行认证。

References

Fed. R. Evid. 901 (authenticating/identifying evidence).

MBE 考点解析

Evidence: Authentication of Handwriting
正确答案：选项 C

本题询问的是不足以作为采纳证据依据的选项。

非专家证人（Non-expert witness）不能仅为了作证而临时去熟悉某人的笔迹。这种“为了诉讼而获得的熟悉”是被联邦证据规则（FRE）明确禁止的。

核心考点：FRE 901(b)(2)

在联邦证据规则下，认证笔迹（Handwriting Authentication）主要有三种方式。理解这三者的区别是解题关键：

认证主体 要求条件 本题适用性
普通证人
(Lay Witness)		 必须基于亲身了解 (Personal Knowledge)，且该熟悉程度并非为了本次诉讼而获得。 选项 D (有效)
选项 C (无效)
专家证人
(Expert Witness)		 可以通过将争议文件与已认证样本进行比对来作证。可以为了诉讼专门研究。 (本题未涉及)
事实审理者
(Trier of Fact)		 陪审团或法官可以将争议文件与已认证样本进行比对。 选项 A (有效)
深度解析：为什么选项 C 无效？

选项 C 描述了一位非专家证人，他是“基于为鉴定该签名而获得的熟悉程度” (based upon familiarity acquired to authenticate) 来作证。

法律逻辑：

  • 如果允许普通证人为了出庭而临时研究笔迹，他们实际上是在扮演“速成专家”的角色，但又缺乏专家的资质和科学方法。
  • FRE 901(b)(2) 明确规定：普通证人的意见必须基于"familiarity not acquired for the current litigation"（非为本次诉讼而获得的熟悉）。
其他有效认证方式（排除法）
  • 选项 A (比对)： 允许陪审团（Trier of Fact）亲自比对争议签名和已知样本，这是 FRE 901(b)(3) 明确允许的。
  • 选项 B (回复信件原则 Reply Letter Doctrine)： 如果信件是对原告先前信件的回复，且内容表明不太可能是他人所写，则可认证。这是 FRE 901(b)(4) 的典型应用。
  • 选项 D (原有熟悉度)： 原告在诉讼前就熟悉被告签名，完全符合 FRE 901(b)(2) 的要求。
MBE 考试通关秘籍

在处理笔迹鉴定题目时，请立即检查证人的身份和熟悉笔迹的时间点：

  1. 如果是专家 (Expert)：可以为了打官司现学现卖（通过比对）。
  2. 如果是普通人 (Lay Witness)：必须是老相识（Pre-existing familiarity）。

看到 "Lay witness" 和 "acquired for trial/litigation" 同时出现，必是错误选项（即本题这类 "NOT" 题型的正确答案）。

questions.question:
A plaintiff, the owner of a condominium building, sued a defendant, a young architect, in federal court. The plaintiff alleged that the defendant was negligent in designing the plaintiff's building and that defects in the building's structural design rendered it unsafe and uninhabitable. At trial, the plaintiff called a structural engineer as an expert witness and asked her several questions about her education and experience. The court found that the engineer was qualified to testify as an expert and permitted her to offer an opinion on the soundness of the building's design. On cross-examination, the defendant asked the engineer if it was true that she had failed three engineering classes while in graduate school. The plaintiff has objected to the question.
Should the court allow the defendant's question?

choices.a: No, because the court already decided that the engineer is an expert.
choices.b: No, because the engineer's character has not been placed in issue.
choices.c: Yes, because a party may inquire into specific instances of conduct that bear on a witness's truthfulness during cross-examination.
choices.d: Yes, because it goes to the weight to be given to the engineer's testimony.

data.questionStem:
Q87193

A plaintiff, the owner of a condominium building, sued a defendant, a young architect, in federal court. The plaintiff alleged that the defendant was negligent in designing the plaintiff's building and that defects in the building's structural design rendered it unsafe and uninhabitable. At trial, the plaintiff called a structural engineer as an expert witness and asked her several questions about her education and experience. The court found that the engineer was qualified to testify as an expert and permitted her to offer an opinion on the soundness of the building's design. On cross- examination, the defendant asked the engineer if it was true that she had failed three engineering classes while in graduate school. The plaintiff has objected to the question.

Should the court allow the defendant's question?

一位原告，即一栋公寓楼的所有人，在联邦法院起诉了一位被告，即一位年轻的建筑师。原告指控被告在设计其建筑时存在过失，并且建筑结构设计中的缺陷导致该建筑不安全且不适合居住。在庭审中，原告传唤了一位结构工程师作为专家证人，并就其教育和经验向她提了几个问题。法院认定该工程师有资格作为专家作证，并准许其就建筑设计的合理性发表意见。在交叉询问中，被告询问该工程师，其在研究生院期间曾有三门工程课程不及格是否属实。原告对该问题提出了异议。

法院应否准许被告的提问？
options:
A. No, because the court already decided that the engineer is an expert.
不应准许，因为法院已经裁定该工程师是专家。

B. No, because the engineer's character has not been placed in issue.
不应准许，因为该工程师的品格尚未成为争议点。

C. Yes, because a party may inquire into specific instances of conduct that bear on a witness's truthfulness during cross-examination.
应准许，因为在交叉询问中，一方当事人可以就影响证人诚信度的具体行为进行询问。

D. Yes, because it goes to the weight to be given to the engineer's testimony.
应准许，因为这关系到应赋予该工程师证言的证明力大小。
data.explanation:
Under Federal Rule of Evidence 104, the court must decide if a witness is qualified to testify as an expert. To make this decision, the court considers the witness's specialized knowledge, skill, experience, education, or training in a subject that pertains to an issue being litigated. A finding that a witness is qualified as an expert typically means that the witness may offer an opinion on an ultimate issue. But such a finding does not preclude the opposing party from inquiring into matters that might affect the weight given to the witness's testimony.

Here, the court found that the engineer was qualified as an expert and allowed her to testify as to the soundness of the building's design - an ultimate issue in the case. However, that finding does not preclude the defendant from inquiring into matters that might affect the weight of the engineer's testimony. Therefore, the court should allow the defendant to ask the engineer about failing three engineering classes in graduate school - a matter that may diminish the weight given to the engineer's testimony (Choice A).

(Choices B & C) The engineer's character for truthfulness was placed in issue when the plaintiff called the engineer as a witness. However, the defendant's question pertained to the weight to be given to the engineer's testimony - not her character for truthfulness.

Educational objective: A court must determine whether a witness is qualified to testify as an expert. But a finding that the witness meets the requirements for expert testimony does not preclude the opposing party from inquiring into matters that might affect the weight of the witness's testimony.



选项正确率统计：A选项 27%，B选项 6%，C选项 8%，D选项 56%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

根据《联邦证据规则》(Federal Rule of Evidence) 第104条，法院必须裁定证人是否有资格作为专家作证。为作出此项裁定，法院会考量证人在与诉讼争议点相关的某一学科上所拥有的专业知识、技能、经验、教育或培训。认定一名证人具备专家资格，通常意味着该证人可以就最终争议点发表意见。但此项认定并不妨碍反对方询问那些可能影响该证人证言证明力的事项。

在本案中，法院认定该工程师具备专家资格，并准许其就建筑设计的合理性——本案的一个最终争议点——作证。然而，该认定并不妨碍被告就可能影响该工程师证言证明力的事项进行询问。因此，法院应准许被告询问该工程师在研究生院期间三门工程课程不及格一事——此事可能会削弱其证言的证明力，故(选项 A)不成立。

(选项 B & C) 当原告传唤该工程师作为证人时，其诚信品格就已成为争议点。然而，被告的提问关系到应赋予该工程师证言的证明力大小——而非其诚信品格。

教学目标：法院必须裁定证人是否有资格作为专家作证。但认定该证人符合专家证言的要求，并不妨碍反对方就可能影响其证言证明力的事项进行询问。

References

Fed. R. Evid. 104 (preliminary questions).

MBE 考点解析

Evidence / Expert Testimony

正确答案 选项 D

应准许，因为这关系到应赋予该工程师证言的证明力大小。

⚖️ 核心法律规则
Federal Rule of Evidence (FRE) 104 & 702

法院作为“守门人”(Gatekeeper) 决定证人是否有资格成为专家（可采性，Admissibility）。

一旦证人被允许作证，陪审团决定相信该证言的程度（证明力，Weight）。反对方可以通过交叉询问攻击专家的资历，以降低其证言的分量。

🔍 逻辑推理解析

本题考察的是“资格认定”与“证明力”的区别。

  1. 法官的角色 (Judge's Role)： 法官根据 FRE 104(a) 裁定该工程师具备足够的教育和经验，可以作为专家出庭。这意味着她的证言是可被法庭接纳的 (Admissible)。
  2. 被告的策略 (Defendant's Strategy)： 被告询问“研究生挂科”的问题，并不是为了推翻法官关于她“有资格”的裁定，而是为了向陪审团展示：虽然她是专家，但她可能是一个学艺不精的专家。
  3. 证明力 (Weight)： 专家在相关领域的学术失败（挂科）直接关系到其专业知识的可靠性。这属于证明力 (Weight) 问题，而非可采性问题。陪审团有权知道这些信息，以便决定是否采纳她的意见。
❌ 干扰项分析
选项 A 错误： 虽然法院裁定她是专家，但这并不意味着她的资历不可被挑战。资格认定只是让她“进门”，进门后反对方仍可攻击其专业水平。
选项 B 错误： 此问题针对的是专家的专业能力 (Competence)，而非其品格 (Character)。即使不涉及品格问题，反对方也有权质询专家的教育背景。
选项 C 错误： 这是一个极具迷惑性的选项。FRE 608(b) 确实允许询问涉及“诚实性”的具体行为 (Specific instances of conduct concerning truthfulness)。但“挂科”通常被视为能力不足，而非不诚实。因此，提问的理由不是为了攻击诚信，而是为了攻击专业度。
💡 MBE 考试技巧

在处理专家证人 (Expert Witness) 的题目时，请牢记以下区分：

  • Admissibility (可采性)： 由法官决定。如果题目问“证言是否应被排除”，通常涉及 FRE 702 的门槛要求。
  • Weight (证明力/分量)： 由陪审团决定。如果题目问“是否允许提问”，且该问题能让专家看起来“不那么专业”或“有偏见”，通常都应允许，因为它影响 Weight。

questions.question:
At a defendant's trial for drug dealing, a prosecution witness testified that he had heard the defendant telling a group of people to come to the defendant's house because he had "a great crop of apples for sale." The prosecutor then called and qualified a drug enforcement agent as an expert in how drug dealing is conducted. The prosecutor now seeks to have the expert testify that in her opinion, based on years of experience with drug dealers, the defendant's statement about the apples was code for his having drugs for sale.
Should the expert's opinion be admitted?

choices.a: No, because an expert must base his or her opinion on scientific or technical data, not merely on experience.
choices.b: No, because the opinion is based on the criminal actions of others engaged in drug dealing, and thus is substantially more unfairly prejudicial than probative.
choices.c: Yes, because the opinion is based on her specialized knowledge, and it will assist the trier of fact in understanding the evidence and determining facts in issue in the case.
choices.d: Yes, provided that the expert first testifies about the specific information upon which she based her view that the defendant was using "apples" as a code word to refer to drugs.

data.questionStem:
Q87819 At a defendant's trial for drug dealing, a prosecution witness testified that he had heard the defendant telling a group of people to come to the defendant's house because he had "a great crop of apples for sale." The prosecutor then called and qualified a drug enforcement agent as an expert in how drug dealing is conducted. The prosecutor now seeks to have the expert testify that in her opinion, based on years of experience with drug dealers, the defendant's statement about the apples was code for his having drugs for sale.

Should the expert's opinion be admitted? 在一名被告的贩毒审判中，一名控方证人作证称，他曾听到被告告诉一群人到被告家中，因为他有“一批很好的苹果要卖”。随后，检察官传唤了一名缉毒局探员，并使其具备了就贩毒如何进行的专家资格。检察官现在试图让该专家作证，根据她多年与毒贩打交道的经验，她认为被告关于苹果的陈述是其有毒品待售的暗号。

该专家的意见应被采纳吗？
options:
A. No, because an expert must base his or her opinion on scientific or technical data, not merely on experience.
不应采纳，因为专家的意见必须基于科学或技术数据，而不仅仅是经验。

B. No, because the opinion is based on the criminal actions of others engaged in drug dealing, and thus is substantially more unfairly prejudicial than probative.
不应采纳，因为该意见基于其他从事贩毒者的犯罪行为，因此其不公平的偏见性实质上大于其证明价值。

C. Yes, because the opinion is based on her specialized knowledge, and it will assist the trier of fact in understanding the evidence and determining facts in issue in the case.
应采纳，因为该意见基于她的专业知识，并将有助于事实审理者理解证据和确定案件中有争议的事实。

D. Yes, provided that the expert first testifies about the specific information upon which she based her view that the defendant was using "apples" as a code word to refer to drugs.
应采纳，前提是该专家首先就其认为被告使用“苹果”作为毒品暗号的观点所依据的具体信息作证。
data.explanation:
A witness is qualified to provide expert opinion testimony if the witness has specialized knowledge, skill, experience, education, or training in a subject that pertains to an issue in litigation. However, expert testimony is only admissible if the court determines that it is both:

relevant – the testimony will help the trier of fact (1) understand the evidence or (2) determine a fact in issue and

reliable – the testimony is (1) based on sufficient facts or data and (2) the product of reliable principles and methods that have been reliably applied by the expert to the facts of the case

Here, the drug enforcement agent was qualified as an expert in drug dealing. Her expert opinion testimony is relevant because it will help the trier of fact understand the defendant's statement regarding a "great crop of apples" (evidence) and determine if the defendant was selling drugs (fact in issue). That testimony is also reliable because her years of experience with drug dealers (sufficient facts and data) are being applied to the facts of this drug case. Therefore, the expert's opinion should be admitted.

(Choice A) To be reliable, an expert's opinion testimony must be based on sufficient facts or data—but this information can stem from the witness's experience (as seen here) as well as scientific or technical data.

(Choice B) The expert's opinion will assist the jury in understanding and determining a key issue in the case—whether the defendant was dealing drugs. Therefore, the probative value of this evidence outweighs any danger of unfair prejudice.

(Choice D) Unless the court orders otherwise, an expert may state an opinion before testifying to the underlying facts or data upon which that opinion is based. The opponent may then inquire into the bases for the opinion on cross-examination.

Educational objective: Expert opinion testimony is admissible if it will help the trier of fact understand the evidence or determine a fact in issue (ie, relevant) and is based on sufficient facts/data and the product of reliable principles/methods reliably applied by the expert (ie, reliable).



如果证人在与诉讼争议问题相关的某一学科上拥有专业知识、技能、经验、教育或培训，则该证人有资格提供专家意见证词。然而，专家证词只有在法院认定其同时满足以下两个条件时才是可采纳的：

相关性 – 该证词将帮助事实审理者(1)理解证据或(2)确定一个争议中的事实并且

可靠性 – 该证词(1)基于充分的事实或数据，并且(2)是专家将可靠的原则和方法可靠地应用于案件事实的产物

在本案中，缉毒局探员具备了贩毒领域的专家资格。她的专家意见证词具有相关性，因为它将帮助事实审理者理解被告关于“一批很好的苹果”的陈述（证据），并确定被告是否在贩卖毒品（争议事实）。该证词也具有可靠性，因为她多年与毒贩打交道的经验（充分的事实和数据）被应用于本贩毒案件的事实。因此，该专家的意见应被采纳。

(选项 A) 为确保可靠性，专家的意见证词必须基于充分的事实或数据——但这些信息可以源于证人的经验（如本案所示），也可以源于科学或技术数据。

(选项 B) 专家的意见将有助于陪审团理解和确定案件的一个关键问题——被告是否在贩毒。因此，该证据的证明价值超过了任何不公平偏见的危险。

(选项 D) 除非法院另有规定，专家可以在就其意见所依据的基础事实或数据作证之前陈述其意见。然后，对方可以在交叉询问中就该意见的基础进行质询。

教学目的： 专家意见证词，如果能帮助事实审理者理解证据或确定争议中的事实（即相关性），并且基于充分的事实/数据以及专家可靠地应用的可靠原则/方法的产物（即可靠性），则是可采纳的。

References

Fed. R. Evid. 702 (expert witness testimony).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 证据法考点解析

Expert Testimony (专家证言)
正确答案：选项 C

应采纳，因为该意见基于她的专业知识，并将有助于事实审理者理解证据和确定案件中有争议的事实。

⚖️ 法律依据：FRE 702

根据《联邦证据规则》第702条 (Federal Rules of Evidence 702)，专家证言的可采性主要取决于以下几点：

  • 资格 (Qualification)： 证人必须通过知识、技能、经验、培训或教育具备专家资格。
  • 协助性 (Helpfulness)： 专家的科学、技术或其他专业知识 (Specialized Knowledge) 必须能帮助事实审理者（陪审团或法官）理解证据或确定争议事实。
  • 可靠性 (Reliability)： 证言必须基于充分的事实或数据，且是可靠原理和方法的产物。
🔍 逻辑推演

本题的核心在于判断一名基于“经验”而非“科学数据”的专家，是否可以就毒贩的“黑话” (Code words) 进行解读。

1. 经验即知识：
法律并不要求专家必须是科学家。缉毒探员 (DEA Agent) 多年的实战经验 (Years of experience) 足以构成“专业知识”。

2. 协助陪审团 (Help the Trier of Fact)：
普通陪审员通常不懂毒贩的暗语。被告说“卖苹果”，普通人可能真以为是水果。专家的介入能揭示其潜在含义（即毒品交易），这直接帮助陪审团理解证据。这就是证据法中的相关性 (Relevance) 和协助性标准。

❌ 为什么其他选项是错的？
选项 A 错误

理由： 专家意见不必仅基于“科学或技术数据”。FRE 702 明确包含基于经验 (Experience) 的专业知识。对于帮派代号、毒品黑话等领域，经验往往是唯一的知识来源。

选项 B 错误

理由： 虽然该证据对被告不利（Prejudicial），但并非不公平的偏见 (Unfairly Prejudicial)。根据 FRE 403，只有当证据造成的不公平偏见实质性地超过 (Substantially Outweigh) 其证明价值时才会被排除。本案中，解读暗语具有极高的证明价值。

选项 D 错误

理由： 这是一个常见的程序性陷阱。根据 FRE 705，专家可以在不先披露 (Without first testifying to) 基础事实或数据的情况下发表意见（除非法庭另有命令）。对方律师可以在交叉询问 (Cross-examination) 时质询其基础。

💡 MBE 实战技巧

在处理专家证言 (Expert Testimony) 题目时，请记住关键词："Helpfulness" (协助性)。

如果普通人（陪审团）凭常识就能看懂证据，专家的意见就是多余的，不应被采纳。但如果是像“毒品黑话”、“医疗事故标准”或“复杂的金融结构”这种普通人不懂的领域，只要专家合格且方法可靠，通常都是可采纳的。

questions.question:
A plaintiff, who had been injured in an automobile collision, sued for damages. The defendant denied negligence and denied that the plaintiff's injuries were severe.
At trial, the plaintiff has offered in evidence a color photograph of himself made from a videotape taken by a television news crew at the scene of the collision. The plaintiff has demonstrated that the videotape has since been routinely reused by the television station and that the footage of the plaintiff was erased. The photograph shows the plaintiff moments after the collision, with his bloodied head protruding at a grotesque angle through the broken windshield of his car.
Should the photograph be admitted over the defendant's objection?

choices.a: No, because the plaintiff has failed to establish that a duplicate could not be found.
choices.b: No, because the plaintiff has failed to produce the original videotape or a duplicate.
choices.c: Yes, because a photograph that establishes a disputed fact cannot be excluded as prejudicial.
choices.d: Yes, because it tends to prove a controverted fact.

data.questionStem:
Q87170

A plaintiff, who had been injured in an automobile collision, sued for damages. The defendant denied negligence and denied that the plaintiff's injuries were severe.

At trial, the plaintiff has offered in evidence a color photograph of himself made from a videotape taken by a television news crew at the scene of the collision. The plaintiff has demonstrated that the videotape has since been routinely reused by the television station and that the footage of the plaintiff was erased. The photograph shows the plaintiff moments after the collision, with his bloodied head protruding at a grotesque angle through the broken windshield of his car.

Should the photograph be admitted over the defendant's objection?

一名在车祸中受伤的原告，提起损害赔偿诉讼。被告否认其存在过失，并否认原告的伤势严重。

在审判中，原告提交了一张彩色照片作为证据。该照片是从一家电视台新闻团队在碰撞现场拍摄的录像带中制作的。原告已证明，该录像带此后被电视台例行重复使用，有关原告的录像片段已被删除。照片显示了碰撞发生后不久的原告，他血迹斑斑的头部以一个怪异的角度从他汽车破碎的挡风玻璃中伸出。

这张照片是否应在被告反对的情况下被采纳？
options:
A. No, because the plaintiff has failed to establish that a duplicate could not be found.
不应采纳，因为原告未能证明无法找到副本。

B. No, because the plaintiff has failed to produce the original videotape or a duplicate.
不应采纳，因为原告未能出示原始录像带或其副本。

C. Yes, because a photograph that establishes a disputed fact cannot be excluded as prejudicial.
应采纳，因为一张能证明争议事实的照片，不能因其可能产生偏见而被排除。

D. Yes, because it tends to prove a controverted fact.
应采纳，因为它有助于证明一个有争议的事实。
data.explanation:
Relevant evidence - ie, evidence that tends to make a material fact more or less probable - is admissible unless otherwise provided by law or other evidentiary rules. For example, Federal Rule of Evidence (FRE) 403 bars the admission of relevant evidence if its probative value is substantially outweighed by its danger of unfair prejudice. This rule applies even when the proffered evidence establishes a disputed fact (Choice C).

Here, the photograph offered by the plaintiff poses a danger of unfair prejudice because it shows the plaintiff's bloodied head protruding at a grotesque angle through the windshield. But the photograph has a high probative value because it goes to a controverted material fact - ie, that the plaintiff's injuries from the collision were severe. As a result, the photograph would likely pass FRE 403's balancing test and should be admitted.

Relevant evidence may also be barred by the best evidence rule. This rule generally requires that an original be produced to prove the contents of a writing, recording, or photograph. An original photograph includes the negative and any prints made from it. Therefore, the photograph would be considered an original that satisfies the best evidence rule if it is found to be a print from the negative of the videotape.

But even if the photograph was a duplicate, it would be admissible to the same extent as an original unless (1) a question is raised about the original's authenticity or (2) circumstances make it unfair to admit the duplicate. Since no such questions or circumstances appear here and the plaintiff need not show that other duplicates are unavailable, the photograph should be admitted over the defendant's objection (Choices A & B).

Educational objective: Relevant evidence is inadmissible if its probative value is substantially outweighed by its danger of unfair prejudice. And under the best evidence rule, relevant evidence in the form of a writing, recording, or photograph can be excluded if an original or reliable duplicate is not produced.



选项正确率统计：A选项 5%，B选项 8%，C选项 13%，D选项 72%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

相关证据——即，有助于使一个重要事实（material fact）更可能或更不可能成立的证据——是可采纳的，除非法律或其他证据规则另有规定。例如，《联邦证据规则》(Federal Rule of Evidence, FRE)第403条禁止采纳相关证据，如果其证明价值被其不公正偏见的危险性实质上超过。即使所提交的证据能证明一个争议事实，该规则依然适用(选项C)。

在本案中，原告提交的照片带来了不公正偏见的风险，因为它显示了原告血迹斑斑的头部以一个怪异的角度从挡风玻璃中伸出。但这张照片具有很高的证明价值，因为它涉及一个有争议的重要事实——即原告在碰撞中所受的伤害是严重的。因此，这张照片很可能通过FRE 403的平衡测试，应当被采纳。

相关证据也可能因最佳证据规则（best evidence rule）而被排除。该规则通常要求，为证明书面文件、录音或照片的内容，必须出示原件。一张原始照片包括底片及其冲印出的任何照片。因此，如果这张照片被认定为是从作为原始记录的录像带冲印出来的，那么它将被视为满足最佳证据规则的原件。

但即使这张照片是副本，它也将在与原件同等的程度上可被采纳，除非 (1) 对原件的真实性提出了质疑，或 (2) 当时的情况使得采纳该副本有失公允。由于本案中没有出现此类质疑或情况，且原告无需证明其他副本不可获得，因此这张照片应在被告反对的情况下被采纳(选项 A & B)。

教学目的：如果相关证据的证明价值被其不公正偏见的危险性实质上超过，则该证据不可采纳。并且，根据最佳证据规则，如果未能出示原件或可靠的副本，书面文件、录音或照片形式的相关证据可能被排除。

References

Fed R. Evid. 401 (defining relevant evidence).

Fed R. Evid. 403 (test for excluding relevant evidence for certain dangers).

Fed R. Evid. 1001 - 04 (best evidence rule).

MBE 考点解析

Evidence: Relevancy & Best Evidence Rule
✅ 正确答案：D

应采纳，因为它有助于证明一个有争议的事实 (tends to prove a controverted fact)。

本题考察的是证据法中的两个核心概念：相关性 (Relevancy) 与 最佳证据规则 (Best Evidence Rule) 的结合应用。

⚖️ 法律依据与推理
1. 相关性 (FRE 401 & 403)
证据只要有任何趋势使某个重要事实（Material Fact）更可能或更不可能存在，即为相关。

在本案中，被告否认原告伤势严重。照片显示了原告头部受伤的惨状，这直接证明了伤势的严重性（Severity of injuries）。因此，该照片具有极高的证明价值 (Probative Value)。

虽然照片可能引起“不公正的偏见” (Unfair Prejudice)，但根据 FRE 403，只有当偏见实质上超过 (Substantially Outweighed) 证明价值时，证据才会被排除。由于该照片针对的是案件的核心争议点（伤势是否严重），法院通常会倾向于采纳。

2. 最佳证据规则 (Best Evidence Rule, FRE 1001-1004)
为了证明书面文件、录音或照片的内容，通常需要出示原件。

然而，本案中原告已经证明：

  • 原始录像带已被电视台例行删除（非恶意销毁）。
  • 照片是从录像带制作的。

根据 FRE 1004，如果原件丢失或被毁（且非提出者恶意所为），则可以使用其他证据 (Secondary Evidence) 来证明其内容。因此，这张照片作为次级证据是可采纳的。

❌ 为什么其他选项错误？
选项 A & B (错误)
这两个选项试图利用“最佳证据规则”来排除照片。但如上所述，当原件在正常业务过程中丢失时，规则并不要求必须找到副本或出示原件。次级证据（本案中的照片）即可满足要求。
选项 C (错误)
这是一个常见的绝对化陷阱。选项称“证明争议事实的照片不能被排除”。这是错误的法律陈述。即使证据证明了争议事实，如果其引发的偏见、混淆或拖延时间实质上超过了其证明价值，法官仍有权根据 FRE 403 将其排除。
💡 MBE 考试技巧 (Exam Tip)

1. 面对“血腥照片”： 除非照片完全没有证明价值（例如被告已经承认了伤势，照片纯粹为了激怒陪审团），否则法院通常倾向于采纳 (Admit)。FRE 403 偏向于采纳证据 (Weighted towards admissibility)。

2. 最佳证据规则的例外： 看到“原件丢失”时，首先检查是否是“恶意销毁” (Bad faith)。如果是例行公事 (Routine course of business) 导致的丢失，次级证据（如证人证言、副本、照片）通常都是可采纳的。

questions.question:
A man is charged with possession of heroin. The prosecution called as a witness an experienced dog trainer who testified that he was in the airport with a dog trained to detect heroin. As the man approached, the dog immediately became alert and pawed and barked frantically at the man's briefcase. The man managed to run outside and throw his briefcase into the river, from which it could not be recovered. After the witness's experience is established, he is asked to testify as an expert that the dog's reaction told him that the man's briefcase contained heroin.
Is the witness's testimony admissible?

choices.a: No, because it is based on hearsay not within any exception.
choices.b: No, because of the unreliability of the reactions of an animal.
choices.c: Yes, as evidence of the man's guilt.
choices.d: Yes, because an expert may rely on hearsay.

data.questionStem:
Q87228

A man is charged with possession of heroin. The prosecution called as a witness an experienced dog trainer who testified that he was in the airport with a dog trained to detect heroin. As the man approached, the dog immediately became alert and pawed and barked frantically at the man's briefcase. The man managed to run outside and throw his briefcase into the river, from which it could not be recovered. After the witness's experience is established, he is asked to testify as an expert that the dog's reaction told him that the man's briefcase contained heroin.

Is the witness's testimony admissible?

一名男子被指控持有海洛因。控方传唤了一名经验丰富的训犬师作为证人，他作证说，他当时在机场，带着一只受过海洛因探测训练的警犬。当该男子走近时，警犬立即警觉起来，并疯狂地用爪子扒抓和吠叫该男子的公文包。该男子设法跑到外面，将公文包扔进河里，公文包无法被打捞上来。在证人的专业经验被确认后，他被要求作为专家证人作证，证明警犬的反应告诉他，该男子的公文包里含有海洛因。

该证人的证言是否可被采纳？
options:
A. No, because it is based on hearsay not within any exception.
不可以，因为它基于传闻证据，且不属于任何例外情况。

B. No, because of the unreliability of the reactions of an animal.
不可以，因为动物的反应不可靠。

C. Yes, as evidence of the man's guilt.
可以，作为该男子有罪的证据。

D. Yes, because an expert may rely on hearsay.
可以，因为专家可以依赖传闻证据。
data.explanation:
An expert witness is one who possesses specialized knowledge, skill, experience, education, or training in a subject that pertains to an issue in litigation. Expert witness testimony is admissible for substantive purposes - ie, to help prove a material fact or issue - if it is both:

  • relevant - the testimony will help the trier of fact (1) understand the evidence OR (2) determine a fact in issue and
  • reliable - the testimony is (1) based on sufficient facts or data AND (2) the product of reliable principles and methods that the expert reliably applied to the facts of the case.


Here, the prosecution called an experienced dog trainer who seeks to testify that the dog's reaction to the man's briefcase told him that the briefcase contained heroin. This expert testimony would help the trier of fact determine the fact in issue - ie, whether the man possessed heroin - and is likely reliable based on his experience. Therefore, his testimony is admissible as substantive evidence of the man's guilt.

(Choices A & D) Hearsay is an out-of-court statement offered to prove the truth of the matter asserted therein and is inadmissible unless excluded or excepted from the hearsay rule. An expert may rely on inadmissible hearsay to form an opinion. But for a statement to constitute hearsay, the declarant must be a person - not a dog.

(Choice B) The reactions of trained animals (eg, drug-detection dogs) are commonly relied upon as a basis for expert testimony.

Educational objective: Expert testimony is admissible as substantive evidence if it will help the trier of fact understand the evidence or determine a fact in issue (ie, relevant) AND is based on sufficient facts/data and the product of reliable principles/methods reliably applied by the expert (ie, reliable).



选项正确率统计：A选项 10%，B选项 7%，C选项 65%（正确选项），D选项 16%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

专家证人是指在与诉讼争议相关的某一学科中，拥有专业知识、技能、经验、教育或培训的人。专家证人的证言因实质性目的（即帮助证明某一重要事实或争议点）而可被采纳，条件是它同时满足：

  • 相关性 - 该证言将帮助事实审理者 (1) 理解证据 或 (2) 确定争议中的事实 并且
  • 可靠性 - 该证言 (1) 基于充分的事实或数据，并且 (2) 是专家将可靠的原则和方法可靠地应用于案件事实的产物。


在本案中，控方传唤了一名经验丰富的训犬师，他试图作证说，警犬对该男子公文包的反应告诉他，公文包里含有海洛因。该专家证言将有助于事实审理者确定争议中的事实——即该男子是否持有海洛因——并且基于他的经验，该证言很可能是可靠的。因此，他的证言可作为证明该男子有罪的实质性证据而被采纳。

（选项A和D）传闻证据是指在庭外作出的、为证明其所述事项的真实性而提出的陈述，除非被排除或属于传闻证据规则的例外，否则不予采纳。专家可以依赖不可采纳的传闻证据来形成其意见。但是，构成传闻证据的陈述，其陈述人必须是人——而不是狗。

（选项B）受过训练的动物（例如，缉毒犬）的反应通常被用作专家证言的基础。

教学目标：专家证言若能帮助事实审理者理解证据或确定争议事实（即具有相关性），并且基于充分的事实/数据，同时是专家将可靠的原则/方法可靠地应用于案件事实的产物（即具有可靠性），则可作为实质性证据被采纳。

References

Fed. R. Evid. 702 (expert witness testimony).

MBE 考点解析

证据法：专家证言与传闻规则
正确答案：选项 C 可以，作为该男子有罪的证据。
Yes, as evidence of the man's guilt.
⚖️ 法律依据与推理
🐕 非传闻规则 (Not Hearsay)

这是本题最大的陷阱。根据《联邦证据规则》(FRE 801)，传闻是指人 (Person) 在庭外作出的陈述。

关键点：动物（如警犬）或机器的反应不是陈述 (Statement)，因为它们不是“人”。因此，警犬的吠叫不属于传闻证据规则的管辖范围，不需要寻找传闻例外。

👨‍⚖️ 专家证言 (Expert Testimony)

根据 FRE 702，如果专家拥有专业知识、技能或经验，且其证言能帮助事实审理者理解证据，则该证言可被采纳。

本案逻辑：

  • 证人：训犬师（人）是证人。
  • 基础：他基于其专业经验观察到了警犬的反应。
  • 结论：警犬的反应表明公文包内有毒品。
只要训犬师的资质和警犬训练的可靠性已确立（题目中已说明），这就是合法的专家意见。

❌ 为什么其他选项错误？
选项 A (传闻/Hearsay)： 错误。如上所述，狗不是“陈述人” (Declarant)。狗的叫声不是法律意义上的“陈述”，因此根本不构成传闻。
选项 B (不可靠/Unreliability)： 错误。美国法院普遍承认受过训练的缉毒犬的反应是可靠的证据来源，可以作为专家证言的基础（甚至可以作为搜查的 probable cause）。题目中已明确该证人是“经验丰富”的，且狗是“受过训练”的。
选项 D (专家依赖传闻)： 错误。虽然专家确实可以依赖不可采纳的传闻来形成意见 (FRE 703)，但这个选项的推理前提是“狗叫是传闻”。由于狗叫不是传闻，这个理由在法律逻辑上是不准确的。
💡 MBE 提分技巧 遇到涉及动物（狗、鹦鹉等）或机器（雷达测速、时钟、温度计）产生的信息时：

1. 立即划掉所有声称这是“传闻 (Hearsay)”的选项。
2. 传闻的陈述人必须是人类 (Human Declarant)。
3. 这类证据通常作为实物证据或专家证言的基础引入。

questions.question:
A plaintiff sued a police officer for false arrest. The officer's defense was that, based on a description he heard over the police radio, he reasonably believed the plaintiff was an armed robber. The police radio dispatcher, reading from a note, had broadcast the description of an armed robber on which the officer claims to have relied.
The officer offers as evidence: his testimony relating the description he heard; the dispatcher's testimony relating the description she read over the radio; and the note containing the description the dispatcher testifies she read over the radio.
Which are admissible on the issue of what description the officer heard?

choices.a: The dispatcher's testimony and the note only.
choices.b: The officer's testimony and the dispatcher's testimony only.
choices.c: The officer's testimony and the note only.
choices.d: The officer's testimony, the dispatcher's testimony, and the note.

data.questionStem:
Q87208

A plaintiff sued a police officer for false arrest. The officer's defense was that, based on a description he heard over the police radio, he reasonably believed the plaintiff was an armed robber. The police radio dispatcher, reading from a note, had broadcast the description of an armed robber on which the officer claims to have relied.

The officer offers as evidence: his testimony relating the description he heard; the dispatcher's testimony relating the description she read over the radio; and the note containing the description the dispatcher testifies she read over the radio.

Which are admissible on the issue of what description the officer heard?

一名原告以非法逮捕为由起诉一名警官。该警官的抗辩是，根据他从警用无线电中听到的描述，他有合理理由相信原告是一名持械抢劫犯。警用无线电调度员从一张字条上读取并播报了该警官声称其所依赖的持械抢劫犯的描述。

该警官提供以下证据：他关于所听到描述的证言；调度员关于她通过无线电所播读描述的证言；以及调度员作证其通过无线电所播读的、包含该描述的字条。

关于警官听到了何种描述这一争议点，哪些证据是可采纳的？
options:
A. The dispatcher's testimony and the note only.
仅调度员的证言和字条。

B. The officer's testimony and the dispatcher's testimony only.
仅警官的证言和调度员的证言。

C. The officer's testimony and the note only.
仅警官的证言和字条。

D. The officer's testimony, the dispatcher's testimony, and the note.
警官的证言、调度员的证言和字条。
data.explanation:
False arrest occurs when a person is held in custody without a valid warrant or probable cause. As a result, any evidence that would tend to make the existence of probable cause - and any other material fact - more or less probable is relevant. Relevant evidence is admissible unless it is excluded by a constitutional provision, law, or rule - including the rule against hearsay. That rule bars the admission of out-of-court statements offered to prove the truth of the matter asserted. But it does not bar out-of-court statements offered for a different purpose - eg:
  • to prove that a statement was made to identify a statement's contents - but not to prove its truth -
  • or to show a statement's effect on the person who heard it.


Here, the officer offered three items of evidence - (1) his testimony to the description he heard broadcast over the radio shortly before the plaintiff's arrest, (2) the police radio dispatcher's testimony to what she said during that broadcast, and (3) the dispatcher's authenticated written note from which she read the armed robber's description. These items would be inadmissible hearsay if offered to prove the truth of the matter asserted therein - ie, that the person described was the armed robber.

But the dispatcher's testimony and the note are admissible to prove that the statements were made and to prove their contents . And the officer's testimony is admissible to show the description's effect on him - ie, that it caused him to believe that the plaintiff was the robber. Therefore, the officer's testimony, the dispatcher's testimony, and the note are all admissible to prove that the officer reasonably believed the plaintiff was the armed robber (Choices A, B & C).

Educational objective: Testimony to what a witness heard is generally inadmissible hearsay if offered for the truth of the matter asserted. But such testimony may be admissible for other purposes - eg, to show that a statement was made or affected another.



选项正确率统计：A选项 8%，B选项 26%，C选项 16%，D选项 49%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

当一个人在没有有效逮捕令或相当理由（probable cause）的情况下被拘留时，即构成非法逮捕（false arrest）。因此，任何倾向于使相当理由——以及任何其他关键事实——的存在更可能或更不可能的证据，都是相关的。相关证据是可采纳的，除非被宪法条款、法律或规则——包括排除传闻证据规则（rule against hearsay）——所排除。该规则禁止采纳为证明其所述事项之真实性而提出的庭外陈述。但它不禁止为不同目的而提出的庭外陈述——例如：
  • 为了证明某个陈述曾被做出，以确定陈述的内容——但并非为了证明其真实性——
  • 或为了显示一个陈述对听者产生的影响。


在本案中，该警官提供了三项证据——（1）他就在原告被捕前不久从无线电广播中听到的描述所作的证言，（2）警用无线电调度员就在该广播中所述内容所作的证言，以及（3）调度员宣读持械抢劫犯描述时所依据的、经过认证的书面字条。如果这些证据被用于证明其所述事项的真实性——即被描述的人就是那个持械抢劫犯——那么它们将是不可采纳的传闻证据。

但是，调度员的证言和字条是可采纳的，用以证明陈述曾被做出并证明其内容。而警官的证言是可采纳的，用以显示该描述对他产生的影响——即，这导致他相信原告是抢劫犯。因此，警官的证言、调度员的证言和字条都是可采纳的，用以证明该警官有合理理由相信原告是持械抢劫犯（因此选项A、B和C不正确）。

教学目的：证人就其所听闻内容的证言，如果用于证明所述事项的真实性，通常是不可采纳的传闻证据。但此类证言若用于其他目的——例如，证明某个陈述曾被做出或对他人产生了影响——则可能是可采纳的。

References

Fed. R. Evid. 401 (test for relevant evidence).

Fed. R. Evid. 801 (exclusions from hearsay).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

证据法：传闻证据与相关性
Evidence: Hearsay & Relevancy
核心考点：传闻证据的定义

本题的关键在于判断证据是否属于传闻证据 (Hearsay)。根据 FRE 801(c)，传闻证据必须满足两个条件：

  1. 是庭外陈述 (Out-of-court statement)；
  2. 且是为了证明“所述事项的真实性” (Truth of the matter asserted) 而提出。
关键区别：
如果提出陈述是为了证明该陈述对听者产生的影响 (Effect on the listener)，或者仅仅证明话被说出来了 (Fact of utterance)，则它不是传闻证据，因此是可采纳的。
案情深度解析

本案是关于非法逮捕 (False Arrest)的诉讼。辩护的核心在于警官是否有相当理由 (Probable Cause) 相信原告是抢劫犯。

这就改变了证据的“目的”：

  • ❌ 不需要证明： 原告真的抢劫了（Truth）。
  • ✅ 需要证明： 警官听到了描述，并且基于该描述产生合理信赖（State of mind / Reasonableness）。
为何三项证据均可采纳？

题目问的是关于“警官听到了什么描述”这一争议点，以下证据均相关且非传闻：

  • ✔
    1. 警官的证言
    Officer's Testimony
    证明他听到了广播。这直接展示了广播对他心理状态的影响（Effect on listener），解释了他为何实施逮捕。
  • ✔
    2. 调度员的证言
    Dispatcher's Testimony
    证明该陈述确实被“说出来”了（Fact of utterance）。如果没人广播，警官就不可能听到。这佐证了警官的说法。
  • ✔
    3. 调度员的字条
    The Note
    这是广播内容的原始来源。它证明了调度员读的内容是什么，进一步佐证了广播的内容和警官听到的内容一致。

结论： 所有三项证据都不是为了证明原告是抢劫犯，而是为了构建警官“合理相信”的事实链条。因此，它们都不是传闻证据，且都具有相关性。

🎓 MBE 考试技巧

当你看到涉及“某人的信念”、“知情 (Notice)”、或“相当理由 (Probable Cause)”的题目时，警惕“听者的反应” (Effect on the Listener) 这一非传闻用途。

在这种情况下，只要庭外陈述能解释听者为何采取某种行动，该陈述通常都是可采纳的（Admissible），且不被视为传闻。

Based on NCBE MBE Standards • FRE 801(c)

questions.question:
A factory worker is charged with criminal assault on his manager after losing money to the manager during a game of poker. The factory worker testified that he struck the manager while acting in self-defense. The state now seeks to call a witness to testify that, on two prior occasions, the witness saw the factory worker assault someone without provocation after a poker game and thereafter falsely claim self-defense.
Is the witness's testimony admissible?

choices.a: No, because it is improper character evidence.
choices.b: No, because it is not relevant.
choices.c: Yes, as evidence of the factory worker's violent nature.
choices.d: Yes, as evidence that the factory worker did not act in self-defense on this occasion.

questions.question:
A defendant was charged with using a forged prescription from a local doctor to obtain a powerful painkiller from a drugstore on May 1. At trial, the pharmacist identified the defendant as the customer, but the defendant testified that he had not been in the store. In rebuttal, the prosecutor calls two other pharmacists to testify that on May 1 a man they identified as the defendant had presented prescriptions for the same painkiller from the same local doctor at each of their drugstores.
Is the testimony of the two other pharmacists admissible?

choices.a: No, because it proves specific acts rather than reputation or opinion.
choices.b: No, because other crimes may not be used to show propensity.
choices.c: Yes, to identify the man who presented the prescription at the first pharmacist's drugstore.
choices.d: Yes, to prove a pertinent trait of the defendant's character and his action in conformity therewith.

data.questionStem:
Q87180

A defendant was charged with using a forged prescription from a local doctor to obtain a powerful painkiller from a drugstore on May 1. At trial, the pharmacist identified the defendant as the customer, but the defendant testified that he had not been in the store. In rebuttal, the prosecutor calls two other pharmacists to testify that on May 1 a man they identified as the defendant had presented prescriptions for the same painkiller from the same local doctor at each of their drugstores.

Is the testimony of the two other pharmacists admissible?

一名被告被指控于5月1日使用一张伪造的本地医生的处方，从一家药店获取一种强效止痛药。在庭审中，药剂师指认该被告为当时的顾客，但被告作证称他当时并未在该药店。作为反驳证据，检察官传唤了另外两名药剂师作证，称在5月1日，一名他们指认为被告的男子，在他们各自的药店出示了来自同一位本地医生的、针对同一种止痛药的处方。

这两名药剂师的证词是否可采纳？
options:
A. No, because it proves specific acts rather than reputation or opinion.
否，因为它证明的是具体行为，而非名誉或意见。

B. No, because other crimes may not be used to show propensity.
否，因为不得使用其他罪行来证明（犯罪）倾向。

C. Yes, to identify the man who presented the prescription at the first pharmacist's drugstore.
是，为了指认在第一家药店出示处方的男子。

D. Yes, to prove a pertinent trait of the defendant's character and his action in conformity therewith.
是，为了证明被告品格的一个相关特征及其与该特征相符的行为。
data.explanation:
Evidence that a criminal defendant committed similar crimes or bad acts is inadmissible for propensity purposes - ie, to prove the defendant's character trait and his/her conformance with that trait on the occasion at issue. This protects criminal defendants from being convicted on the basis of bad character (as opposed to actual guilt).

But such evidence may be admissible for relevant, noncharacter purposes (ie, MIMIC). This includes proving the perpetrator's identity - eg, by showing a sufficient similarity (in nature, location, and/or time) between the defendant's prior bad acts and the charged crime to link the defendant to that crime. Therefore, evidence that the defendant presented identical prescriptions at two other drugstores on the same day is admissible to identify him as the man who presented the prescription at the first pharmacist's drugstore (Choice B).

(Choice A) Under Federal Rule of Evidence 405, specific acts cannot be used to prove character unless it is an essential element of a claim, charge, or defense. But specific acts can always be used for relevant, noncharacter purposes - eg, to prove identity (as seen here).

(Choice D) The prosecution may prove a pertinent trait of the defendant's character if the defendant has opened the door to such evidence. This occurs when the defendant offers reputation or opinion testimony on a good character trait that is pertinent (ie, relevant) to the charged crime. Here, there is no indication that the defendant has offered such testimony, so the pharmacists' testimony cannot be admitted for this purpose.

Educational objective: Evidence that a criminal defendant committed similar crimes or bad acts is inadmissible to prove his/her propensity to commit the charged crime. But it may be admissible for relevant, noncharacter purposes (ie, MIMIC).



选项正确率统计：A选项 4%，B选项 4%，C选项 81%（正确选项），D选项 9%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

关于刑事被告犯下类似罪行或不法行为的证据，不可采纳用于证明倾向——即，证明被告的品格特征以及其在涉案场合与该特征相符的行为。这是为了保护刑事被告，使其免于因品格不良（而非实际罪行）而被定罪。

但此类证据可能可采纳用于相关的、非品格目的（即MIMIC）。这包括证明行为人的身份——例如，通过展示被告先前的劣迹与被指控的罪行之间在性质、地点和/或时间上的充分相似性，从而将被告与该罪行联系起来。因此，被告在同一天于另外两家药店出示相同处方的证据是可采纳的，用以指认他就是在第一家药店出示处方的男子（选项B）。

（选项A）根据《联邦证据规则》第405条 (Federal Rule of Evidence 405)，除非品格是某项诉求、指控或辩护的基本要素，否则不得使用具体行为来证明品格。但具体行为始终可以用于相关的、非品格目的——例如，证明身份（如此处所示）。

（选项D）如果被告就其品格证据“打开了大门”，检方可以证明被告品格的一个相关特征。这种情况发生于被告就与被指控罪行相关（即，有关联）的良好品格特征，提供了名誉或意见证词。在此案中，没有迹象表明被告提供了此类证词，因此药剂师的证词不能为此目的而被采纳。

教学目标：关于刑事被告犯下类似罪行或不法行为的证据，不可采纳用于证明其犯下被指控罪行的倾向。但该证据可能因相关的、非品格目的（即MIMIC）而被采纳。

References

Fed. R. Evid. 404(b) (admissibility of crimes, wrongs, or other acts).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 证据法解析

Relevancy & Character Evidence
核心考点：FRE 404(b)

一般规则：先前的不法行为 (Prior Bad Acts) 不可用于证明被告具有犯罪倾向 (Propensity)。

例外规则：如果用于证明非品格 (Non-character) 目的，则是可采纳的。

记忆口诀：MIMIC

先前行为可用于证明以下目的：

MMotive
动机
IIntent
意图
MMistake
(无)错误
IIdentity
身份
CCommon Plan
共同计划
案情逻辑分析

关键事实：被告否认他在药店（提出了身份 Identity 问题）。

检方证据：另外两名药剂师证明，同一天、同一医生、同一药物、同一人。

法律推理：这种高度相似且时间紧凑的作案手法（Modus Operandi），就像“签名”一样，可以用来证明在第一家药店出现的人就是被告。这不是为了说他“人品坏”，而是为了说“就是这个人”。

选项深度解析
正确答案 C

是，为了指认在第一家药店出示处方的男子。

这正是 MIMIC 规则中的 Identity。当被告辩称“那不是我”时，检方可以用极其相似的先前行为来证明身份。

选项 A & B 错误

这两个选项都引用了“禁止倾向性证据”的一般规则。虽然一般规则确实禁止用具体行为证明品格，但本题符合 404(b) 的例外情况（MIMIC），因此证据是可采纳的。

选项 D 错误

为了证明被告品格...

这是典型的陷阱。检方不能主动提出品格证据（Character Evidence），除非被告先“打开了大门”(Opened the door)。本题中被告只是否认在场，并未声称自己“品格良好”，因此检方不能以此为由引入证据。

💡 MBE 提分技巧：
看到“先前犯罪”或“其他坏行为”时，先问自己：
  1. 这是用来证明他“本性难移”（Propensity）吗？如果是 ➡️ 不可采纳。
  2. 这是用来证明 MIMIC (动机、意图、身份等) 吗？如果是 ➡️ 可采纳。
本题中，被告说“我不在那儿”，直接触发了 Identity 考点。

questions.question:
A defendant was charged with possession of cocaine. At the defendant's trial, the prosecution called a police officer to testify that, when approached by police on a suburban residential street corner, the defendant dropped a plastic bag and ran, and that when the officer returned to the corner a few minutes later after catching the defendant, he found a plastic bag containing white powder.
The defendant objects to introduction of this bag (the contents of which would later be established to be cocaine), citing lack of adequate identification.
How should the court rule on the defendant's objection?

choices.a: Overrule the objection, because the objection should have been made on the basis of incomplete chain of custody.
choices.b: Overrule the objection, because there is sufficient evidence to find that the bag was the one the defendant dropped.
choices.c: Sustain the objection, because the defendant did not have possession of the bag at the time he was arrested.
choices.d: Sustain the objection, unless the judge makes a finding by preponderance of the evidence that the bag was the one dropped by the defendant.

data.questionStem:
Q87183

A defendant was charged with possession of cocaine. At the defendant's trial, the prosecution called a police officer to testify that, when approached by police on a suburban residential street corner, the defendant dropped a plastic bag and ran, and that when the officer returned to the corner a few minutes later after catching the defendant, he found a plastic bag containing white powder.

The defendant objects to introduction of this bag (the contents of which would later be established to be cocaine), citing lack of adequate identification.

How should the court rule on the defendant's objection?

一名被告被指控持有可卡因。在对该被告的庭审中，控方传唤一名警官作证，称当被告在市郊住宅区街角被警察靠近时，他丢下一个塑料袋并逃跑，并且，在抓获被告几分钟后，当该警官返回那个街角时，他发现了一个装有白色粉末的塑料袋。

被告对采纳该塑料袋作为证据提出异议（袋中物品后被证实为可卡因），理由是缺乏充分的辨认。

法庭应如何裁定被告的异议？
options:
A. Overrule the objection, because the objection should have been made on the basis of incomplete chain of custody.
驳回异议，因为该异议本应基于不完整的证据监管链而提出。

B. Overrule the objection, because there is sufficient evidence to find that the bag was the one the defendant dropped.
驳回异议，因为有充分的证据可以认定该塑料袋就是被告所丢弃的那个。

C. Sustain the objection, because the defendant did not have possession of the bag at the time he was arrested.
支持异议，因为被告在被捕时并未持有该塑料袋。

D. Sustain the objection, unless the judge makes a finding by preponderance of the evidence that the bag was the one dropped by the defendant.
支持异议，除非法官根据优势证据原则作出裁定，认定该塑料袋是被告所丢弃的那个。
data.explanation:
Authenticating physical objects (FRE 901)


Personal knowledgeTestimony by witness with personal knowledge of object (or that reproduction depicts original object). Most common method of authentication.
ComparisonComparison of object or writing against authenticated specimen by expert or trier of fact.
Distinctive characteristicsTestimony on object's appearance, contents, substance, internal patterns, or other distinctive characteristics.
Chain of custodySubstantially unbroken account of object's whereabouts from time it was obtained until introduction at trial. Required method for authenticating objects that could easily be tampered with or confused with similar item (eg, blood sample).
X-ray images &electrocardiogramsEvidence showing accurate process was used, machine was working properly, machine operator was qualified & chain of custody. Required method for authenticating physical representations of things that cannot otherwise be seen.
FRE = Federal Rule of Evidence.

Physical objects, like all tangible evidence, must be authenticated before they can be admitted at trial. Authentication requires a prima facie showing that the object is what the proponent claims it to be. This is most commonly done by testimony of someone with personal knowledge of the object, which comes from firsthand observations or experiences.

Here, the police officer testified that he saw the defendant drop a plastic bag before running and that he recovered a bag from that same area a few minutes after catching the defendant. Since this testimony is based on the police officer's personal knowledge and provides sufficient evidence to find that the recovered bag was the one the defendant had dropped, the defendant's objection should be overruled.

(Choice A) An objection based on incomplete chain of custody may have been sustained if the prosecution failed to establish a substantially unbroken account of the bag's whereabouts from the time it was obtained until its introduction at trial. However, there are insufficient facts to determine if the prosecution could meet this burden.

(Choice C) Although the bag was not found on the defendant's person, there is still sufficient evidence to find that the bag was the one he dropped.

(Choice D) Authentication merely requires proof that the item is what the proponent claims it to be. This is a lesser standard than a preponderance of the evidence, which requires that a party show that the greater weight of the evidence (more than 50%) supports his/her argument.

Educational objective: Before physical evidence can be admitted at trial, it must be authenticated through a prima facie showing that the item is what the proponent claims it to be. This is commonly done by testimony of personal knowledge of the object.

选项正确率统计：A选项 13%，B选项 62%（正确选项），C选项 3%，D选项 20%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

实物证据的认证 (FRE 901)


亲身认知由对物证有亲身认知的证人提供的证言（或证明复制品描绘了原始物证）。最常见的认证方法。
比对由专家或事实审理者将物证或文书与经认证的样本进行比对。
独有特征关于物证外观、内容、物质、内部图案或其他独有特征的证言。
证据监管链从获取物证到庭审采纳期间，对其下落的实质上不间断的说明。对于容易被篡改或与相似物品混淆的物证（如血样），这是必需的认证方法。
X光图像与心电图证明程序准确、机器正常工作、机器操作员合格以及证据监管链的证据。对于那些无法通过其他方式看到的物体的物理再现，这是必需的认证方法。
FRE = 《联邦证据规则》(Federal Rule of Evidence)。

实物证据，与所有有形证据一样，必须在庭审中被采纳前得到认证。认证要求初步证据证明该物证是证据提出方所声称的物品。这通常通过对该物证有亲身认知的人提供证言来完成，这种认知来自于第一手的观察或经历。

在本案中，警官作证说，他看到被告在逃跑前丢下一个塑料袋，并且在抓获被告几分钟后，他从同一区域找回了一个袋子。由于该证言基于警官的亲身认知，并提供了充分的证据来认定找回的袋子就是被告所丢弃的那个，因此被告的异议应被驳回。

（选项A）如果控方未能提供从获取袋子到庭审采纳期间其下落的实质上不间断的说明，那么基于不完整证据监管链的异议可能会被支持。然而，现有事实不足以确定控方是否能满足这一举证责任。

（选项C）尽管该袋子并非在被告身上发现，但仍有充分的证据可以认定该袋子就是他所丢弃的那个。

（选项D）认证仅要求证明该物品是证据提出方所声称的物品。这是一个比优势证据原则更低的标准，后者要求一方当事人证明更具分量的证据（超过50%）支持其论点。

教学目标：在实物证据能在庭审中被采纳之前，必须通过初步证据证明该物品是证据提出方所声称的物品来进行认证。这通常通过对该物证有亲身认知的人提供证言来完成。

References

Fed. R. Evid. 901 (authenticating or identifying evidence).

data.htmlContent:
Evidence / 证据法

实物证据的认证 (Authentication)

本题考察的核心是实物证据的可采性，具体涉及《联邦证据规则》第901条（FRE 901）。

正确答案：B
驳回异议，因为有充分的证据可以认定该塑料袋就是被告所丢弃的那个。

⚖️ 法律规则解析

根据 FRE 901(a)，为了认证或辨认某项证据，证据提出方（Proponent）必须提供：

“足以支持一项认定的证据，证明该物品即是提出方所声称的物品。”
"Evidence sufficient to support a finding that the item is what the proponent claims it is."

这是一个较低的证明标准（Prima Facie Standard，初步证据标准）。

  • 法官的角色： 仅需判断是否有“足够的证据”让一个合理的陪审团（Reasonable Jury）相信这袋子是被告扔的。
  • 陪审团的角色： 最终决定是否真的相信这袋子是被告扔的（证据的证明力/Weight）。

🔍 案情分析

1. 证据链条：
警官作证说看到被告扔了一个袋子 ➡️ 警官几分钟后回到同一地点 ➡️ 发现了一个装有白色粉末的袋子。
2. 推理逻辑：
虽然警官离开了几分钟，但这期间袋子被调包的可能性虽然存在，但并不足以导致证据直接被排除。警官的证词（基于亲身感知 Personal Knowledge）提供了充分的环境证据（Circumstantial Evidence），足以让陪审团认定这就是那个袋子。
3. 结论：
因此，法庭应驳回被告关于“缺乏充分辨认”的异议，允许证据呈堂。

🚫 易错项辨析

❌ 选项 D 错误（最大陷阱）
选项D提到了“优势证据原则”(Preponderance of the Evidence)。

解析： 在认证（Authentication）问题上，法官不需要确信证据“更有可能”（>50%）是真的。法官只需要确认存在“足以支持一项认定”的证据即可（FRE 104(b) 条件相关性）。如果要求法官先用优势证据标准裁定，实际上是法官篡夺了陪审团评估证据的职能。
❌ 选项 A 错误
虽然“证据监管链”(Chain of Custody)不完整，但这通常影响证据的分量而非可采性，除非缺失环节极其严重导致无法认证。本题中，警官的直接观察和短时间间隔已足以满足认证的最低门槛。

🎓 MBE 考试技巧

在处理 Authentication (认证) 题目时，请记住口诀：

"Low Bar for Admissibility" (准入门槛很低)

只要有一点证据能让合理的人认为“这就是那个东西”，法官就应该放行（Admit）。至于这东西是否被调包、是否可信，留给陪审团去吵（Weight）。

questions.question:
At trial in a criminal prosecution for aggravated battery, the defendant testified that she was acting in self-defense when she struck the victim. The defendant has now called a witness to testify that the victim has a reputation in the community as a violent person. The prosecutor has objected to the witness's testimony.
Should the testimony be admitted?

choices.a: No, because the prosecution has not introduced evidence of the defendant's violent character.
choices.b: No, because the prosecution has not introduced evidence of the victim's peaceful character.
choices.c: Yes, because the testimony calls the victim's character for truthfulness into question.
choices.d: Yes, because the testimony supports the defendant's claim of self-defense.
