Q87207

At trial in a criminal prosecution for aggravated battery, the defendant testified that she was acting in self-defense when she struck the victim. The defendant has now called a witness to testify that the victim has a reputation in the community as a violent person. The prosecutor has objected to the witness's testimony.

Should the testimony be admitted?

在一场关于加重伤害罪（aggravated battery）的刑事诉讼审判中，被告作证称，她在攻击受害人时是出于自卫。被告现在传唤一名证人作证，证明受害人在社区中以暴力著称。检察官对该证人的证词提出了异议。

该证词是否应被采纳？
options:
A. No, because the prosecution has not introduced evidence of the defendant's violent character.
不应采纳，因为控方并未引入证明被告暴力品格的证据。

B. No, because the prosecution has not introduced evidence of the victim's peaceful character.
不应采纳，因为控方并未引入证明受害人平和品格的证据。

C. Yes, because the testimony calls the victim's character for truthfulness into question.
应予采纳，因为该证词对受害人的诚信品格提出了质疑。

D. Yes, because the testimony supports the defendant's claim of self-defense.
应予采纳，因为该证词支持了被告的自卫主张。
data.explanation:
Under FRE 404, evidence of a person's character is generally inadmissible to prove that the person acted in accordance with that character on the occasion being litigated. However, a criminal defendant may offer evidence of an alleged victim's character , to show conformity therewith, if it is pertinent to the case.†

Here, for example, the criminal defendant is on trial for battery and has argued self-defense. As a result, evidence of the victim's violent character is admissible because it is pertinent to the asserted defense. The evidence may be used to support an argument that the victim was the first aggressor or to show that the defendant reasonably believed she needed to use force to defend herself.

Once admitted, the evidence may be rebutted by the prosecution with evidence of the victim's good character for the pertinent trait (eg, peacefulness) and the defendant's bad character for the same pertinent trait (eg, violence).

†However, under FRE 412, evidence offered to prove that a victim engaged in other sexual behavior or a victim's sexual predisposition is inadmissible in civil or criminal proceedings involving sexual misconduct - with some exceptions.

(Choices A & B) A criminal defendant's ability to introduce evidence of a victim's pertinent character trait is not predicated upon the prosecution opening the door to that evidence. To the contrary, the prosecution may only introduce evidence of a defendant's or victim's character after the defendant has opened the door to that evidence.

(Choice C) Evidence of the victim's reputation for violence has no bearing on the victim's character for truthfulness because it does not show that the victim has a general propensity for dishonesty. It merely supports the defendant's testimony that she was acting in self-defense.

Educational objective: A criminal defendant may introduce evidence of an alleged victim's character if it is pertinent to the case. The prosecution may then rebut that evidence with evidence of (1) the victim's good character for the pertinent trait and (2) the defendant's bad character for that trait.



选项正确率统计：A选项 4%，B选项 8%，C选项 3%，D选项 83%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

根据《联邦证据规则》(FRE) 第404条，关于个人品格的证据通常不可采纳，用以证明该人在诉讼所涉场合的行为与其品格一致。然而，刑事案件的被告可以提供据称的受害人品格的证据，以显示其行为与该品格一致，前提是该证据与案件相关。†

例如，在本案中，刑事被告因伤害罪（battery）受审，并主张自卫。因此，关于受害人暴力品格的证据是可采纳的，因为它与所主张的自卫相关。该证据可用于支持受害人是最初攻击者的论点，或用于证明被告有合理理由相信她需要使用武力进行自卫。

一旦采纳，该证据可能被控方反驳，控方可引入证据证明受害人在相关特质（如平和）上的良好品格以及被告在同一相关特质（如暴力）上的不良品格。

†然而，根据FRE 412，在涉及性不当行为的民事或刑事诉讼中，为证明受害人曾有其他性行为或性倾向而提出的证据不予采纳——但有部分例外。

(选项 A & B) 刑事被告引入受害人相关品格特质证据的能力，并不以控方首先开启该证据之门为前提。恰恰相反，只有在被告开启了品格证据之门后，控方才能引入关于被告或受害人品格的证据。

(选项 C) 关于受害人暴力声誉的证据，与其诚信品格无关，因为它并未显示受害人有不诚实的普遍倾向。它仅仅支持了被告关于其行为是出于自卫的证词。

教学目标：刑事被告可以引入据称的受害人的品格证据，前提是该证据与案件相关。其后，控方可以用以下证据反驳：(1) 受害人在相关特质上的良好品格证据，以及 (2) 被告在该特质上的不良品格证据。

References

  • Fed. R. Evid. 404(a)(2) (character evidence regarding victim in criminal cases).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 证据法精讲

Character Evidence (品格证据)
⚖️ 核心规则：FRE 404(a)(2) 在刑事案件中，虽然一般禁止使用品格证据来证明行为的一致性（Propensity），但存在一个重要的例外：

被告（Defendant）有权主动引入关于受害人（Victim）相关品格特征的证据。
逻辑推演

本题考察的是刑事被告如何利用受害人的品格证据来支持自己的辩护。

1. 案件背景：
这是一起加重伤害罪（Aggravated Battery）的刑事诉讼，被告主张自卫（Self-Defense）。

2. 关键证据：
被告传唤证人证明受害人有“暴力（Violent）”的名声。

3. 法律分析：
在自卫案件中，受害人是否具有暴力倾向是相关（Pertinent）的。如果受害人有暴力名声，这可以支持被告的说法：即受害人可能是最初的攻击者（First Aggressor），或者被告有理由恐惧并使用武力。

选项解析
正确答案 D 应予采纳，因为该证词支持了被告的自卫主张。

这直接符合 FRE 404(a)(2)(B)。被告有权“开启大门”（Open the Door），引入受害人的相关不良品格（暴力），以证明受害人在案发时的行为符合该暴力品格（即受害人先动的手）。
陷阱 A & B 关于“谁先开启大门”

这两个选项错误地暗示控方必须先行动。实际上，在品格证据方面，控方（Prosecution）通常是被动的。只有在被告先引入了受害人的不良品格证据后，控方才有权进行反驳（Rebut）。被告不需要等待控方先出牌。
混淆项 C 关于“诚信品格” (Truthfulness)

这是一个常见的干扰项。暴力名声（Reputation for violence）与诚实（Truthfulness）无关。
  • FRE 608 涉及攻击证人的诚实度（Impeachment）。
  • FRE 404 涉及用性格证明行为倾向。
本题中，被告是想证明受害人“打人”，而不是证明受害人“撒谎”。
⚠️ 考试预警：后果（The Catch） 考生必须知道，一旦被告引入了受害人的不良品格证据，控方可以如何反击？
根据 FRE 404(a)(2)(B)(ii)，控方可以引入：
  1. 受害人的良好品格（和平）；AND
  2. 被告的不良品格（暴力）。
这就是所谓的“引火烧身”。虽然本题只问是否可采纳，但MBE常考这一后续后果。
解题口诀：
刑事自卫案，被告若出招（受害人暴力），
大门即开启，证据可入庭。

questions.question:
A defendant was charged with possession of cocaine with intent to distribute. He had been stopped while driving a car and several pounds of cocaine were found in the trunk.
In her opening statement, the defendant's counsel asserted that her client had no key to the trunk and no knowledge of its contents. The prosecutor offers the state motor vehicle registration, shown to have been found in the glove compartment of the car, listing the defendant as the owner.
Should the court admit the registration?

choices.a: No, as hearsay not within any exception.
choices.b: No, unless authenticated by testimony of or certification by a state official charged with custody of vehicle registration records.
choices.c: Yes, as a statement against interest.
choices.d: Yes, as evidence of the defendant's close connection with the car and, therefore, knowledge of its contents.

一名被告被指控犯有持有并意图分销可卡因的罪行。他在驾驶一辆汽车时被拦下，其后备箱中发现了数磅可卡因。

在开案陈词中，被告的律师声称其当事人没有后备箱钥匙，且对其中的物品一无所知。检察官出示了在汽车手套箱中发现的州机动车登记证，该登记证将被告列为车主。

法院是否应采纳该登记证？
options:
A. No, as hearsay not within any exception.
不应采纳，因为该证据属于传闻证据，且不符合任何例外规定。

B. No, unless authenticated by testimony of or certification by a state official charged with custody of vehicle registration records.
不应采纳，除非经负责保管车辆登记记录的州政府官员的证言或文书认证。

C. Yes, as a statement against interest.
应采纳，因为这属于一种对自身利益不利的陈述。

D. Yes, as evidence of the defendant's close connection with the car and, therefore, knowledge of its contents.
应采纳，因为该证据可证明被告与该车有密切联系，并因此知晓车内物品。
data.explanation:
Evidence is relevant, and admissible unless otherwise provided by law or other rules, if:
  • it has any tendency to make a fact more or less probable than it would be without that evidence (ie, probative) and
  • the fact is of consequence to the outcome of the case (ie, material).


Whether the defendant knew that there was cocaine in his possession is an issue of material fact in this case. The defendant's counsel claimed that he had no key to the trunk and no knowledge of the cocaine found therein. But a state motor vehicle registration found in the glove compartment listing the defendant as the owner provides circumstantial evidence of his close connection with the car. Since this would make it more probable that the defendant knew that there was cocaine in his trunk, the registration is relevant.

However, one basis for exclusion raised in this question is the hearsay rule, which generally bars the admission of out-of-court statements (eg, vehicle registrations) offered to prove the truth of the matter asserted therein (eg, the vehicle's owner). Here, the registration is not hearsay because it is being offered to prove the defendant's close connection to the car - not his ownership of it. Therefore, the registration need not be excepted (eg, as a statement against interest) or excluded from hearsay to be admitted (Choices A & C).

The other basis for exclusion raised here is lack of authenticity. All tangible evidence must be authenticated - ie, proven to be what the proponent claims it to be - before it can be admitted to prove its contents. Therefore, a state custodian would have to certify the registration (ie, a public record) to prove that the defendant owned the car, but not to establish his connection to it (Choice B). And since no other grounds for exclusion have been raised, the court should admit the registration.

Educational objective: Evidence is relevant if it has any tendency to make a material fact more or less probable. Relevant evidence is admissible unless it is excluded by law or other rules - eg, hearsay, authenticity requirements.



选项正确率统计：A选项 1%，B选项 19%，C选项 3%，D选项 75%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

证据具有关联性，且除非法律或其他规则另有规定，否则是可采纳的，条件是：
  • 该证据具有任何使某一事实（相较于没有该证据时）更可能或更不可能的趋势（即具有证明力）并且
  • 该事实对案件的结果具有重要性（即具有重要性）。


被告是否知晓其持有可卡因是本案的一个重要事实问题。被告的律师声称他没有后备箱钥匙，也对其中发现的可卡因一无所知。但是在手套箱中发现的、将被告列为车主的州机动车登记证，为他与该车的密切联系提供了间接证据。由于这会使被告知晓其后备箱中有可卡因的可能性更大，因此该登记证具有关联性。

然而，本问题中提出的一个排除理由是传闻证据规则，该规则通常禁止采纳为证明所述事项的真实性（例如，车辆的所有人）而提出的庭外陈述（例如，车辆登记证）。在此，该登记证并非传闻证据，因为其被用以证明被告与该车的密切联系，而非其所有权。因此，该登记证无需作为传闻证据的例外（例如，作为对自身利益不利的陈述）或被排除，即可被采纳（选项A和C）。

此处提出的另一个排除理由是缺乏真实性。所有有形证据在被采纳以证明其内容之前，都必须经过认证——即证明其确为证据提出方所声称的物品。因此，州政府保管人需要对该登记证（即一份公共记录）进行认证，以证明被告拥有该车，但认证并非为了建立他与该车的联系（选项B）。并且由于没有提出其他排除的理由，法院应采纳该登记证。

教学目的：如果证据具有任何使某一重要事实更可能或更不可能的趋势，则该证据具有关联性。关联证据是可采纳的，除非被法律或其他规则排除——例如，传闻证据规则、真实性要求。

References

Fed. R. Evid. 401 (test for relevance).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

证据法 (Evidence) - Relevancy & Hearsay

✅ 正确答案：D

理由：该证据可证明被告与该车有密切联系，并因此知晓车内物品。

核心逻辑：非传闻用途 (Non-Hearsay Purpose) + 关联性 (Relevance)。

⚖️ 法律深度解析

本题考察的是证据法中极易混淆的“传闻证据”与“间接证据”的区别。

1. 关联性 (Relevance - FRE 401)
证据只要能让某个重要事实（Material Fact）变得“更可能”或“更不可能”，即具有关联性。

本案中，辩方声称被告“没有钥匙”且“不知情”。在手套箱中发现写有被告名字的文件（无论内容真假），都能证明被告与这辆车存在物理上的联系 (Physical Connection)。这种联系增加了被告“控制”车辆并知晓后备箱内容的可能性。

2. 传闻证据的定义 (Hearsay - FRE 801)
传闻是指：(1) 庭外陈述，(2) 提出该证据是为了证明“所述事项的真实性” (Truth of the Matter Asserted)。

关键点：如果提出证据不是为了证明文件内容的真实性（即“被告是合法车主”），而是为了证明其他事实（即“被告的私人物品出现在车内，说明他与车有关联”），那么它就不是传闻 (Not Hearsay)。

检察官的目的是反驳被告“对此车一无所知”的辩解。只要那张纸上有他的名字且在车里，就能建立联系，至于DMV记录是否准确并不重要。

❌ 干扰项排除

  • 选项 A (Hearsay)： 错误。如上所述，当证据被用于证明“联系/控制”而非“所有权归属”时，它不被视为传闻证据。
  • 选项 B (Authentication)： 错误。虽然公共记录证明内容（所有权）时需要严格认证，但这里作为实物证据（在车内发现的物品），其发现地点的证词通常足以满足基础认证 (Prima Facie Authenticity) 要求，证明它确实是“在车里发现的那张纸”。
  • 选项 C (Statement Against Interest)： 错误。这是传闻例外的一种，但它要求声明人“不可出庭” (Unavailable)（FRE 804）。题目未提及DMV官员或被告不可出庭，且该文件并非典型的“违反自身利益”的陈述。

🎓 MBE 备考技巧

遇到“文件/陈述”题时的思维导图：

  1. 问目的 (Ask the Purpose)： 为什么要引入这个证据？
  2. 如果是为了证明内容为真 (To prove the content is true)： 它是传闻，必须找例外（如商业记录、公共记录等）。
  3. 如果是为了证明其他事实 (To prove something else)： 如本题中的“存在联系”、“听者的反应”或“精神状态”，则它不是传闻，通常只要有关联性即可采纳。

口诀： "Not offered for the truth of the matter asserted." 是MBE证据法中最常见的正确答案路径之一。

questions.question:
A man sued an auto manufacturer for his wife's death, claiming that a defective steering mechanism on the family car caused it to veer off the road and hit a tree when his wife was driving. The auto manufacturer claims that the steering mechanism was damaged in the collision and offers testimony that the deceased wife was intoxicated at the time of the accident.
Is the testimony concerning the wife's intoxication admissible?

choices.a: No, because it is improper to prove character evidence by specific conduct.
choices.b: No, because it is substantially more prejudicial than probative.
choices.c: Yes, as proper evidence of the wife's character.
choices.d: Yes, to provide an alternate explanation of the accident's cause.

The auto manufacturer claims that the steering mechanism was damaged in the collision and offers testimony that the deceased wife was intoxicated at the time of the accident.

一名男子就其妻子的死亡起诉了一家汽车制造商，声称其家用汽车上有缺陷的转向装置导致其妻子在驾驶时车辆偏离道路并撞上一棵树。该汽车制造商声称，转向装置是在碰撞中受损的，并提供证言称，已故妻子在事故发生时处于醉酒状态。

关于该妻子醉酒的证言是否可采纳？
options:
A. No, because it is improper to prove character evidence by specific conduct.
不可采纳，因为以特定行为来证明品格证据是不当的。

B. No, because it is substantially more prejudicial than probative.
不可采纳，因为其不公允的偏见性实质上超过其证明价值。

C. Yes, as proper evidence of the wife's character.
可采纳，作为关于该妻子品格的适当证据。

D. Yes, to provide an alternate explanation of the accident's cause.
可采纳，以提供对事故原因的替代性解释。
data.explanation:
Evidence must be relevant to be admissible. This means that the proffered evidence must tend to make a material fact - ie, one of consequence in determining the lawsuit - more or less probable. Therefore, testimony that the wife was intoxicated at the time of the accident is relevant because it tends to reduce the probability of a material fact - that a defective mechanism caused the accident. But even when this low threshold for relevance is met, evidence can still be excluded by other laws or evidentiary rules.

For example, Federal Rule of Evidence 403 excludes relevant evidence when its probative value (ie, degree of relevance) is substantially outweighed by the danger of unfair prejudice to the opposing party. But here, testimony on the wife's intoxication addresses the accident's cause - a central issue in this case. As a result, the testimony has a high probative value that is not substantially outweighed by the danger of unfair prejudice (Choice B).

The other grounds for exclusion raised in this question pertain to character evidence - ie, evidence of a person's general disposition. But the proffered testimony is not character evidence since it seeks to provide an alternative explanation for the accident's cause - not to prove the wife's general disposition for intoxication. Additionally, character evidence is only admissible in a civil case when character is an essential element of a claim or defense (not seen here) (Choices A & C). Therefore, testimony concerning the wife's intoxication is admissible.

Educational objective: Evidence must be relevant - ie, tend to make a material fact more or less probable - to be admissible. But even relevant evidence can be excluded by other laws or evidentiary rules (eg, unfair prejudice, character evidence).



选项正确率统计：A选项 1%，B选项 7%，C选项 0%，D选项 90%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

证据必须具有相关性才能被采纳。这意味着所提出的证据必须倾向于使一个实质性事实——即一个对诉讼裁决有影响的事实——变得更可能或更不可能。因此，关于妻子在事故发生时醉酒的证言是相关的，因为它倾向于降低一个实质性事实——即有缺陷的装置导致了事故——的可能性。但即使满足了这一相关性的低门槛，证据仍可能被其他法律或证据规则排除。

例如，Federal Rule of Evidence 403 规定，当相关证据的证明价值（即相关性程度）被对对方当事人造成不公允偏见的危险实质上超过时，该证据应被排除。但在本案中，关于妻子醉酒的证言涉及事故的原因——这是本案的一个核心争议点。因此，该证言具有很高的证明价值，并没有被不公允偏见的危险实质上超过(选项 B)。

本问题中提出的其他排除理由与品格证据有关——即关于一个人一般倾向的证据。但所提出的证言并非品格证据，因为它旨在为事故原因提供一个替代性解释，而不是为了证明妻子有醉酒的一般倾向。此外，在民事案件中，只有当品格是某项诉讼请求或抗辩的必要元素时，品格证据才可被采纳（本案并非如此）(选项 A & C)。因此，关于妻子醉酒的证言是可采纳的。

教学目标：证据必须具有相关性——即倾向于使一个实质性事实变得更可能或更不可能——才能被采纳。但即使是相关的证据，也可能被其他法律或证据规则（例如，不公允的偏见、品格证据）排除。

References

  • Fed. R. Evid. 401 (test for relevant evidence).

MBE 考点解析

Evidence / Relevancy (证据法/相关性)
✅ 正确答案：D
关于妻子醉酒的证言是可采纳的 (Admissible)，因为它为事故原因提供了替代性解释 (Alternative Explanation)。
⚖️ 法律依据与逻辑推理

FRE 401 相关性 (Relevance)

根据《联邦证据规则》(Federal Rules of Evidence)，证据只要能使某个对诉讼结果有影响的事实（Material Fact）变得更可能或更不可能，即具有相关性。

  • 本案核心争议：事故的起因 (Causation)。
  • 原告主张：转向装置缺陷 (Defective Mechanism)。
  • 被告主张：驾驶员醉酒导致失控 (Driver Intoxication)。

证明妻子当时处于醉酒状态，直接降低了“机械故障导致事故”的可能性，并增加了“人为错误导致事故”的可能性。因此，该证据具有高度相关性。

🚫 陷阱排除：品格证据 vs. 事实状态

很多考生容易混淆品格证据 (Character Evidence)与特定状态证据 (Evidence of Specific Condition)。

排除选项 A 和 C (Character Evidence)：
品格证据通常指一个人的“一般倾向” (General Disposition)，例如“她是个酒鬼”。

本案中的证言并非指责妻子平时爱喝酒，而是指出她在事故发生的特定时刻处于醉酒状态。这是对当时物理/精神状态的描述，属于事实证据，而非品格证据。因此，不需要考虑民事案件中品格证据的限制规则。
⚖️ 权衡测试 (The Balancing Test)

FRE 403 偏见 vs. 证明价值

排除选项 B (Unfair Prejudice)：
虽然“醉酒”听起来对原告不利（Prejudicial），但 FRE 403 只有在不公允的偏见 (Unfair Prejudice) 实质上超过 (Substantially Outweighed) 证明价值 (Probative Value) 时才排除证据。

在本案中，醉酒直接解释了事故原因，证明价值极高。它虽然对原告的案子有“杀伤力”，但这种杀伤力是基于事实逻辑的，并非“不公允”的情绪煽动。
💡 MBE 考试技巧

当题目涉及侵权案件（如车祸、产品责任）时，如果一方试图引入对方在事发当时的身体状况（如醉酒、疲劳、视力模糊），这通常是为了证明因果关系 (Causation) 或 共同过失 (Contributory Negligence)。

切记：特定时刻的状态 ≠ 品格证据。不要一看到“醉酒”就自动联想到 Character Evidence 的禁令。

© MBE 考点复习助手 | Reference: FRE 401, 403

questions.question:
A defendant was charged with the crime of defrauding the federal agency where he worked as an accountant. At trial, the court allowed the defendant to call his supervisor at the large corporation where he had previously worked, who testified about the defendant's good reputation in the community for honesty. Over objection, the defendant then sought to elicit testimony from his former supervisor that on several occasions the corporation had, without incident, entrusted him with large sums of money.
Should the testimony be admitted?

choices.a: No, because good character cannot be proved by specific instances of conduct unless character is an essential element of the charge or defense.
choices.b: No, because the testimony is extrinsic evidence on a collateral matter.
choices.c: Yes, because it is evidence of a pertinent character trait offered by an accused.
choices.d: Yes, because it is relevant to whether the defendant was likely to have taken money as charged in this case.

data.questionStem:
Q87194

A defendant was charged with the crime of defrauding the federal agency where he worked as an accountant. At trial, the court allowed the defendant to call his supervisor at the large corporation where he had previously worked, who testified about the defendant's good reputation in the community for honesty. Over objection, the defendant then sought to elicit testimony from his former supervisor that on several occasions the corporation had, without incident, entrusted him with large sums of money.

Should the testimony be admitted?

一名被告被指控欺诈其曾任会计师的联邦机构。在审判中，法院允许被告传唤其前雇主（一家大型公司）的主管作证，该主管就该被告在社区中诚实正直的良好声誉作证。被告随后在反对意见下，试图从其前主管处引出证词，证明公司曾多次将大笔资金委托给他，且均未发生任何事故。

该证词应否被采纳？
options:
A. No, because good character cannot be proved by specific instances of conduct unless character is an essential element of the charge or defense.
不应采纳，因为良好品格不能通过特定行为事例来证明，除非品格是控罪或抗辩的必要要素。

B. No, because the testimony is extrinsic evidence on a collateral matter.
不应采纳，因为该证词是关于附随事项的外部证据。

C. Yes, because it is evidence of a pertinent character trait offered by an accused.
应采纳，因为这是由被告提出的相关品格特质的证据。

D. Yes, because it is relevant to whether the defendant was likely to have taken money as charged in this case.
应采纳，因为这与被告是否可能如本案所指控的那样拿走了钱款相关。
data.explanation:
A criminal defendant may offer evidence of his/her good character when that character trait is:
  • an essential element of the charged crime or asserted defense - ie, the trait must be proven for the defendant to be convicted of a crime or prevail in a defense or
  • otherwise pertinent to the charged crime - ie, the trait is relevant to, but not an element of, a crime or defense.
Reputation and opinion testimony can always be used to prove a criminal defendant's good character. But specific instances of conduct (SICs) can only be used when character is an essential element of the crime or defense. That is because SICs pose a great risk of prejudicing or confusing the jury.

Here, the defendant was charged with fraud - ie, a knowing misrepresentation made to induce another to act. Since character is not an essential element of this offense, testimony from the defendant's former supervisor about specific instances when the defendant was entrusted with large sums of money should not be admitted. But since honesty is pertinent to fraud, testimony about the defendant's honest reputation was properly admitted.

(Choice B) Under the collateral-evidence rule, extrinsic evidence is not admissible to impeach a witness on a matter that is collateral (ie, irrelevant) to the case. But this rule does not apply here since the supervisor's testimony that the defendant had been entrusted with substantial monies is relevant to the case and would not be used to impeach the supervisor's credibility.

(Choices C & D) The testimony is (1) evidence of the defendant's pertinent character for honesty and (2) relevant to whether he likely took money. But since character is not an essential element of fraud, this trait cannot be proved by a SIC.

Educational objective: A criminal defendant may offer reputation or opinion testimony on his/her good character when that character is (1) an essential element of a crime or defense or (2) otherwise pertinent to the case. But specific instances of conduct may only be used when character is an essential element of a crime or defense.



选项正确率统计：A选项 51%（正确选项），B选项 11%，C选项 20%，D选项 16%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

刑事被告可以提供其良好品格的证据，当该品格特质是：
  • 所指控罪行或所主张抗辩的必要要素——即，该特质必须被证明，被告才会被定罪或抗辩成功 或者
  • 与所指控罪行相关——即，该特质与罪行或抗辩相关，但并非其要素。
声誉和意见证词总是可以被用来证明刑事被告的良好品格。但是特定行为事例 (SICs) 只有在品格是罪行或抗辩的必要要素时才可被使用。这是因为特定行为事例（SICs）有很大风险会对陪审团产生偏见或造成困惑。

在本案中，被告被控欺诈罪——即，明知而作出虚假陈述以诱使他人行动。由于品格不是此项罪行的必要要素，因此，被告前主管就其曾被委托大笔资金的特定事例所作的证词不应被采纳。但由于诚实正直与欺诈罪相关，关于被告诚实声誉的证词则被恰当地采纳了。

(选项 B) 根据附随证据规则，外部证据不可用于就与案件附随（即不相关）的事项弹劾证人。但该规则在此不适用，因为主管关于被告曾被委托大笔资金的证词与本案相关，且并非用于弹劾该主管的可信度。

(选项 C 和 D) 该证词是 (1) 关于被告诚实正直这一相关品格的证据，并且 (2) 与其是否可能拿走钱款相关。但由于品格不是欺诈罪的必要要素，该品格特质不能通过特定行为事例（SIC）来证明。

教学目的：刑事被告可以在其品格是 (1) 罪行或抗辩的必要要素，或 (2) 与案件相关的其他情况下，提供关于其良好品格的声誉或意见证词。但是，特定行为事例仅能在品格是罪行或抗辩的必要要素时使用。

References

  • Fed. R. Evid. 404 (character evidence).
  • Fed. R. Evid. 405 (methods of proving character).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 证据法考点解析

Character Evidence (品格证据)
正确答案：A

不应采纳。因为除非品格是控罪或抗辩的必要要素 (Essential Element)，否则不能通过特定行为事例 (Specific Instances of Conduct) 来证明良好品格。

核心考点：FRE 405 证明方法

在刑事案件中，被告确实可以主动提出关于自己良好品格的证据（这被称为 "Mercy Rule"），但必须遵守严格的证明方法限制。

证明方法 何时允许使用？
声誉 (Reputation)
意见 (Opinion)		 ✔ 总是允许
只要品格证据本身可采。
特定行为 (Specific Acts) ✖ 通常禁止
例外：只有当品格是罪行或抗辩的“必要要素”时才允许。
本案逻辑分析

1. 控罪性质：被告被控欺诈 (Fraud)。

2. 品格是否为必要要素？ 不是。

在欺诈案中，检察官只需证明被告有欺诈行为和意图。被告的“诚实品格”是用来推断他不太可能犯罪（环境证据），而不是罪行本身的构成要件。

3. 结论：由于品格不是必要要素，被告只能使用声誉 (Reputation) 或意见 (Opinion) 证词。

4. 判决：前主管关于“多次受托大笔资金未出事”的证词属于特定行为事例 (Specific Instances)，因此不可采纳。

为什么其他选项是错的？
选项 B (Collateral Matter) 错误：
附随事项规则主要用于限制弹劾 (Impeachment)。这里的证据是用来证明被告无罪的实质性证据，并非附随事项，只是形式（特定行为）不合法。
选项 C & D (Relevance) 错误：
这两个选项都强调证据是“相关”的。虽然证据确实相关 (Relevant)（诚实的人不太可能欺诈），但证据法不仅要求相关，还要求符合形式规则。FRE 405(b) 明确禁止在这种情况下使用特定行为，无论其多么相关。
💡 MBE 提分技巧：
看到品格证据题目，分两步走：
  1. 目的 (Purpose)：是用来证明行为倾向 (Propensity) 还是作为要素 (Element)？
  2. 方法 (Method)：如果是证明倾向（如本案），只能用 R/O (Reputation/Opinion)。绝对不能用特定行为 (Specific Acts)！
*只有在诽谤 (Defamation)、过失委托 (Negligent Entrustment) 或儿童监护权等少数案件中，品格才是“必要要素”。
© MBE Evidence Review | Based on NCBE Standards

questions.question:
At trial in a criminal prosecution for theft, the defendant calls a witness to testify that he formerly knew the defendant as an army supply sergeant and that the defendant had turned down many opportunities for black-marketeering.
Is the witness's testimony admissible?

choices.a: No, because it is irrelevant to the present charge.
choices.b: No, because the defendant may not prove his good character by specific instances of good conduct.
choices.c: Yes, because a criminal defendant may prove his good character as a basis for inferring conduct.
choices.d: Yes, because, by accusing the defendant of being a thief, the prosecution has put his character in issue.

data.questionStem:
Q87806 At trial in a criminal prosecution for theft, the defendant calls a witness to testify that he formerly knew the defendant as an army supply sergeant and that the defendant had turned down many opportunities for black-marketeering.

Is the witness's testimony admissible? 在一场针对盗窃罪的刑事检控审判中，被告传唤一名证人作证，称其以前认识被告时，被告是一名军队补给中士，并且被告曾拒绝过许多从事黑市交易的机会。

该证人的证言是否可采纳？
options:
A. No, because it is irrelevant to the present charge.
不可采纳，因为它与当前的指控无关。

B. No, because the defendant may not prove his good character by specific instances of good conduct.
不可采纳，因为被告不得通过良好行为的具体事例来证明其良好品格。

C. Yes, because a criminal defendant may prove his good character as a basis for inferring conduct.
可采纳，因为刑事被告可以证明其良好品格，作为推断其行为的基础。

D. Yes, because, by accusing the defendant of being a thief, the prosecution has put his character in issue.
可采纳，因为通过指控被告是小偷，检方已将其品格置于争议之中。
data.explanation:
A criminal defendant may present evidence of a pertinent character trait—ie, a trait that is relevant to the charged crime—so that the jury can infer that the defendant acted in conformity with that trait on the occasion at issue (Choice C). And since honesty is pertinent to theft (a crime of dishonesty), the defendant can provide evidence of this good-character trait (Choice A). But he can only do so with reputation or opinion testimony—not a specific instance of conduct (eg, turning down opportunities for black-marketeering).

(Choice D) A person's character is "in issue" when that character is an essential element of a civil claim, criminal charge, or asserted defense. In these rare instances (none of which apply here), that character may be proved by specific instances of conduct.

Educational objective: A criminal defendant may present reputation or opinion testimony—but not a specific instance of conduct—regarding his/her good character if that character trait is pertinent to the charged crime.



刑事被告可以就某一相关品格特质——即与被指控罪行相关的特质——提出证据，以便陪审团可以推断被告在争议事件中的行为与该特质相符（选项C）。并且，由于诚实与盗窃（一种不诚实的犯罪）相关，被告可以提供这种良好品格特质的证据（这与选项A的理由相悖）。但他只能通过关于名誉或意见的证言来这样做——而不是通过具体的行为事例（例如，拒绝从事黑市交易的机会）。

（选项D）当一个人的品格是民事索赔、刑事指控或所主张的抗辩中的一个基本要素时，该品格即“处于争议之中”。在这些罕见的情况下（此处均不适用），该品格可以通过具体的行为事例来证明。

教学目标： 如果品格特质与被指控的罪行相关，刑事被告可以就其良好品格提出关于名誉或意见的证言——但不能是关于具体行为的证言。

References
Fed. R. Evid. 404 (character evidence).
Fed. R. Evid. 405 (methods of proving character).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析：品格证据

本题考察的是美国联邦证据规则（Federal Rules of Evidence, FRE）中关于刑事被告如何证明自己良好品格的具体规则。

正确答案：B
不可采纳，因为被告不得通过良好行为的具体事例（Specific Instances of Conduct）来证明其良好品格。

1. 核心法律规则 (The Rules)

要解决这个问题，必须区分“目的”（Purpose）和“方法”（Method）。

FRE 404(a) 目的：允许
刑事被告可以主动提出关于自己“相关品格特质”（Pertinent Trait）的证据，以证明自己在案发时的行为与该品格相符。这被称为“宽恕规则”（Mercy Rule）。
在本案中，被告被控盗窃（Theft），诚实（Honesty）是相关特质，因此目的是合法的。

FRE 405(a) 方法：限制
虽然被告可以证明良好品格，但只能通过以下两种形式：

  • 名誉证言 (Reputation)：例如“他在社区里名声很好”。
  • 意见证言 (Opinion)：例如“我认为他是个诚实的人”。
注意： 在直接询问（Direct Examination）中，严禁使用具体行为事例（Specific Instances of Conduct）。

2. 案情分析 (Application)

在本题中：

  • 证人证言： “被告曾拒绝过许多从事黑市交易的机会。”
  • 性质： 这是一个具体的行为事例（Specific Instance）。
  • 结论： 虽然目的是为了证明被告诚实（允许），但使用的证明方法（具体事例）违反了 FRE 405(a)。

3. 为什么其他选项是错误的？

选项 分析
A (无关) 错误。 诚实与盗窃罪绝对相关（Relevant）。错误不在于相关性，而在于证明形式。
C (允许推断) 错误。 虽然前半句法律原理正确（被告可以证明品格），但结论错误。因为本题中的证据形式是“具体事例”，所以不可采纳。
D (品格处于争议) 错误。 这是一个常见的陷阱。“Character in Issue”仅指品格是罪行或抗辩的基本要素（Essential Element）时（如诽谤案中的真相抗辩、疏忽雇佣案）。在盗窃案中，品格只是旁证，并非要素。

4. 考试技巧 (Exam Tip)

MBE 策略
当看到品格证据（Character Evidence）题目时，请按以下步骤思考：
  1. 民事还是刑事？ (本题是刑事)
  2. 谁提出的？ (本题是被告)
  3. 目的是什么？ (证明行为倾向 Propensity)
  4. 方法是什么？ (本题是具体事例 Specific Acts) -> STOP!
记住口诀："RO yes, SA no" (Reputation/Opinion 可以，Specific Acts 不行)，除非品格本身是案件的要素（Character in Issue）。

questions.question:
A man has sued a police officer, alleging that the officer violated the man's civil rights by using excessive force while arresting him. At trial, the officer admits having hit the man in the head with the butt of his gun but contends that the force was necessary, because the man was resisting arrest. In support of his contention, the officer seeks to introduce evidence that the man had resisted arrest on three prior occasions during the last 10 years.
Is this testimony regarding the man's conduct during the three prior arrests admissible?

choices.a: No, because evidence of the prior incidents constitutes impermissible character evidence.
choices.b: No, because the officer has not shown that the man was convicted in connection with the prior incidents.
choices.c: Yes, because the incidents in question are relevant evidence of the man's propensity for violence.
choices.d: Yes, because the incidents in question are sufficient to constitute a habit.

Q87826 A man has sued a police officer, alleging that the officer violated the man's civil rights by using excessive force while arresting him. At trial, the officer admits having hit the man in the head with the butt of his gun but contends that the force was necessary, because the man was resisting arrest. In support of his contention, the officer seeks to introduce evidence that the man had resisted arrest on three prior occasions during the last 10 years.

Is this testimony regarding the man's conduct during the three prior arrests admissible? 一名男子起诉一名警官，指控该警官在逮捕他时使用过度武力，侵犯了他的民权。在审判中，该警官承认用枪托击打了该男子的头部，但辩称该武力是必要的，因为该男子当时正在拒捕。为支持其论点，该警官试图引入证据，证明该男子在过去10年中有过三次拒捕的前科。

关于该男子三次前科中行为的证词是否可以采纳？
options:
A. No, because evidence of the prior incidents constitutes impermissible character evidence.
不可以，因为关于先前事件的证据构成了不允许采纳的品格证据。

B. No, because the officer has not shown that the man was convicted in connection with the prior incidents.
不可以，因为该警官未能证明该男子因先前的事件而被定罪。

C. Yes, because the incidents in question are relevant evidence of the man's propensity for violence.
可以，因为所涉事件是证明该男子有暴力倾向的相关证据。

D. Yes, because the incidents in question are sufficient to constitute a habit.
可以，因为所涉事件足以构成一种习惯。

Admissibility of previous criminal conviction or bad act
(FRE 404, 608 & 609)


Impeach witness's
character
(FRE 608(b), 609)		Impeach witness with either:

conviction for crime of dishonesty or any felony through examination & extrinsic evidence or
bad act (no conviction) elicited only on examination
Relevant noncharacter
purpose
(FRE 404(b))		Examination & extrinsic evidence to show MIMIC:

Motive/opportunity
Intent
Mistake (absence of)
Identity
Common scheme/plan
FRE = Federal Rules of Evidence

Character evidence is evidence of a person's general traits or propensities. Such evidence is generally inadmissible when used to prove that a person acted in conformity with a particular trait or propensity on the occasion at issue. That is because of the risk that a jury could punish a person for his/her bad character instead of what actually happened. Therefore, evidence of a person's previous crimes or other acts can only be used for impeachment or noncharacter purposes.

Here, the officer seeks to testify that the man had resisted arrest on three prior occasions. This testimony would support the officer's contention that the man resisted arrest on the occasion leading to this lawsuit because he has a propensity for doing so. As a result, this testimony constitutes character evidence and is not admissible.

(Choice B) The man's prior incidents cannot be used to prove that he resisted arrest on the occasion in question—regardless of whether the officer shows that those incidents resulted in convictions. But proof of a criminal conviction may have been necessary had the man testified and the officer introduced the man's prior incidents for impeachment purposes.

(Choice C) The prior incidents of resisting arrest are relevant since they tend to make it more probable that the man resisted arrest in this instance. But relevant evidence can still be excluded by a constitutional provision, law, or rule—eg, the rule prohibiting the use of character evidence.

(Choice D) Evidence of a person's habit is admissible to prove that the person acted in accordance with that habit on a particular occasion. Habit differs from character in that it focuses on a person's regular response to a repeated specific situation (eg, regularly using a turn signal) instead of a general trait (eg, carefulness). And since the man's three prior incidents do not prove that he regularly resists arrest, they do not constitute a habit.

先前刑事定罪或不当行为的可采纳性
(《联邦证据规则》第404、608和609条)


弹劾证人的
品格
(《联邦证据规则》第608(b)、609条)		通过以下任一方式弹劾证人：

通过询问和外部证据证明其犯有不诚实罪或任何重罪的定罪或
仅在询问中引出的不当行为（无定罪）
相关的非品格
目的
(《联邦证据规则》第404(b)条)		通过询问和外部证据以证明MIMIC：

动机/机会 (Motive/opportunity)
意图 (Intent)
无过失 (Mistake (absence of))
身份 (Identity)
共同的计划/方案 (Common scheme/plan)
《联邦证据规则》 = Federal Rules of Evidence

品格证据是关于一个人普遍特质或倾向的证据。当用于证明某人在特定场合的行为与其特定特质或倾向相符时，此类证据通常不可采纳。这是因为存在陪审团可能因某人的不良品格而非实际发生的事情来惩罚他的风险。因此，关于某人先前罪行或其他行为的证据只能用于弹劾或非品格目的。

在本案中，该警官试图作证证明该男子曾有过三次拒捕的前科。该证词会支持警官的论点，即该男子在此次诉讼所涉的场合中拒捕了，因为他有这样做的倾向。因此，该证词构成品格证据，是不可采纳的。

(选项B) 该男子先前事件不能用来证明他在本案所涉场合中拒捕——无论警官是否能证明这些事件导致了定罪。但是，如果该男子作证，而警官为了弹劾目的引入该男子先前事件的证据，那么刑事定罪的证明就可能是必要的。

(选项C) 先前的拒捕事件是相关的，因为它们倾向于使该男子在本案中拒捕的可能性更大。但是，相关证据仍然可能因宪法条款、法律或规则而被排除——例如，禁止使用品格证据的规则。

(选项D) 一个人的习惯证据可以被采纳，用以证明该人在特定场合的行为与该习惯相符。习惯与品格不同，习惯关注的是一个人对重复特定情况的常规反应（例如，经常打转向灯），而不是一个普遍的特质（例如，谨慎）。并且，由于该男子的三次先前事件并不能证明他经常性地拒捕，因此这些事件不构成习惯。

Educational objective:

Prior crimes and other acts cannot be used to prove a person's character—ie, one's propensity to behave in a certain manner.

References

Fed. R. Evid. 404(b) (crimes, wrongs, or other acts).

MBE 考点解析

Evidence: Character vs. Habit

✅ 正确答案：A

证据不可采纳。因为这是被禁止的品格证据 (Character Evidence)，用于证明被告在特定场合的行为符合其过去的性格倾向。

⚖️ 核心规则：FRE 404(b)

根据《联邦证据规则》(Federal Rules of Evidence, FRE) 第 404(b) 条：

一般规则：关于某人过去的罪行、过错或其他行为 (Crimes, wrongs, or other acts) 的证据，不可采纳用于证明该人的品格，以推断其在特定场合的行为符合该品格（即禁止 Propensity Evidence）。

本案应用：警官试图引入该男子过去 10 年中 3 次拒捕的证据，逻辑是：“他以前拒捕过，说明他有拒捕的倾向，所以这次他也拒捕了。” 这正是法律所禁止的推论。

🔍 考点辨析：品格 (Character) vs. 习惯 (Habit)

考生最容易混淆的是选项 D（习惯）。为什么“10年内3次”不构成习惯？

维度 品格 (Character) 习惯 (Habit) - FRE 406
定义 一般的性格特质
(General disposition)		 对特定情况的常规反应
(Regular response)
关键词 "Violence", "Honesty" "Always", "Invariably", "Automatically"
频率 不一定频繁 高度频繁且具体
本案 拒捕倾向 (不可采纳) 10年才3次 $\neq$ 习惯 (选项D错误)
❌ 为什么其他选项错误？
  • 选项 B (Conviction)： 错误。FRE 404(b) 适用于“其他行为 (other acts)”，并不要求必须有刑事定罪 (Conviction)。即使没有定罪，作为品格证据也是不可采纳的。
  • 选项 C (Relevance)： 错误。虽然证据可能具有相关性 (Relevant)，即让事实更有可能发生，但相关性不能凌驾于排除规则之上。如果证据违反了品格证据禁令 (FRE 404)，即使相关也不可采纳。
💡 MBE 解题技巧

在民事案件 (Civil Case) 中，品格证据通常是不可采纳的，除非：

  1. 品格本身是案件的实质争议点 (Character is directly in issue)，例如诽谤案 (Defamation) 或过失雇佣 (Negligent Hiring)。
  2. 用于非品格目的 (MIMIC: Motive, Intent, etc.)。
  3. 用于弹劾证人 (Impeachment)。

本题中，警官试图用它来证明行为 (Conduct)，而非上述例外情况，因此必选 "Inadmissible"。

A defendant who is a doctor has been charged with sexual assault for allegedly touching a patient inappropriately during a routine examination. The defendant pleaded not guilty and denied that any inappropriate conduct occurred during the patient's examination. At trial, the prosecutor seeks to show the defendant's propensity to commit sexual assault. The prosecutor has therefore called three of the defendant's other patients to testify that the defendant touched them inappropriately during routine examinations.
Should the testimony be admitted?

choices.a: No, because character must be proved by reputation or opinion testimony.
choices.b: No, because evidence of a prior crime or bad act is inadmissible to prove propensity.
choices.c: Yes, because the defendant has been charged with sexual assault.
choices.d: Yes, provided that the court finds beyond a reasonable doubt that the other incidents occurred.

A defendant who is a doctor has been charged with sexual assault for allegedly touching a patient inappropriately during a routine examination. The defendant pleaded not guilty and denied that any inappropriate conduct occurred during the patient's examination. At trial, the prosecutor seeks to show the defendant's propensity to commit sexual assault. The prosecutor has therefore called three of the defendant's other patients to testify that the defendant touched them inappropriately during routine examinations.

Should the testimony be admitted?

一名医生被告被指控犯有性侵犯罪，因其据称在一次常规检查中不当触摸一名患者。该被告作无罪辩护，并否认在患者的检查过程中发生任何不当行为。在审判中，检察官试图证明被告有实施性侵犯的倾向。因此，检察官传唤了被告的另外三名患者出庭作证，指证被告曾在常规检查中不当触摸过她们。

该证词是否应被采纳？
options:
A. No, because character must be proved by reputation or opinion testimony.
不应采纳，因为品格必须通过声誉或意见证词来证明。

B. No, because evidence of a prior crime or bad act is inadmissible to prove propensity.
不应采纳，因为先前的犯罪或不当行为的证据不可被采纳用于证明倾向。

C. Yes, because the defendant has been charged with sexual assault.
应采纳，因为被告被指控犯有性侵犯罪。

D. Yes, provided that the court finds beyond a reasonable doubt that the other incidents occurred.
应采纳，前提是法庭在排除合理怀疑（beyond a reasonable doubt）的情况下认定其他事件确有发生。
data.explanation:
Evidence of a crime, wrong, or other act is generally not admissible to prove a person's character by showing that the person acted in accordance with that character on the occasion being ligated. This ban on character evidence stems from concerns that a jury would give too much weight to this evidence and judge a person based on his/her bad record as opposed to the case at hand.

However, the Federal Rules of Evidence provide an exception for criminal and civil cases involving sexual assault or child molestation. In such cases, evidence that the accused committed any other sexual assault or child molestation is admissible for any relevant purpose - even to show the accused's propensity to commit the charged assault or molestation (Choice B). Therefore, the testimony by the defendant's other patients should be admitted.

(Choice A) Character must generally be proved by reputation or opinion testimony. But when a party seeks to prove a defendant's propensity to commit sexual assault or child molestation, character can also be proved by introducing specific instances of conduct (eg, prior sexual assaults).†

(Choice D) The testimony regarding the other incidents is admissible if there is sufficient evidence for a reasonable jury to find that the incidents occurred by a preponderance of the evidence - a lower standard than beyond a reasonable doubt.

†Specific instances of conduct are also admissible when character is an essential element of the claim, charge, or defense.

Educational objective: In criminal and civil cases involving sexual assault or child molestation, evidence that the accused committed any other sexual assault or child molestation is admissible for any relevant purpose - even to show the accused's propensity to commit the charged assault or molestation.



选项正确率统计：A选项 6%，B选项 26%，C选项 62%（正确选项），D选项 4%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

关于犯罪、过错或其他行为的证据，通常不可采纳用以证明一个人的品格，即证明该人在诉讼所涉场合的行为与该品格相符。这项对品格证据的禁令源于一种担忧，即陪审团可能会过分看重此类证据，并基于被告的不良记录而非当前案件本身来对其进行评判。

然而，《联邦证据规则》(Federal Rules of Evidence) 对涉及性侵犯或猥亵儿童的刑事和民事案件规定了一项例外。在此类案件中，证明被告曾实施任何其他性侵犯或猥亵儿童行为的证据，是可采纳的，可用于任何相关目的——即使是为了证明被告有实施被指控的侵犯或猥亵行为的倾向 （选项 B）。因此，被告其他患者的证词应当被采纳。

（选项 A） 品格通常必须通过声誉或意见证词来证明。但当一方当事人试图证明被告有实施性侵犯或猥亵儿童的倾向时，品格也可以通过引入具体行为实例（例如，先前的性侵犯行为）来证明。†

（选项 D） 关于其他事件的证词是可采纳的，前提是有足够证据能让一个理性的陪审团以优势证据标准（preponderance of the evidence）认定这些事件确有发生——这是一个比排除合理怀疑（beyond a reasonable doubt）更低的标准。

†当品格是诉讼请求、指控或抗辩的关键要素时，具体行为实例也是可采纳的。

教学目标：在涉及性侵犯或猥亵儿童的刑事和民事案件中，证明被告曾实施任何其他性侵犯或猥亵儿童行为的证据，可为任何相关目的而被采纳——即使是为了证明被告有实施被指控的侵犯或猥亵行为的倾向。

References

Fed. R. Evid. 413 - 15 (similar acts in criminal and civil cases involving sexual assault or child molestation).

MBE 考点解析：性侵案件中的品格证据

本题考察的是美国联邦证据规则（Federal Rules of Evidence, FRE）中关于性侵犯案件的一个重要例外规则。

1. 核心考点：FRE 413 规则

一般规则 (FRE 404)：
通常情况下，先前的犯罪或不当行为（Prior Bad Acts）不可用于证明被告具有某种性格倾向（Propensity），从而推断其在本次案件中也实施了该行为。

例外规则 (FRE 413)：
在刑事案件中，如果被告被指控性侵犯 (Sexual Assault)，关于被告实施过任何其他性侵犯的证据是可以被采纳的（Admissible），并且可以用于任何相关目的，包括证明被告具有实施性侵的倾向 (Propensity)。

2. 题目解析

在本案中：

  • 指控：医生被告被指控性侵犯（不当触摸患者）。
  • 证据：检察官希望引入另外三名患者的证词，证明被告曾对她们进行过类似的不当触摸。
  • 目的：证明被告有实施性侵犯的倾向（Propensity）。

根据 FRE 413，因为这是性侵犯案件，检察官可以引入先前的具体性侵行为来证明被告的性格倾向。这直接推翻了通常禁止使用“倾向性证据”的一般原则。

因此，正确答案是 C。

3. 为什么其他选项是错误的？

⚠️ 易错点分析 (选项 D)
选项 D 错误地陈述了证明标准。

虽然先前的行为必须被证明确实发生过，但法庭不需要在“排除合理怀疑 (Beyond a reasonable doubt)” 的标准下认定其发生。

正确标准：只要有足够的证据支持陪审团认定该行为发生即可（类似于优势证据标准 Preponderance of the evidence）。这是由 Huddleston v. United States 判例确立的原则。
  • 选项 A 错误： 虽然通常品格证据限于声誉（Reputation）或意见（Opinion），但在 FRE 413-415（性侵/猥亵儿童）例外下，允许使用具体行为实例 (Specific Instances of Conduct)。
  • 选项 B 错误： 这是 FRE 404(b) 的一般规则，但不适用于性侵犯案件的例外情况。

4. 考试技巧 (Exam Tip)

在 MBE 考试遇到 Character Evidence（品格证据）题目时，请按以下步骤思考：

  1. 这是刑事案件还是民事案件？
  2. 证据是用来证明倾向性（Propensity）的吗？
  3. 关键判断：案件是否涉及 性侵犯 (Sexual Assault) 或 猥亵儿童 (Child Molestation)？

如果是第 3 点的情况，大胆选择“可以采纳 (Admissible)”，因为 FRE 413-415 为此类案件打开了引入先前不良行为的大门。

questions.question:
A plaintiff sued a defendant for civil battery. At trial, the defendant testified that he was nowhere near the plaintiff when the plaintiff sustained the injuries at issue. The defendant now seeks to call a witness to testify to the defendant's reputation for both peacefulness and truthfulness. The plaintiff has objected to the testimony.
How should the court proceed?

choices.a: Admit the testimony in its entirety, because evidence concerning a defendant's character is always admissible.
choices.b: Admit the testimony regarding the defendant's reputation for peacefulness, but exclude the testimony regarding his reputation for truthfulness.
choices.c: Exclude the testimony regarding the defendant's reputation for peacefulness, but admit the testimony regarding his reputation for truthfulness.
choices.d: Exclude the testimony in its entirety, because this is a civil suit and the defendant's character for truthfulness was not attacked.

questions.question:
A company sued the defendant, its former vice president, for return of $230,000 that had been embezzled during the previous two years. Called by the company as an adverse witness, the defendant testified that his annual salary had been $75,000, and he denied the embezzlement.
The company calls a banker as a witness to show that, during the two-year period, the defendant had deposited $250,000 in his bank account.
Is the banker's testimony admissible?

choices.a: No, because its prejudicial effect substantially outweighs its probative value.
choices.b: No, because the deposits could have come from legitimate sources.
choices.c: Yes, as circumstantial evidence of the defendant's guilt.
choices.d: Yes, to impeach the defendant.

data.questionStem:
Q87166

A company sued the defendant, its former vice president, for return of $230,000 that had been embezzled during the previous two years. Called by the company as an adverse witness, the defendant testified that his annual salary had been $75,000, and he denied the embezzlement.

The company calls a banker as a witness to show that, during the two-year period, the defendant had deposited $250,000 in his bank account.

Is the banker's testimony admissible?

一家公司起诉其前副总裁，即本案被告，要求其归还在过去两年中侵占的23万美元。作为公司传唤的敌意证人，被告作证称其年薪为7.5万美元，并否认了侵占行为。

公司传唤一名银行家作为证人，以证明在该两年期间，被告在其银行账户中存入了25万美元。

该银行家的证词是否可以采纳？
options:
A. No, because its prejudicial effect substantially outweighs its probative value.
不可以，因为其偏见性影响实质上超过了其证明价值。

B. No, because the deposits could have come from legitimate sources.
不可以，因为这些存款可能来自合法来源。

C. Yes, as circumstantial evidence of the defendant's guilt.
可以，作为被告存在过错的间接证据。

D. Yes, to impeach the defendant.
可以，用以弹劾被告的可信度。
data.explanation:
Evidence is relevant if:
  • it has any tendency to make a fact more or less probable than it would be without that evidence (ie, probative ) and
  • the fact is of consequence to the outcome of the case (ie, material ).
Here, the plaintiff offers the banker's testimony that the defendant deposited $250,000 in his bank account over a two-year period - an amount well above his $75,000 annual salary. This testimony is circumstantial evidence that the defendant took another's money, which is a material fact in this embezzlement case. Therefore, the banker's testimony is relevant.

Relevant evidence is admissible unless otherwise excluded by law or other rules. One example is Federal Rule of Evidence 403, which excludes relevant evidence if its prejudicial effect substantially outweighs its probative value. Testimony about the defendant's deposits is not unfairly prejudicial because it does not tend to encourage the jury to decide the case on improper grounds (Choice A). And since no other ground for exclusion has been raised, the testimony is admissible as circumstantial evidence of the defendant's guilt.

(Choice B) Whether the defendant's deposits could have come from legitimate sources may affect the strength or probative value that the jury assigns to the banker's testimony. But it does not make this testimony inadmissible, because evidence is relevant if it has even the slightest tendency to make a material fact more or less probable.

(Choice D) One method of impeachment is to specifically contradict the witness's testimony. But testimony that the defendant deposited $250,000 in his bank account does not directly contradict the defendant's testimony that he made $75,000 a year and did not embezzle money.

Educational objective: Evidence is relevant if it has any tendency to make a material fact more or less probable than it would be without that evidence. Relevant evidence is admissible unless otherwise provided by law or other rules - eg, when its prejudicial effect substantially outweighs its probative value.



选项正确率统计：A选项 12%，B选项 4%，C选项 56%（正确选项），D选项 25%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

证据具有相关性(relevant)，如果：
  • 它具有任何使某一事实比没有该证据时更可能或更不可能的倾向（即，有证明价值的/probative）并且
  • 该事实对案件的结果具有重要性（即，关键的/material）。
在本案中，原告提供了银行家的证词，证明被告在两年期间向其银行账户存入了25万美元——这一数额远高于其7.5万美元的年薪。该证词是被告拿走他人钱款的间接证据，而这在本侵占案中是一个关键事实。因此，该银行家的证词具有相关性。

相关证据是可采纳的(admissible)，除非法律或其他规则另有排除。一个例子是《联邦证据规则》第403条(Federal Rule of Evidence 403)，该条规定，如果相关证据的偏见性影响实质上超过(prejudicial effect substantially outweighs)其证明价值(probative value)，则该证据应被排除。关于被告存款的证词并没有不公平的偏见性，因为它不会倾向于鼓励陪审团基于不当理由来裁决案件（选项A）。并且，由于没有提出其他排除的理由，该证词作为被告存在过错的间接证据是可采纳的。

（选项B）被告的存款是否可能来自合法来源，可能会影响陪审团对银行家证词所赋予的证明力或证明价值。但这并不使该证词不可采纳，因为只要证据具有哪怕最轻微的倾向，能使一个关键事实变得更可能或更不可能，该证据就具有相关性。

（选项D）弹劾证人可信度(impeachment)的一种方法是具体反驳该证人的证词。但是，关于被告在其银行账户存入25万美元的证词，并没有直接反驳被告关于其年薪7.5万美元且未侵占钱款的证词。

教学目标：如果证据具有任何使某一关键事实比没有该证据时更可能或更不可能的倾向，则该证据具有相关性。相关证据是可采纳的，除非法律或其他规则另有规定——例如，当其偏见性影响实质上超过其证明价值时。

References

  • Fed. R. Evid. 401 (test for relevance).
  • Fed. R. Evid. 403 (exclusion of relevant evidence for certain dangers).

MBE 考点解析

Evidence: Relevancy & Circumstantial Evidence

1. 核心考点：相关性的低门槛

本题考察的是《联邦证据规则》第401条（FRE 401）关于相关性（Relevancy）的定义。

规则要点：
证据只要有任何倾向（Any Tendency）使一个对案件结果有影响的事实（Material Fact）变得更可能或更不可能，它就是相关的。

在本案中：

  • 已知事实：被告年薪 $75,000（两年共 $150,000）。
  • 争议事实：被告是否侵占了公司 $230,000。
  • 新证据：被告两年内存入了 $250,000。

逻辑推演： 存入金额远超其合法收入（$250k > $150k），这多出来的钱从哪来？这种“不明来源的财富”增加了他侵占公款的可能性。因此，这是证明被告有罪的间接证据（Circumstantial Evidence）。

✔ 结论： 选项 C 正确。

2. 常见陷阱：证明力 vs. 可采性

很多考生会误选 选项 B（存款可能来自合法来源）。这是 MBE 中最经典的干扰项逻辑。

错误原因分析：

  • Weight（证明力）： 陪审团相信这个证据的程度。被告完全可以辩解说“我中了彩票”或“这是遗产”。
  • Admissibility（可采性）： 法官决定证据是否能进法庭。
MBE 黄金法则：
不要因为证据存在“无辜的解释”就认为它不可采纳。只要它能稍微增加一点嫌疑，它就是相关的。解释工作留给被告在交叉询问或辩护时去做，而不是在证据准入阶段将其排除。

3. 其他选项排除法

✘ 选项 A (FRE 403 偏见性)：

所有指控被告有罪的证据都有“偏见性”（Prejudicial）。只有当不公平的偏见（Unfair Prejudice）实质上超过证明价值时才会被排除。本案中，银行流水是客观数据，虽然对被告不利，但并不构成煽动情绪的“不公平”偏见。

✘ 选项 D (Impeachment 弹劾)：

弹劾通常用于攻击证人的可信度。虽然这确实让被告看起来不可信，但该证据的主要功能是作为实体证据（Substantive Evidence）来证明侵占事实，而不仅仅是为了反驳他说“我年薪7.5万”这句话（因为存入25万并不直接逻辑矛盾于年薪7.5万，他可能有其他收入）。选项 C 比 D 更准确地描述了证据的核心用途。

💡 备考小贴士：
在 Evidence 题目中，如果问“是否可采纳”，首先判断是否 Relevant。门槛极低（"A brick is not a wall" —— 一块砖虽不能建成墙，但它是墙的一部分）。不要混淆“证据不足以定罪”和“证据不可采纳”。

questions.question:
A driver sued her insurance company on an accident insurance policy covering personal injuries to the driver. The insurance company defended on the ground that the driver's injuries were intentionally self-inflicted and therefore excluded from the policy's coverage.
The driver testified at trial that she had inflicted the injuries, as her negligence had caused the crash in which she was injured, but that she had not done so intentionally. She then called as a witness her treating psychiatrist to give his opinion that the driver had been mentally unbalanced, but not self-destructive, at the time of the crash.
Should the court admit the witness's opinion?

choices.a: No, because it is a statement about the driver's credibility.
choices.b: No, because it is an opinion about a mental state that constitutes an element of the defense.
choices.c: No, because the witness did not first state the basis for his opinion.
choices.d: Yes, because it is a helpful opinion by a qualified expert.

data.questionStem:
Q87227

A driver sued her insurance company on an accident insurance policy covering personal injuries to the driver. The insurance company defended on the ground that the driver's injuries were intentionally self-inflicted and therefore excluded from the policy's coverage.

The driver testified at trial that she had inflicted the injuries, as her negligence had caused the crash in which she was injured, but that she had not done so intentionally. She then called as a witness her treating psychiatrist to give his opinion that the driver had been mentally unbalanced, but not self-destructive, at the time of the crash.

Should the court admit the witness's opinion?

一名驾驶员依据一份涵盖其人身伤害的意外保险合同，起诉了她的保险公司。保险公司以驾驶员的伤害是故意自我造成，因此不属于保单承保范围为由进行抗辩。

驾驶员在庭审中作证称，她确实造成了这些伤害，因为是她的过失导致了她受伤的撞车事故，但她并非故意为之。随后，她传唤了为她治疗的精神科医生作为证人，就其在撞车事故发生时精神失衡但无自毁倾向发表意见。

法院是否应采纳该证人的意见？
options:
A. No, because it is a statement about the driver's credibility.
不应采纳，因为这是一项关于驾驶员可信度的陈述。

B. No, because it is an opinion about a mental state that constitutes an element of the defense.
不应采纳，因为这是一项关于构成抗辩要素的心理状态的意见。

C. No, because the witness did not first state the basis for his opinion.
不应采纳，因为证人未首先陈述其意见所依据的基础。

D. Yes, because it is a helpful opinion by a qualified expert.
应当采纳，因为这是一项由具备资格的专家提供的有帮助的意见。
data.explanation:
A qualified expert witness is one with specialized knowledge, skill, experience, training, or education on a subject that pertains to an issue being litigated. To be admissible, the expert's testimony must be both:
  • relevant - the testimony will help the trier of fact (1) understand the evidence OR (2) determine a fact in issue and
  • reliable - the testimony is (1) based on sufficient facts or data AND (2) the product of reliable principles and methods that the expert has reliably applied to the facts of the case.
Here, it can be presumed that the witness, as the driver's treating psychiatrist, has specialized knowledge pertinent to the driver's mental state at the time of the crash that was reliably applied to the facts of the case. His opinion that the driver had been mentally unbalanced but not self- destructive is relevant because it will help the jury determine whether her injuries were intentionally self-inflicted. Therefore, the court should admit this testimony.

(Choice A) The witness is offering to testify to the driver's pertinent mental state - not the driver's credibility. If the witness were to do so, the testimony would be inadmissible because credibility is a question for the jury to decide.

(Choice B) An expert may not state an opinion about whether a criminal defendant had the requisite mental state for any element of a charged crime or asserted defense. But all other expert testimony on a party's mental state - including the witness's proffered testimony here - is admissible.

(Choice C) An expert may state an opinion without first testifying to the underlying facts or data. But the expert may be required to disclose the basis for that opinion on cross-examination.

Educational objective: A qualified expert's testimony is admissible if it (1) will help the trier of fact understand the evidence OR determine a fact in issue and (2) is based on sufficient facts or data AND the product of reliable principles and methods that the expert has reliably applied to the facts of the case.



选项正确率统计：A选项 2%，B选项 36%，C选项 6%，D选项 55%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

具备资格的专家证人是指在与诉讼争议问题相关的某一主题上拥有专业知识、技能、经验、培训或教育的人。为使其证言可被采纳，专家的证言必须同时满足：
  • 具有相关性 - 该证言将有助于事实审理者 (1) 理解证据 或 (2) 确定争议事实 并且
  • 具有可靠性 - 该证言 (1) 基于充分的事实或数据，并且 (2) 是专家将可靠的原则和方法可靠地应用于案件事实的产物。
在本案中，可以推定，该证人作为驾驶员的主治精神科医生，拥有与驾驶员在撞车事故时的精神状态相关的专业知识，并且已将该知识可靠地应用于案件事实。他关于驾驶员当时精神失衡但无自毁倾向的意见具有相关性，因为它将帮助陪审团确定其伤害是否为故意自我造成。因此，法院应采纳此证言。

（选项A）证人提供的是关于驾驶员相关精神状态的证言，而非关于驾驶员的可信度。如果证人作证涉及可信度，则该证言将不可被采纳，因为可信度是由陪审团决定的问题。

（选项B）专家不得就刑事被告是否具备被指控罪行或所主张抗辩的任何要素所需的精神状态发表意见。但是，所有其他关于一方当事人精神状态的专家证言——包括本案中证人提供的证言——都是可以采纳的。

（选项C）专家可以先发表意见，而无需首先就其所依据的事实或数据作证。但专家可能被要求在交叉询问中披露该意见的基础。

教学目标：具备资格的专家的证言在以下情况下是可采纳的：(1) 有助于事实审理者理解证据或确定争议事实，并且 (2) 基于充分的事实或数据，并且是专家将可靠的原则和方法可靠地应用于案件事实的产物。

References

Fed. R. Evid. 702 (expert testimony).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Evidence / Expert Testimony
正确答案：D 法院应当采纳该意见，因为这是由具备资格的专家提供的、有助于事实认定的意见。

本题的核心考点在于专家证言的可采性 (Admissibility of Expert Testimony) 以及关于“最终争议点” (Ultimate Issue) 的规则适用范围。

核心法律依据 (FRE 702 & 704)
1. 专家证言的基本要求 (FRE 702)
专家证言若要被采纳，必须满足以下条件：
  • 专家具备资格（知识、技能、经验等）；
  • 证言具有相关性 (Relevance)，即能帮助陪审团理解证据或确定事实；
  • 证言基于充分的事实和可靠的方法。

在本案中，精神科医生作为治疗医生，具备专业资格，且其关于驾驶员“是否有自毁倾向”的意见直接关系到案件的核心争议（是否故意自伤），因此具有高度相关性。

2. 关键区分：民事 vs. 刑事 (FRE 704)
这是本题最大的陷阱。

一般规则 (FRE 704(a))：
专家意见即使触及了案件的最终争议点 (Ultimate Issue)，通常也是可采纳的。

例外规则 (FRE 704(b)) - 仅限刑事案件：
只有在刑事案件 (Criminal Case) 中，专家才被禁止就被告是否具备犯罪要素中的特定心理状态 (Mental State) 发表明确意见。

本案是保险合同纠纷，属于民事案件 (Civil Case)。因此，FRE 704(b) 的限制不适用。专家完全可以直接就驾驶员当时的心理状态（是否想自杀）发表意见。
为什么其他选项是错误的？
选项 A 错误 (Credibility)
虽然专家通常不能直接评价证人是否“诚实”（因为这是陪审团的工作），但本案中专家并非在评价驾驶员是否在撒谎，而是在诊断其案发时的精神状态（是否具有自毁倾向）。这是医学诊断，而非可信度评价。
选项 B 错误 (Element of Defense)
这是最具迷惑性的干扰项。它描述了 FRE 704(b) 的规则，但该规则仅适用于刑事案件。在民事案件中，专家可以就构成抗辩要素的心理状态发表意见。
选项 C 错误 (Basis of Opinion)
根据 FRE 705，专家可以在庭审中先给出意见，而无需先披露其依据的事实或数据（除非法庭另有要求）。对方律师可以在交叉询问 (Cross-examination) 中盘问其依据。
💡 MBE 考试技巧

遇到关于专家证言 (Expert Testimony) 和心理状态 (Mental State) 的题目时，第一步必须确认案件性质：

  • 如果是刑事案件 ➡️ 专家不能直接说“被告当时有/没有杀人意图”。
  • 如果是民事案件 ➡️ 专家可以就心理状态发表意见（只要符合 FRE 702 的要求）。

出题人非常喜欢利用考生对 FRE 704(b) 的模糊记忆，在民事题目中设置类似选项 B 的陷阱。

questions.question:
A plaintiff sued her employer, alleging that poor working conditions had caused her to develop a stomach ulcer. At trial, the plaintiff's medical expert testified to the cause of the plaintiff's ulcer and stated that his opinion was based in part on information in a letter the plaintiff's personal doctor had written to the plaintiff's employer, explaining why the plaintiff had missed work. The plaintiff offered the doctor's letter to prove the cause of her condition.
Is the letter admissible?

choices.a: No, because it is hearsay not within any exception.
choices.b: No, because the plaintiff's doctor is not shown to be unavailable.
choices.c: Yes, because it was relied upon by the plaintiff's medical expert.
choices.d: Yes, under the business records exception to the hearsay rule.

data.questionStem:
Q87048

A plaintiff sued her employer, alleging that poor working conditions had caused her to develop a stomach ulcer. At trial, the plaintiff's medical expert testified to the cause of the plaintiff's ulcer and stated that his opinion was based in part on information in a letter the plaintiff's personal doctor had written to the plaintiff's employer, explaining why the plaintiff had missed work. The plaintiff offered the doctor's letter to prove the cause of her condition.

Is the letter admissible?

一名原告起诉其雇主，指控恶劣的工作条件导致其患上胃溃疡。在庭审中，原告的医学专家就原告溃疡的病因作证，并陈述其意见部分基于一封信中的信息，该信由原告的私人医生写给原告的雇主，用以解释原告缺勤的原因。原告提交了这封医生的信函，以证明其病情的成因。

该信函是否可采纳？
options:
A. No, because it is hearsay not within any exception.
不可采纳，因为它是传闻证据，且不属于任何例外情况。

B. No, because the plaintiff's doctor is not shown to be unavailable.
不可采纳，因为未能证明原告的医生无法出庭作证。

C. Yes, because it was relied upon by the plaintiff's medical expert.
可采纳，因为原告的医学专家依赖了该信函。

D. Yes, under the business records exception to the hearsay rule.
可采纳，依据传闻证据规则中的商业记录例外。
data.explanation:
Hearsay is an out-of-court statement (eg, the doctor's letter) offered to prove the truth of the matter asserted therein (eg, the cause of the plaintiff's condition). An expert witness's opinion can be based on a hearsay statement if other experts in the field would reasonably rely on that statement to form an opinion. The expert witness can then testify as to that opinion - as the medical expert did here. But the hearsay statement itself is inadmissible unless :
  • it is excluded or excepted from the rule against hearsay or
  • its probative value in helping the jury evaluate the expert's opinion substantially outweighs its prejudicial effect.


The only hearsay exception raised in this question is for business records. But since the doctor's letter was not made and kept as a regular practice in the course of regularly conducted business activities (eg, providing medical treatment), it is not a business record under this exception (Choice D). Nor is it otherwise excluded or excepted from the hearsay rule. And though the letter may help the jury evaluate the expert's opinion, it is unlikely that the letter's probative value substantially outweighs its prejudicial effect. Therefore, it is inadmissible.

(Choice B) Certain exceptions only allow a hearsay statement to be admitted if the declarant is unavailable. But since none of those exceptions apply to the doctor's letter, his availability is irrelevant.

(Choice C) An expert's mere reliance on a hearsay statement is not independently sufficient to admit that statement.

Educational objective: Expert witness testimony may be based on a hearsay statement if other experts in the field would reasonably rely on it. But the statement itself is inadmissible unless (1) it is excluded or excepted from the hearsay rule or (2) its probative value in helping the jury evaluate the expert's opinion substantially outweighs its prejudicial effect.



选项正确率统计：A选项 38%（正确选项），B选项 6%，C选项 43%，D选项 11%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

传闻证据是指在庭外作出的陈述（例如，医生的信函），用于证明其所主张事项的真实性（例如，原告病情的成因）。专家证人的意见可以基于传闻证据陈述，前提是该领域的其他专家会合理地依赖该陈述来形成意见。专家证人随后可以就该意见作证——正如本案中的医学专家所做的那样。但是，传闻证据陈述本身是不可采纳的，除非：
  • 它被反对传闻证据的规则排除或属于其例外情况或
  • 其在帮助陪审团评估专家意见方面的证据价值，实质上超过其可能带来的偏见性影响。


本问题中提出的唯一传闻证据例外是商业记录例外。但由于医生的信函并非在正常进行的商业活动（例如，提供医疗服务）过程中，作为常规实践而制作和保存的，因此它不属于此例外情况下的商业记录(选项 D)。它也不属于传闻证据规则的其他排除或例外情况。而且，尽管该信函可能有助于陪审团评估专家的意见，但其证据价值实质上超过其偏见性影响的可能性不大。因此，该信函不可采纳。

(选项 B) 某些例外情况仅在陈述人无法出庭作证时才允许采纳传闻证据陈述。但由于这些例外情况均不适用于该医生的信函，因此其能否出庭作证是无关紧要的。

(选项 C) 专家仅仅依赖传闻证据陈述，其本身并不足以构成采纳该陈述的独立理由。

教学目标： 专家证人证词可以基于传闻证据陈述，前提是该领域的其他专家会合理地依赖它。但是，该陈述本身是不可采纳的，除非 (1) 它被传闻证据规则排除或属于其例外情况，或 (2) 其在帮助陪审团评估专家意见方面的证据价值，实质上超过其可能带来的偏见性影响。

References

Fed. R. Evid. 703 (bases of expert's opinion testimony).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Evidence / Hearsay / Expert Testimony
✅ 正确答案：A
(No, because it is hearsay not within any exception.)

本题考查的是证据法中一个非常经典且容易混淆的考点：专家证人所依赖的传闻证据本身的可采性。

核心法律规则解析

要解决这个问题，我们需要区分两个概念：

  1. 专家能否依赖这份文件形成意见？
  2. 这份文件本身能否作为证据提交给陪审团？
⚖️ 联邦证据规则 703 (FRE 703)
专家可以基于该领域专家通常合理依赖的数据（即使该数据本身不可采）来形成意见。

在本案中，医学专家确实可以阅读私人医生的信件并据此形成“溃疡成因”的专业意见（因为医生通常会参考过往病史）。但是，这并不意味着这封信（传闻证据）自动变得可采纳。

关键逻辑链条：

  • 信件性质： 这封信是庭外陈述 (Out-of-court statement)，原告试图用它来证明信中所述内容（病因）的真实性 (Truth of the matter asserted)。因此，它是典型的传闻证据 (Hearsay)。
  • 不可采纳原则： 除非有例外情况，否则传闻证据不可采纳。
  • 专家依赖不等于例外： 仅仅因为专家依赖了它，并不能让它成为“独立证据” (Substantive Evidence)。

根据 FRE 703，如果专家依赖了不可采纳的传闻，该传闻内容通常不能向陪审团披露，除非其证据价值实质性地超过了偏见性影响 (Probative value substantially outweighs prejudicial effect)。本题中没有证据表明满足这一严格的平衡测试。

为什么其他选项是错误的？
❌ 选项 C (陷阱选项)
“可采纳，因为原告的医学专家依赖了该信函。”

这是最常见的干扰项。考生常误以为“专家用了 = 证据可采”。
纠正：专家可以作证说“我的意见基于那封信”，但他不能把那封信直接拿给陪审团看作为证明事实的证据。专家不能作为传闻证据进入法庭的“输送管道” (Conduit)。
❌ 选项 D (商业记录例外)
“可采纳，依据商业记录例外。”

纠正：商业记录 (Business Records Exception, FRE 803(6)) 要求记录是作为常规商业活动的一部分定期制作的。一封专门写给雇主解释缺勤原因的信，通常不是医生日常诊疗业务中“常规制作”的记录（这就好比医生写的请假条 vs. 医生的诊疗病历）。因此不符合此例外。
❌ 选项 B (证人不可用性)
纠正：大多数传闻例外（如商业记录、医疗诊断陈述）都不要求证人“不可用” (Unavailability)。只有少数例外（如临终遗言、反对利益声明）才需要。既然本信件不符合任何例外，医生的可用性就无关紧要。
💡 MBE 考试通关技巧

当你看到“专家证人” + “庭外文件/报告”的组合时，请立即警惕：

  • 专家可以说出基于文件的结论。
  • 但文件本身通常不可采，除非文件独立满足某个传闻例外（如公共记录、商业记录）。
  • 不要因为专家看了它，就给它发“通行证”。

questions.question:
The nephew of a testator is called as a witness in a civil proceeding challenging the validity of the testator's will. The opposing party objects to the nephew's testifying on each of the following grounds: the nephew is named as a beneficiary under the will; the nephew is an atheist; the nephew states that his conscience will not allow him to swear or affirm that he will tell the truth; and the nephew has been convicted of perjury.
On what grounds can the nephew be prevented from testifying?

choices.a: He cannot swear or affirm that he will tell the truth.
choices.b: He has previously been convicted of perjury.
choices.c: He is an atheist.
choices.d: He is named as a beneficiary under the will.

questions.question:
A company shipped a fluid in a tanker car via a railroad. The morning after the car was transported to a holding area owned and maintained by the railroad, a railroad employee noticed that fluid was gushing from the outlet spout on the bottom of the tanker car. The railroad cleaned up the fluid and then sued the company for the cleanup costs, alleging that the company had negligently failed to properly secure the outlet cap. The company, denying liability, contested the lawsuit.
While the company presented no evidence of its employees' actions regarding the tanker car in question, two company employees testified, over the railroad's objection, that they routinely follow a procedure for inspecting tanker cars before the cars leave the company's premises, which includes ensuring that outlet caps are properly secured. As evidence of this procedure, the company submitted a copy of a checklist routinely used by its employees to inspect tanker cars to be shipped by rail, which contained the item, "Outlet cap: secured."
Is the court's admission of the two company employees' testimony proper?

choices.a: No, because as employees of the company, their testimony was biased.
choices.b: No, because the employees did not testify that they checked the outlet cap in question.
choices.c: Yes, because this evidence is admissible hearsay.
choices.d: Yes, because this evidence is based on the company's routine practice for inspecting tanker cars.

questions.question:
The plaintiff sued a company for injuries suffered in the crash of the plaintiff's dune buggy, allegedly caused by a defective auto part manufactured by the company. The company claims that the part was a fraudulent imitation, not produced by the company.
Which of the following is NOT admissible on the issue of whether the part was manufactured by the company?

choices.a: A judgment for another plaintiff against the company in another case involving substantially similar facts.
choices.b: Testimony that the part was purchased from a parts house to which the company regularly sold parts.
choices.c: The fact that the defective part bears the company's insignia or trademark.
choices.d: The part itself and a concededly genuine part manufactured by the company for the jury's comparison.

data.questionStem:
Q87204

The plaintiff sued a company for injuries suffered in the crash of the plaintiff's dune buggy, allegedly caused by a defective auto part manufactured by the company. The company claims that the part was a fraudulent imitation, not produced by the company.

Which of the following is NOT admissible on the issue of whether the part was manufactured by the company?

原告因其沙滩车发生事故而受伤起诉一家公司，据称事故是由该公司制造的有缺陷的汽车零部件引起的。该公司声称，该部件是假冒产品，并非由其生产。

关于该部件是否由该公司制造这一争议点，以下哪项证据是不可采纳的？
options:
A. A judgment for another plaintiff against the company in another case involving substantially similar facts.
在另一起涉及基本相似事实的案件中，另一名原告胜诉该公司的判决。

B. Testimony that the part was purchased from a parts house to which the company regularly sold parts.
证词表明，该部件购自一家零部件商店，而该公司定期向该商店销售零部件。

C. The fact that the defective part bears the company's insignia or trademark.
有缺陷的部件上带有公司徽章或商标这一事实。

D. The part itself and a concededly genuine part manufactured by the company for the jury's comparison.
部件本身，以及一个公认由该公司制造的正品部件，供陪审团进行比较。
data.explanation:
Evidence is relevant if it has any tendency to make a material fact more or less probable than it would be without that evidence. Relevant evidence is admissible unless excluded by a rule, law, or constitutional provision. For example, Federal Rule of Evidence 403 allows a court to exclude relevant evidence when its probative value is substantially outweighed by the danger of:
  • unfair prejudice - evidence tends to encourage the jury to decide the case on improper grounds
  • confusing the issues - evidence leads the jury to focus on a nonmaterial matter
  • misleading the jury - evidence creates misconceptions in the jurors' minds
  • undue delay or wasting time - caused by presentation of voluminous evidence or
  • needless cumulation - similar evidence on the same issue has already been admitted.
Here, another plaintiff's judgment against the company is not probative of whether the company manufactured the part at issue in this case. Even if it was, the other judgment may mislead the jury or unfairly prejudice the company by encouraging the jury to decide the present case on improper grounds (ie, a prior ruling). This danger would substantially outweigh the minimal probative value of this evidence, so it is NOT admissible.

(Choices B & C) Testimony that the defective part was purchased from a parts house to which the company regularly sold parts is highly probative on the issue of whether the part was manufactured by the company - as is the fact that the part bears the company's insignia or trademark. Therefore, this evidence is admissible.

(Choice D) The jury or an expert witness may compare an item that has been authenticated (eg, the genuine part) with a disputed specimen (eg, the defective part) to determine if the disputed specimen is also genuine. Therefore, the defective and genuine parts are admissible for this purpose.

Educational objective: Evidence is relevant if it has any tendency to make a material fact more or less probable than it would be without that evidence. Although relevant evidence is generally admissible, it can be excluded if its probative value is substantially outweighed by dangers like misleading the jury or unfair prejudice.



选项正确率统计：A选项 83%（正确选项），B选项 11%，C选项 1%，D选项 4%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

如果证据具有任何倾向性，能够使某个重要事实比没有该证据时显得更可能或更不可能，那么该证据就具有相关性。相关证据是可采纳的，除非被某项规则、法律或宪法条款排除。例如，Federal Rule of Evidence 403 允许法院在相关证据的证明价值被以下危险实质上超过时，排除该证据：
  • 不公正的偏见 - 证据倾向于鼓励陪审团基于不正当理由对案件作出裁决
  • 混淆争议点 - 证据导致陪审团关注非重要事项
  • 误导陪审团 - 证据在陪审员心中造成误解
  • 不当延误或浪费时间 - 因提交大量证据而引起或
  • 不必要的累积 - 关于同一争议点的类似证据已被采纳。
在本案中，另一名原告胜诉该公司的判决对于该公司是否制造了本案中的争议部件不具有证明价值。即使有证明价值，另一份判决也可能误导陪审团或对公司造成不公正的偏见，因为它会鼓励陪审团基于不正当的理由（即先前的裁决）来对本案作出裁决。这种危险将实质上超过该证据的微小证明价值，因此它是不可采纳的。

（选项 B & C）有缺陷的部件购自公司定期向其销售零部件的商店这一证词，以及该部件带有公司徽章或商标这一事实，对于该公司是否制造了该部件这一争议点都具有很高的证明价值。因此，这些证据是可采纳的。

（选项 D）陪审团或专家证人可以将一个已经过验证的物品（例如，正品部件）与一个有争议的样本（例如，有缺陷的部件）进行比较，以确定有争议的样本是否也是真品。因此，为此目的，有缺陷的部件和正品部件都是可采纳的。

教学目标：如果证据具有任何倾向性，能够使某个重要事实比没有该证据时显得更可能或更不可能，那么该证据就具有相关性。虽然相关证据通常是可采纳的，但如果其证明价值被诸如误导陪审团或不公正偏见等危险实质上超过，则可以被排除。

References

Fed. R. Evid. 401 (test for relevance).

Fed. R. Evid. 403 (excluding relevant evidence for certain dangers)

MBE 考点解析

Evidence Law | Relevancy
正确答案：选项 A

在关于“该部件是否由该公司制造”的争议中，另一名原告在类似案件中的胜诉判决是不可采纳的（Inadmissible）。

核心考点：FRE 403 排除规则

即使证据具有相关性（Relevant），如果其证明价值（Probative Value）被以下危险实质性超过（Substantially Outweighed），法院也可以排除该证据：

  • 不公正的偏见 (Unfair Prejudice)
  • 混淆争议点 (Confusing the Issues)
  • 误导陪审团 (Misleading the Jury)

为什么选项 A 是不可采纳的？

  • 证明价值极低： 另一个案件的判决只能证明该公司在过去曾制造过有缺陷的部件。它不能直接证明本案中特定的那个部件也是该公司制造的。
  • 传闻证据规则 (Hearsay)： 民事判决书通常被视为传闻证据。虽然有例外情况，但在本案中，试图用前案判决来证明本案事实（即公司制造了该部件），通常不被允许。
  • 误导与偏见 (FRE 403)： 这是最关键的理由。引入另一个判决会诱导陪审团认为：“既然他们在那个案子里输了，那他们在这个案子里肯定也有错。”这属于不公正的偏见。此外，这会导致陪审团去关注另一个案件的细节，从而混淆本案的争议点。

为什么其他选项是可采纳的？

选项 B 销售渠道证据：

证明该部件来自公司定期供货的商店，这属于间接证据（Circumstantial Evidence），增加了该部件源自该公司的可能性（Relevance under FRE 401）。

选项 C 商标/徽章：

根据 FRE 902(7)，刻有商标或商业铭文的物品是自我认证（Self-authenticating）的。这是证明制造来源的强有力证据。

选项 D 实物比较：

根据 FRE 901(b)(3)，允许事实认定者（陪审团）将有争议的样本与已验证的正品进行比较。这是鉴别物证真伪的标准程序。

MBE 解题技巧：
当题目问“哪个证据不可采纳”时，警惕民事判决书。除非用于既判力（Res Judicata）或禁反言（Collateral Estoppel），否则前案判决很少能作为证据在后案中证明事实，因为它们极易产生偏见。

questions.question:
A person purporting to be the defendant makes a threatening telephone call to the plaintiff.
In which instance is the telephone call MOST likely to be admitted against the defendant?

choices.a: The caller identified himself using the defendant's name.
choices.b: The plaintiff believes that the defendant is capable of making such threats.
choices.c: The plaintiff had given her unlisted number only to the defendant and a few other persons.
choices.d: The plaintiff had previously given damaging testimony against the defendant in another lawsuit.

data.questionStem:
Q87184

A person purporting to be the defendant makes a threatening telephone call to the plaintiff.

In which instance is the telephone call MOST likely to be admitted against the defendant?

一个自称是被告的人给原告打了一通威胁电话。

在下列哪种情况下，这通电话最有可能被采纳为对被告不利的证据？
options:
A. The caller identified himself using the defendant's name.
呼叫者用被告的名字表明了自己的身份。

B. The plaintiff believes that the defendant is capable of making such threats.
原告相信被告有能力发出此类威胁。

C. The plaintiff had given her unlisted number only to the defendant and a few other persons.
原告曾将其未公开的电话号码只给过被告以及其他少数几个人。

D. The plaintiff had previously given damaging testimony against the defendant in another lawsuit.
原告曾在另一场诉讼中提供了对被告不利的证词。
data.explanation:
Authenticating oral statements (FRE 901(b)(5) - (6))


Voice identificationAuthenticated by any person who has heard speaker's voice firsthand or through a device at any time (including for litigation) and can connect the speaker's voice to the oral statement at issue.
Telephone conversationAuthenticated by a caller who testifies that: the caller recognized the speaker's voice, the speaker knew facts that only a particular person would know, the caller dialed a number believed to be the speaker's and the speaker identified him/herself upon answering, or the caller dialed a business and spoke with a person who answered about business regularly transacted by phone.
FRE = Federal Rule of Evidence

Before evidence of a telephone call may be admitted, it must be authenticated by identifying the speaker when that identity is important (as seen here). This can be accomplished by having a party to the telephone conversation testify that:



  • the party recognized the speaker's voice

  • the speaker knew facts that only certain persons would know

  • the party dialed a number believed to be the speaker's, and the speaker identified him/herself upon answering or

  • the party dialed a business and spoke to the person who answered about business regularly conducted over the phone.


Evidence that the plaintiff had given her unlisted number only to the defendant and a few other persons shows that the caller knew a fact that only certain persons would know. As a result, the telephone call would likely be admitted against the defendant in that instance.


(Choice A) A caller may authenticate the voice of the person who answered if the caller (1) dialed a number believed to be the speaker's and (2) the speaker identified him/herself upon answering. But since the plaintiff received the call, she cannot use this method to authenticate the caller's voice.


(Choice B) The plaintiff's mere belief that the defendant is capable of making such threats is irrelevant as to identifying the caller.


(Choice D) The plaintiff's prior damaging testimony against the defendant may show that the defendant had motive to make the threatening call, but this is very weak evidence of the caller's identity.


Educational objective: A telephone call can be authenticated by having a party to the conversation testify that (1) the party recognized the speaker's voice, (2) the speaker knew facts only certain persons would know, (3) the party dialed a number believed to be the speaker's and the speaker confirmed that identify upon answering, or (4) the party dialed a business and they spoke about business regularly conducted over the phone.




选项正确率统计：A选项 58%，B选项 2%，C选项 29%（正确选项），D选项 10%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

口头陈述的认证 (FRE 901(b)(5) - (6))


声音识别由任何在任何时候（包括为诉讼目的）曾亲耳或通过设备听过说话者声音，并且能够将说话者的声音与系争口头陈述联系起来的人进行认证。
电话交谈由通话一方作证进行认证，证明：通话者辨认出说话者的声音；说话者知道只有特定人员才会知道的事实；通话者拨打了一个认为是说话者的号码，且说话者在接听时表明了自己身份；或者通话者拨打了一个商家电话，并与接电话的人谈论了通常通过电话处理的业务。
FRE = 联邦证据规则 (Federal Rule of Evidence)

在电话通话的证据可被采纳之前，当说话人身份很重要时（如本案所示），必须通过识别说话人的方式对其进行认证。这可以通过让通话一方当事人作证来完成，证明：



  • 当事人辨认出说话者的声音

  • 说话者知道只有特定人员才会知道的事实

  • 当事人拨打了一个认为是说话者的号码，且说话者在接听时表明了自己身份或者

  • 当事人拨打了一个商家电话，并与接电话的人谈论了通常通过电话处理的业务。


原告只将其未公开的号码提供给被告和少数几个人这一证据，表明呼叫者知道一个只有特定人士才会知道的事实。因此，在这种情况下，该电话通话很可能被采纳为对被告不利的证据。


(选项A) 呼叫者在以下情况可以认证接听者的声音：（1）呼叫者拨打了一个认为是接听者的号码，且（2）接听者在接听时表明了自己的身份。但由于原告是接听电话的一方，她不能用这种方法来认证呼叫者的声音。


(选项B) 原告仅仅相信被告有能力发出此类威胁，这一点与识别呼叫者身份无关。


(选项D) 原告先前对被告作出的不利证词可能表明被告有动机打威胁电话，但这是证明呼叫者身份的一个非常薄弱的证据。


教学目的：电话通话可以通过通话一方当事人作证来进行认证，证明（1）当事人辨认出说话者的声音，（2）说话者知道只有特定人士才会知道的事实，（3）当事人拨打了一个认为是说话者的号码且说话者在接听时确认了该身份，或（4）当事人拨打了一个商家电话并与其谈论了通常通过电话处理的业务。




References



Fed. R. Evid. 901(b)(5)-(6) (authentication of telephone call).

MBE 考点解析

Evidence / Authentication

本题考察的核心是电话通话的认证 (Authentication of Telephone Conversations)。在联邦证据规则 (FRE) 下，证据必须经过认证才能被法庭采纳。

核心规则：FRE 901 认证的要求很低，只需提供足以支持一项认定的证据，证明该事项是其主张者所声称的事项即可。对于电话通话，可以通过以下方式认证：
  • 声音识别 (Voice Identification)：听过该声音的人（无论何时听过）辨认出声音。
  • 独特特征 (Distinctive Characteristics)：通话内容包含只有特定人知道的信息。
✅ 正确答案：选项 C

分析逻辑：

本题中，原告接到了一个威胁电话（Incoming Call）。要证明打电话的人是被告，原告需要提供某种连接被告与该电话的证据。

选项 C 指出原告的电话号码是未公开的 (Unlisted Number)，且只告诉过被告和极少数人。这属于 FRE 901(b)(4) 下的“独特特征” (Distinctive Characteristics)。

因为只有极少数人知道这个号码，呼叫者能拨通这个电话本身就是一个强有力的环境证据 (Circumstantial Evidence)，表明呼叫者很可能是被告（或其同伙）。这足以满足认证的低门槛。

❌ 陷阱选项：选项 A

为什么“自报家门”不够？

这是一个经典的 MBE 考点陷阱。请区分两种情况：

  1. 你打给别人 (Outgoing Call)：如果你拨打了一个电话簿上登记为 X 的号码，且接电话的人自称是 X，这通常足以认证 X 的身份 (FRE 901(b)(6))。
  2. 别人打给你 (Incoming Call)：如果有人打给你并自称是 X，仅凭这一自述是不够的。因为任何人都可以拿起电话谎称自己是 X。必须有额外的证据（如声音识别或内容知识）来佐证。

本题是原告接到电话，因此仅凭呼叫者自称是被告（Self-identification）不足以进行认证。

❌ 其他选项分析

选项 B (相信能力)：原告相信被告“有能力”发出威胁，这属于主观推测或性格证据，不能证明这通特定电话是谁打的。

选项 D (先前证词/动机)：这证明了被告有动机 (Motive) 打电话，但动机本身不能作为身份识别的独立证据来完成认证。相比之下，选项 C 的“独家知识”在认证身份上更具证明力。

💡 考试技巧 (Exam Tip) 在处理电话认证问题时，首先判断是拨出 (Outgoing) 还是打入 (Incoming)。

如果是打入电话，寻找“只有特定人知道的细节” (Knowledge of unique facts) 或“声音辨识” (Voice recognition)。单纯的“我是某某某”在打入电话中是不可采纳的。
© MBE Evidence Review | Federal Rules of Evidence 901

questions.question:
A plaintiff sued for injuries arising from a car accident, claiming a back injury. At trial, she wishes to testify that before the accident she had never had any problems with her back.
Is the plaintiff's proposed testimony admissible?

choices.a: No, because the plaintiff has not been qualified as an expert.
choices.b: No, because the plaintiff's pain could have been caused by factors arising after the accident, such as an injury at work.
choices.c: Yes, because it is probative evidence of the plaintiff's injury.
choices.d: Yes, because the testimony of parties is not subject to the lay opinion rule.

data.questionStem:
Q87222

A plaintiff sued for injuries arising from a car accident, claiming a back injury. At trial, she wishes to testify that before the accident she had never had any problems with her back.

Is the plaintiff's proposed testimony admissible?

一名原告因车祸受伤提起诉讼，声称其背部受伤。在庭审中，她希望作证称，在事故发生前，她的背部从未有过任何问题。

原告提议的该证言是否可以采纳？
options:
A. No, because the plaintiff has not been qualified as an expert.
不可以，因为原告不具备专家证人资格。

B. No, because the plaintiff's pain could have been caused by factors arising after the accident, such as an injury at work.
不可以，因为原告的疼痛可能由事故后出现的因素导致，例如工伤。

C. Yes, because it is probative evidence of the plaintiff's injury.
可以，因为这是关于原告伤情具有证明力的证据。

D. Yes, because the testimony of parties is not subject to the lay opinion rule.
可以，因为当事人的证言不受普通证人意见规则的限制。
data.explanation:
Evidence is relevant, and admissible unless otherwise provided by law or other rules, if:
  • it has any tendency to make a fact more or less probable than it would be without that evidence (ie, probative) and
  • the fact is of consequence to the outcome of the case (ie, material).


Here, the plaintiff's proposed testimony is probative because it tends to make the fact that she was injured from the car accident more probable. It is also material because it will impact her ability to recover for those injuries. And since no other rules raised in this question apply, the plaintiff's proposed testimony is admissible.

(Choice A) A witness need not be qualified as an expert to testify to a matter of personal knowledge - ie, knowledge based on firsthand observation or experience (as seen here).

(Choice B) The plaintiff can testify that she never had any problems with her back before the accident even if other factors after the accident may have contributed to her back pain. However, if admitted, the jury may consider these other factors in assessing the weight of the plaintiff's testimony.

(Choice D) Under the lay opinion rule, all nonexpert opinion testimony must be
  • (1) rationally based on the witness's firsthand perception,
  • (2) helpful to understanding the witness's testimony or determining a fact in issue, and
  • (3) not based on scientific, technical, or other specialized knowledge.
This includes a party's testimony.

Educational objective: Evidence is relevant if it has any tendency to make a fact more or less probable than it would be without that evidence (ie, probative) and the fact is of consequence to the outcome of the case (ie, material).



选项正确率统计：A选项 0%，B选项 2%，C选项 91%（正确选项），D选项 6%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

证据在满足以下条件时具有关联性，并且除非法律或其他规则另有规定，否则应予采纳：
  • 该证据具有使某个事实比没有该证据时更可能或更不可能的任何倾向（即，具有证明力）并且
  • 该事实对案件的判决结果至关重要（即，具有重要性）。


在本案中，原告提议的证言具有证明力，因为它倾向于使“她因车祸受伤”这一事实更可能成立。该证言也具有重要性，因为它将影响她就这些伤害获得赔偿的能力。并且，由于本问题中提出的其他规则均不适用，因此原告提议的证言可以被采纳。

(选项A) 证人无需具备专家资格即可就其亲身知晓的事项作证——即，基于第一手观察或经验的认知（如本案所示）。

(选项B) 即使事故后的其他因素可能对她的背痛有所影响，原告仍然可以作证她在事故前背部从未有过任何问题。但是，如果该证言被采纳，陪审团在评估原告证言的权重时，可以考虑这些其他因素。

(选项D) 根据普通证人意见规则，所有非专家的意见证言必须：
  • (1) 合理地基于证人的第一手感知，
  • (2) 有助于理解证人的证言或确定争议中的事实，以及
  • (3) 不基于科学、技术或其他专业知识。
这包括当事人的证言。

教学目标：证据如果具有使某个事实比没有该证据时更可能或更不可能的任何倾向（即，具有证明力），并且该事实对案件的判决结果至关重要（即，具有重要性），则该证据具有关联性。

References

Fed. R. Evid. 401 (test for relevance).
