MBE 考点深度解析

Evidence | Character Evidence & Prior Bad Acts

📚 核心法律规则 (Legal Rules)

1. 禁止倾向性推理 (Propensity Inference)

根据 Fed. R. Evid. 404(b)，控方不得引入被告先前的犯罪、过错或其他不良行为（Prior Bad Acts）来证明被告的品格，并借此推断被告在本次案件中“按照该品格行事”（即有犯罪倾向）。

2. 核心排除理由：FRE 403 利益衡量

为什么禁止倾向性证据？因为其证明价值 (Probative Value) 被不公正偏见的危险性 (Danger of Unfair Prejudice) 实质上超过。陪审团极容易因为被告“是个坏人”或“以前犯过罪”而直接定罪，而不是基于本案的证据。

例外情况：MIMIC 规则

如果先前行为是为了证明非品格目的，则是可采纳的：

  • Motive (动机)
  • Intent (意图)
  • Mistake, absence of (不存在误解/意外)
  • Identity (身份) —— 本题关键考点！
  • Common scheme or plan (共同计划)

⚖️ 本题逻辑推演

1

控方意图：引入被告过去一年抢劫过另外两家店的证据。这属于典型的“先前不良行为 (Prior Bad Acts)”。

2

能否适用 MIMIC 中的 Identity (身份)？
要通过先前犯罪证明“身份”，必须满足 Signature Crime（签名式犯罪） 的标准。即先前的犯罪手法必须极其独特 (highly distinctive)，且与本案高度相似，就像罪犯留下了签名一样。本题仅说明被告“抢劫了另外两家店”，没有提及任何独特的作案手法 (Modus Operandi)。因此，不能用于证明身份。

3

得出结论：既然不能适用 MIMIC 例外，该证据就沦为了纯粹的“倾向性证据 (Propensity Evidence)”。根据 FRE 403，这种证据会引发极大的不公正偏见（陪审团会想：“他以前抢过，这次肯定也是他”），这种偏见实质上超过了其合法的证明价值。因此，证据不可采纳。

🚫 选项排雷分析

选项 A 错误
法律陈述过于绝对。虽然通常品格用声誉或意见证明，但在某些特定情况下（例如品格是案件的实质要素 Essential Element，或者在交叉询问品格证人时），品格是可以通过具体行为 (Specific Acts) 来证明的。
选项 C 错误
在刑事案件中，控方不能主动引入被告的品格证据。必须由被告先“打开大门 (Open the door)”（即被告先引入自己良好品格的证据），控方才能进行反驳 (Rebuttal)。
选项 D 错误
如前文分析，证明 Identity 需要独特的“签名式作案手法 (Signature Crime)”。普通的同类犯罪记录不足以证明身份。
💡 考场解题技巧 (MBE Pro-Tip) 当你在 MBE 考题中看到控方试图引入被告过去的犯罪记录时：
  1. 先找 MIMIC。如果没有特殊的动机、意图或极其独特的作案手法（Signature），直接排除 MIMIC。
  2. 如果只是为了证明“他以前做过，所以这次也是他干的”，这就是 Propensity，绝对禁止！
  3. 排除的根本法理依据通常落在 FRE 403 (Probative value substantially outweighed by unfair prejudice)。

questions.question:
An accident at an intersection left the driver of one of the automobiles dead. His personal representative sued the driver of the other automobile in a wrongful-death action. The defendant driver, who was the only surviving eyewitness to the accident, testified that the deceased driver was going at least 10 mph above the 50-mph speed limit when he struck her automobile. A passerby who came upon the scene of the accident shortly afterward testified that based on his observations of the positions of the automobiles, the damage done to each, and the skid marks left by the deceased driver's car, the deceased driver was traveling at the speed limit when the accident occurred. Neither the defendant nor the passerby qualified as an expert witness.
Did the court properly permit each to testify?

choices.a: Yes, as to each, because a lay witness may testify as to common-sense impressions such as the speed of a vehicle.
choices.b: Yes, as to each, because each based his or her testimony on personal perceptions.
choices.c: Yes, as to the defendant only, because only her testimony did not require specialized knowledge.
choices.d: Yes, as to the passerby only, because only his testimony was not self-serving.

questions.question:
After a fire destroyed her home, a plaintiff sued the insurance company that insured the home for the proceeds of her policy. The company claimed that the policy had lapsed.
At trial, the plaintiff admits that she failed to make a timely premium payment; however, she cites a policy provision that required the company to give her notice that it had not received the premium by a specified date and testifies that she never received such a notice. The company then calls its chief billing clerk, who is prepared to testify that, because of the plaintiff's unusual name, the clerk remembers preparing the plaintiff's notice and placing it in the "out" box on his desk, and that an employee from the company's mailroom daily picks up all mail from office "out" boxes and places it in a U.S. mail deposit box.
How should the court rule on the admissibility of the billing clerk's testimony?

choices.a: It is admissible only if the company produces corroborative evidence, such as a mailing checklist.
choices.b: It is admissible without more, because it is evidence of the routine practice of a business.
choices.c: It is inadmissible, because evidence of the mailroom employee's general practice does not prove the particular mailing.
choices.d: It is inadmissible, because the billing clerk lacks personal knowledge of the actual mailing.

data.questionStem:
Q87822 After a fire destroyed her home, a plaintiff sued the insurance company that insured the home for the proceeds of her policy. The company claimed that the policy had lapsed.

At trial, the plaintiff admits that she failed to make a timely premium payment; however, she cites a policy provision that required the company to give her notice that it had not received the premium by a specified date and testifies that she never received such a notice. The company then calls its chief billing clerk, who is prepared to testify that, because of the plaintiff's unusual name, the clerk remembers preparing the plaintiff's notice and placing it in the "out" box on his desk, and that an employee from the company's mailroom daily picks up all mail from office "out" boxes and places it in a U.S. mail deposit box.

How should the court rule on the admissibility of the billing clerk's testimony? 房屋被火烧毁后，一名原告就其保单的赔偿金起诉了为其房屋投保的保险公司。该公司声称保单已经失效。

在庭审中，原告承认她未能按时支付保费；但是，她引用了一项保单条款，该条款要求公司在她未在指定日期前支付保费时向她发出通知，并作证说她从未收到过此类通知。随后，公司传唤其首席账务员作证，该账务员准备作证说，由于原告的名字很特殊，他记得自己准备了原告的通知，并将其放入办公桌上的“待发”文件盒中，而且公司收发室的一名员工每天都会从办公室的“待发”文件盒中收取所有邮件，并将其投入美国邮政的邮箱。

法院应如何裁定该账务员证词的可采性？
options:
A. It is admissible only if the company produces corroborative evidence, such as a mailing checklist.
只有在公司出示补强证据，如邮寄核对清单的情况下，该证词才可采纳。

B. It is admissible without more, because it is evidence of the routine practice of a business.
该证词无需更多证据即可采纳，因为它是企业常规惯例的证据。

C. It is inadmissible, because evidence of the mailroom employee's general practice does not prove the particular mailing.
该证词不可采纳，因为收发室员工的一般做法的证据并不能证明该特定邮件已寄出。

D. It is inadmissible, because the billing clerk lacks personal knowledge of the actual mailing.
该证词不可采纳，因为该账务员对实际的邮寄行为没有亲身了解。
data.explanation:
Evidence of a person's habit or an organization's routine practice (eg, sending daily mail) is admissible to prove that the person or organization acted in accordance with that habit or practice on a particular occasion (eg, mailed plaintiff's notice of nonpayment) (Choice C). Both habit and routine practice can be proven by evidence of:

specific instances of conduct that tend to show a regular response to a specific, recurring situation or

opinion testimony of a witness with personal knowledge of the habit or routine practice.† This evidence is admissible regardless of whether it is corroborated (eg, by a mailing checklist) or an eyewitness was present on the particular occasion (Choice A).

Here, the billing clerk testified to placing the plaintiff's notice in the "out" box on his desk. And he had personal knowledge of the mailroom's daily process for picking up mail from "out" boxes and placing it in a U.S. mail deposit box. Therefore, a clerk's testimony is admissible without more as evidence of the company's routine business practice.

†The proponent of habit or routine practice evidence has the burden of establishing that the habit or practice is inflexibly regular by demonstrating an adequate and representative sample.

(Choice D) The billing clerk need only have personal knowledge of the company's routine mailing practice—not the actual mailing of the plaintiff's notice—for his testimony to be admissible.

Educational objective: Evidence of a person's habit or an organization's routine business practice is admissible to prove that the person or organization acted in accordance with that habit or practice on a particular occasion-even if the evidence is not corroborated and no eyewitness was present on that occasion.



关于个人习惯或组织常规惯例（例如，每日邮寄）的证据是可采纳的，用以证明该个人或组织在某一特定场合（例如，邮寄原告的未付款通知）的行为符合该习惯或惯例（选项C）。习惯和常规惯例均可通过以下证据证明：

显示对特定、重复出现情况有固定反应的具体行为实例或

对该习惯或常规惯例有亲身了解的证人的意见证词。† 无论该证据是否得到补强（例如，通过邮寄核对清单）或在特定场合是否有目击证人在场，该证据都是可采纳的（选项A）。

此处，账务员作证称将原告的通知放入了他办公桌上的“待发”文件盒中。并且，他对收发室每日从“待发”文件盒中收取邮件并投入美国邮政邮箱的流程有亲身了解。因此，作为公司常规商业惯例的证据，该账务员的证词无需更多证据即可采纳。

†习惯或常规惯例证据的提出方有责任通过展示充分且有代表性的样本来证明该习惯或惯例具有固定规律性。

（选项D）账务员只需对公司的常规邮寄惯例有亲身了解——而无需对原告通知的实际邮寄行为有亲身了解——其证词即可被采纳。

教学目标： 关于个人习惯或组织常规商业惯例的证据是可采纳的，用以证明该个人或组织在某一特定场合的行为符合该习惯或惯例——即使该证据没有得到补强，且在该场合没有目击证人在场。

References
Fed. R. Evid. 406 (habit and routine practice).

MBE 考点解析

Evidence (证据法) - Routine Practice
核心考点：FRE 406

习惯与常规惯例 (Habit and Routine Practice)

根据《联邦证据规则》第406条，关于个人习惯或组织常规惯例的证据是可采纳的 (Admissible)，用以证明该个人或组织在特定场合的行为符合该习惯或惯例。

关键点：无论是否有目击证人，也无论是否有补强证据 (Corroboration)，均可采纳。

案情逻辑链条

本题考察的是如何证明信件已寄出（"Mailbox Rule" 的证据基础）。证据链条分为两部分：

  1. 特定记忆 (Specific Memory)： 账务员记得因为名字特殊，特意准备了通知并放入桌上的“待发”盒 (Out box)。
  2. 常规惯例 (Routine Practice)： 账务员作证说明公司的流程是收发室每天从“待发”盒取件并投递到美国邮政。

结论： 这两点结合，足以构成该信件已寄出的证据。

选项深度解析
正确 选项 B (Admissible without more)

这是正确答案。FRE 406 明确规定，证明组织的常规做法（如邮件处理流程）不需要补强证据。只要证人（账务员）对该流程有亲身了解 (Personal Knowledge)，其证词即可采纳，用以推定公司在本次事件中也遵循了该流程。

错误 选项 A (Need corroboration)

错误。FRE 406 明确废除了普通法中某些管辖区要求的“无目击证人”或“需补强证据”的限制。规则原文："...regardless of whether it is corroborated..."

错误 选项 C (General practice insufficient)

错误。这恰恰是 FRE 406 的核心功能：允许用“一般做法”来证明“特定行为”。如果没有这条规则，大型机构将无法证明任何日常事务的处理。

错误 选项 D (Lack of personal knowledge)

错误。这是一个常见的干扰项。证人不需要亲眼看到这封特定的信被投入邮筒。证人只需要对公司的常规流程有亲身了解即可。账务员作为内部员工，有资格证明公司的邮件流转程序。

💡 MBE 通关秘籍
  • 区分 Character vs. Habit：
    • Character (性格)： 泛泛的描述（如 "He is a careful driver"），通常不可采纳用于证明行为。
    • Habit/Routine (习惯/惯例)： 具体、重复、自动化的反应（如 "He always stops at that specific stop sign" 或本题中的 "Daily mail pickup"）。可采纳。
  • 关键词识别： 看到 "always", "invariably", "automatically", "daily routine" 等词汇时，优先考虑 FRE 406。
  • 商业环境： 法院对商业组织的 "Routine Practice" 认定比个人 "Habit" 更宽松，因为企业运作依赖流程。
© MBE Evidence Study Guide | 仅供学习参考

questions.question:
At a man's trial for public intoxication, the prosecutor offered a videotape of the man being booked into the city jail. The videotape showed the man hardly able to stand unassisted and badly slurring his words when responding to routine booking questions.
Should the court admit the videotape?

choices.a: No, because the privilege against self-incrimination applies to the booking process.
choices.b: No, because the videotape is overly prejudicial.
choices.c: Yes, because the videotape contains statements by a party-opponent.
choices.d: Yes, because the videotape is probative of the man's conduct.

data.questionStem:
Q87215

At a man's trial for public intoxication, the prosecutor offered a videotape of the man being booked into the city jail. The videotape showed the man hardly able to stand unassisted and badly slurring his words when responding to routine booking questions.

Should the court admit the videotape?

在一起男子因公共醉酒罪受审的案件中，检察官提供了一盘该男子被市监狱收押时的录像带。录像带显示，该男子在无人搀扶的情况下几乎无法站立，并且在回答例行收押问题时口齿严重不清。

法院是否应采纳该录像带为证据？
options:
A. No, because the privilege against self-incrimination applies to the booking process.
不应采纳，因为反对自证其罪的特权适用于收押程序。

B. No, because the videotape is overly prejudicial.
不应采纳，因为该录像带具有过度偏见性。

C. Yes, because the videotape contains statements by a party-opponent.
应采纳，因为该录像带包含由对方当事人作出的陈述。

D. Yes, because the videotape is probative of the man's conduct.
应采纳，因为该录像带对该男子的行为具有证明价值。
data.explanation:
Evidence is relevant if it has any tendency to make a material fact more or less probable than it would be without that evidence. Relevant evidence is admissible unless there is some other legal basis for excluding it. For example, under Federal Rule of Evidence 403, relevant evidence may be excluded if its probative value is substantially outweighed by the danger of unfair prejudice. This danger exists when the evidence would tend to encourage the jury to decide the case on improper grounds (eg, emotion).

Here, the man is being tried for public intoxication. The prosecutor has offered a videotape of the man exhibiting obvious signs of intoxication when he was booked into the city jail. That videotape is relevant and probative of the man's conduct since it tends to make it more probable that he was intoxicated when he was arrested. And since the videotape poses little danger of encouraging the jury to decide the case on improper grounds, it is not overly prejudicial (Choice B). Therefore, the court should admit it.

(Choice A) Under the routine-booking exception, the Fifth Amendment privilege against self-incrimination does not apply to routine biographical questions asked by police while booking a suspect into jail. As a result, police may ask such questions without first issuing the suspect Miranda warnings.

(Choice C) An out-of-court statement made by and offered against a party-opponent is admissible as nonhearsay. Here, the videotape offered by the prosecution may contain nonhearsay statements made by and offered against the man. But this is inconsequential since there is no indication that the prosecutor has offered those statements for the truth of the matter asserted therein.

Educational objective: Otherwise relevant evidence may be excluded if its probative value is substantially outweighed by the danger of unfair prejudice. This danger exists when the evidence would tend to encourage the jury to decide the case on improper grounds.



选项正确率统计：A选项 1%，B选项 20%，C选项 8%，D选项 69%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

如果证据具有任何使某一重要事实比没有该证据时更可能或更不可能的倾向，那么该证据就具有关联性。关联证据是可采纳的，除非有其他法律依据将其排除。例如，根据《联邦证据规则》(Federal Rule of Evidence) 第403条，如果关联证据的证明价值被不公正偏见的危险实质上超过，则该证据可能被排除。当证据倾向于鼓励陪审团基于不正当理由（例如，情感）来裁决案件时，就存在这种危险。

在本案中，该男子因公共醉酒罪正在受审。检察官提供了一盘录像带，内容是该男子在被市监狱收押时表现出明显的醉酒迹象。该录像带与该男子的行为相关并具有证明价值，因为它倾向于使他在被捕时处于醉酒状态这一事实更具可能性。并且，由于该录像带几乎没有鼓励陪审团基于不正当理由裁决案件的危险，因此它不具有过度偏见性（选项B）。所以，法院应采纳该证据。

（选项A）根据例行收押例外规则，《第五修正案》中反对自证其罪的特权不适用于警方在将被告收押入狱时所询问的例行身份背景问题。因此，警方可以询问此类问题而无需首先向嫌疑人发出米兰达警告 (Miranda warnings)。

（选项C）由对方当事人作出并用于反驳该当事人的庭外陈述，可作为非传闻证据予以采纳。在本案中，控方提供的录像带可能包含由该男子作出并用于反驳他的非传闻陈述。但这一点无关紧要，因为没有迹象表明检察官提供这些陈述是为了证明其陈述内容本身的真实性。

教学目标：在其他方面具有关联性的证据，如果其证明价值被不公正偏见的危险所实质性超过，则可能被排除。当证据倾向于鼓励陪审团基于不正当理由来裁决案件时，这种危险就存在。

References

  • Fed. R. Evid. 403 (excluding relevant evidence).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Evidence (证据法) | Relevancy (关联性)

正确答案 D 核心逻辑

本题考查的是证据的关联性 (Relevancy) 和证明价值 (Probative Value)。

录像带直接展示了被告无法站立 (hardly able to stand) 和口齿不清 (slurring words)，这是醉酒的典型生理特征。这种行为证据 (Conduct) 直接证明了被告处于醉酒状态，因此具有极高的证明价值，应当被采纳。

⚖️ 关键法律规则 (FRE 401 & 403)

根据《联邦证据规则》(Federal Rules of Evidence)，证据只要能让某一重要事实变得“更可能”或“更不可能”，即具备关联性。

虽然 FRE 403 允许排除具有不公正偏见 (Unfair Prejudice) 的证据，但“对被告不利”并不等于“不公正偏见”。只有当证据会导致陪审团基于情绪而非事实做出决定时，才会被排除。本案中录像带是直接证据，并非不公正偏见。

🚫 陷阱辨析：自证其罪特权

选项 A 是最具迷惑性的干扰项。考生常误以为所有警局内的录像都受《第五修正案》保护。

关键判例： Pennsylvania v. Muniz (1990)

  • 非证言性证据 (Non-testimonial): 说话的方式（如口齿不清）被视为物理特征 (Physical characteristic)，类似于血样或指纹，不属于受保护的“证言”内容。
  • 例行收押例外 (Routine Booking Exception): 警方在收押时询问姓名、住址等例行问题，不需要先进行 Miranda 警告。

因此，录像中展示的身体状态和说话方式不违反反对自证其罪的特权。

🤔 为什么不选 C？

选项 C 提到“对方当事人陈述”(Statement by a party-opponent)。虽然这在技术上可以让被告的话语不被视为传闻 (Hearsay)，但这不是本案证据被采纳的主要原因。

检察官引入录像带不是为了证明被告当时说了什么（内容的真实性），而是为了展示他怎么说的（醉酒的状态）。因此，选项 D 关于“行为证明价值”的描述比 C 更精准。

🎓 MBE 考试技巧

当题目涉及醉酒驾驶 (DUI) 或公共醉酒案件中的视频/音频证据时，请记住：

  1. 口齿不清 (Slurring) = 物理证据 (Physical Evidence)，不是证言。
  2. 关联性优先：如果证据直接展示了犯罪要素（如醉酒状态），它通常是可采纳的，除非有极强的排除理由。
MBE Evidence Review | © 2025 Exam Prep

questions.question:
One morning, a man was standing beside his automobile in his employer's parking lot when a self-closing door on his automobile unexpectedly shut on his hand, causing a serious injury to his finger. The man has filed a product liability action against the automobile manufacturer. The manufacturer contends that the man's own negligence contributed to the accident. The manufacturer presents a coworker of the man as a witness who will testify that although she was not at work on the day in question, the man had unfailingly arrived at work late and clumsily exited his vehicle every morning for the year before the incident.
To admit this testimony as habit evidence, which of the following must the court find?

choices.a: The man has already put his character for gracefulness in question.
choices.b: The man's clumsiness supports the inference that he was negligent while using the self-closing mechanism on the automobile's door.
choices.c: There is a second witness who will corroborate the coworker's testimony.
choices.d: There were no eyewitnesses to the incident.

questions.question:
At the defendant's murder trial, the defendant calls his first witness to testify that the defendant has a reputation in their community as a peaceful and truthful person. The prosecutor objects on the ground that the witness's testimony would constitute improper character evidence.
Should the court admit or exclude the witness's testimony?

choices.a: Admit the testimony as to peacefulness but exclude the testimony as to truthfulness.
choices.b: Admit the testimony as to truthfulness but exclude the testimony as to peacefulness.
choices.c: Admit the testimony as to both character traits.
choices.d: Exclude the testimony as to both character traits.

Q87202

At the defendant's murder trial, the defendant calls his first witness to testify that the defendant has a reputation in their community as a peaceful and truthful person. The prosecutor objects on the ground that the witness's testimony would constitute improper character evidence.

Should the court admit or exclude the witness's testimony?

在被告的谋杀案庭审中，被告传唤其第一位证人作证，证明被告在社区中享有和平、诚实的声誉。检察官提出异议，理由是该证人的证言构成不当的品格证据。

法庭应采纳还是排除该证人的证言？
options:
A. Admit the testimony as to peacefulness but exclude the testimony as to truthfulness.
采纳关于和平品格的证言，但排除关于诚实品格的证言。

B. Admit the testimony as to truthfulness but exclude the testimony as to peacefulness.
采纳关于诚实品格的证言，但排除关于和平品格的证言。

C. Admit the testimony as to both character traits.
两种品格特征的证言均予以采纳。

D. Exclude the testimony as to both character traits.
两种品格特征的证言均予以排除。
data.explanation:
Pertinent trait v. Truthful character


(admissibility of evidence on criminal defendant's character)
Pertinent trait (FRE 404(a))
Defendant may offer evidence of pertinent character trait by:reputation or opinion testimony
Prosecution may rebut with:reputation or opinion testimony or SIC (only on cross-examination)
Truthful character (FRE 608)
If defendant testifies, prosecution may impeach with:reputation or opinion testimony SIC (only on cross-examination) or extrinsic evidence of conviction for felony or crime of dishonesty
Defendant may rebut with:reputation or opinion testimony or SIC (only on cross-examination)
FRE = Federal Rule of Evidence; SIC = Specific instance of conduct

A criminal defendant may offer evidence of his/her good character in the form of reputation or opinion testimony if that character trait is pertinent (ie, relevant) to the charged crime. Here, the defendant's character for peacefulness (but not truthfulness) is pertinent to murder since it is a violent crime. Therefore, the witness's testimony as to the defendant's reputation for peacefulness should be admitted on this basis (Choice D).

Alternatively, a defendant may offer evidence of his/her truthful character if (1) the defendant has testified and (2) the prosecution has impeached that testimony by attacking the defendant's truthfulness. Here, the defendant has not testified since he has only called his first witness. Therefore, testimony as to the defendant's truthful reputation is inadmissible on this basis (Choices B & C).

Educational objective: A criminal defendant may introduce evidence of his/her good character if that trait is pertinent to the charged crime. And evidence of a defendant's truthful character may be introduced if the defendant testified and his/her truthfulness was then attacked.

选项正确率统计：A选项 75%（正确选项），B选项 1%，C选项 17%，D选项 4%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

相关特征与诚实品格之比较


(关于刑事被告品格证据的可采性)
相关特征 (FRE 404(a))
被告可通过以下方式提供相关品格特征的证据：声誉或意见证言
检方可通过以下方式反驳：声誉或意见证言 或 特定行为实例 (仅限交叉询问)
诚实品格 (FRE 608)
如果被告作证，检方可通过以下方式进行弹劾：声誉或意见证言、特定行为实例 (仅限交叉询问) 或 因重罪或不诚实犯罪而被定罪的外部证据
被告可通过以下方式反驳：声誉或意见证言 或 特定行为实例 (仅限交叉询问)
FRE =《联邦证据规则》；SIC = 特定行为实例

刑事被告可以声誉或意见证言的形式，提供其良好品格的证据，前提是该品格特征与被指控的罪行相关。在本案中，被告的和平品格（而非诚实品格）与谋杀罪相关，因为谋杀罪是一项暴力犯罪。因此，证人关于被告和平声誉的证言应基于此理由被采纳 (选项D)。

此外，被告可以提供其诚实品格的证据，前提是（1）被告已经作证，并且（2）检方通过攻击被告的诚实性弹劾了该证言。在本案中，被告尚未作证，因为他才刚刚传唤其第一位证人。因此，关于被告诚实声誉的证言基于此理由是不可采纳的 (选项 B & C)。

教学目标：刑事被告可以引入其良好品格的证据，前提是该特征与被指控的罪行相关。而关于被告诚实品格的证据，则只有在被告作证且其诚实性受到攻击后，方可引入。

References

  • Fed. R. Evid. 404(a) (character evidence).
  • Fed. R. Evid. 608 (witness's character for truthfulness).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Evidence: Character Evidence

⚖️ 核心法律规则 (FRE)

本题考察的是《联邦证据规则》(Federal Rules of Evidence, FRE) 中关于刑事被告品格证据的两个不同维度：

  • FRE 404(a)(2)(A)：相关品格特征 (Pertinent Trait)
  • FRE 608：诚实品格 (Character for Truthfulness)
FRE 404(a)
1. 和平品格 (Peacefulness)

规则：刑事被告可以主动提出与其被指控罪行相关的良好品格证据（这被称为 "Mercy Rule"）。

本案分析：被告被指控犯有谋杀罪 (Murder)，这是一种暴力犯罪。因此，“和平” (Peacefulness) 是一个与案情直接相关的特征 (Pertinent Trait)。证明被告生性和平，有助于让陪审团推断他不太可能实施暴力谋杀。

结论：✅ 应予采纳 (Admit)

FRE 608 / FRE 404(a)
2. 诚实品格 (Truthfulness)

规则：诚实品格通常只有在以下两种情况才相关：

  1. 罪行本身涉及不诚实（如欺诈、伪证），即 Crimen Falsi。
  2. 被告作为证人出庭作证，且其可信度受到攻击 (Impeachment)。

本案分析：

  • 谋杀罪是暴力犯罪，不属于欺诈类犯罪，因此诚实不是该罪行的“相关特征”。
  • 题目明确指出这是“第一位证人”，被告尚未作证，因此其作为证人的可信度尚未成为问题。

结论：❌ 应予排除 (Exclude)

正确答案：A
采纳和平品格，排除诚实品格
🎓 MBE 解题技巧

在处理刑事被告品格证据题目时，请务必区分：

1. 罪行性质：如果是暴力犯罪（谋杀、攻击），和平 (Peacefulness) 是相关的；如果是欺诈犯罪（贪污、伪造），诚实 (Truthfulness) 才是相关的。

2. 被告身份：只有当被告坐上证人席（Testify）时，诚实品格才作为“证人可信度”问题变得相关（除非罪行本身就是关于撒谎的）。

questions.question:
After graduating from college, a man lived at home with his parents. He purchased a life insurance policy and named his parents as its beneficiaries. Three months later, he was found dead at the base of a cliff. The insurance company, contending that the man had died by suicide, refused to honor the policy.
The parents sued the insurance company to compel it to pay them as beneficiaries of the policy. At trial, the man's mother testified that she had watched videos on the man's social media accounts during the weeks before his death. She remembered several life-affirming posts, such as the man saying "I'm having the time of my life" while laughing and smiling, and she testified that in her opinion, her son was not suicidal. The posts were deleted before the lawsuit through no fault of any party.
Did the court err in permitting the mother to recount the social media posts and express her opinion as to her inference from the posts?

choices.a: No, because the best evidence rule does not apply to the social media posts.
choices.b: No, because the mother based her opinion on the social media posts, which she had personally perceived.
choices.c: Yes, because the mother's testimony as to the social media posts is inadmissible hearsay.
choices.d: Yes, because the social media posts themselves are the best evidence of the content and have not been introduced into evidence.

The plaintiff was severely injured in the reservoir when he dove from a boat into what he thought was deep water and hit an unmarked submerged island. The plaintiff alleges that the company was negligent in failing to mark the submerged island. At trial, the plaintiff has called an engineer and qualified him as an expert in managing reservoirs.
Which of the following opinions by the plaintiff's expert is the court most likely to admit?

choices.a: "The accident probably occurred in the manner shown by this computer-animated film I made."
choices.b: "The company could have marked the island in a day and at a cost of $300."
choices.c: "The company was required by federal law to mark the island."
choices.d: "The plaintiff was not contributorily negligent."

Q87830 A plaintiff sued a utility company that owns a reservoir that is open to the public for recreation pursuant to a license from a federal agency. The plaintiff was severely injured in the reservoir when he dove from a boat into what he thought was deep water and hit an unmarked submerged island. The plaintiff alleges that the company was negligent in failing to mark the submerged island. At trial, the plaintiff has called an engineer and qualified him as an expert in managing reservoirs.

Which of the following opinions by the plaintiff's expert is the court most likely to admit? 原告起诉了一家公用事业公司，该公司根据联邦机构的许可，拥有一座向公众开放用于娱乐的水库。原告在该水库中严重受伤，当时他从船上跳入他认为是深水区的地方，结果撞上了一个未标记的水下暗礁。原告声称，该公司因未能标记该水下暗礁而构成过失。在庭审中，原告传唤了一名工程师，并使其获得了水库管理专家的资格。

法院最有可能采纳原告专家的以下哪项意见？
options:
A. "The accident probably occurred in the manner shown by this computer-animated film I made."
“这起事故很可能是以我制作的这部电脑动画影片所示的方式发生的。”

B. "The company could have marked the island in a day and at a cost of $300."
“该公司本可以在一天内以300美元的成本标记该暗礁。”

C. "The company was required by federal law to mark the island."
“根据联邦法律，该公司有义务标记该暗礁。”

D. "The plaintiff was not contributorily negligent."
“原告没有与有过失。”
data.explanation:
An expert witness is one who possesses specialized knowledge, skill, experience, education, or training in a subject that pertains to an issue in litigation. Once qualified as an expert, a witness may testify on a disputed issue if that testimony is:

relevant – the testimony will help the trier of fact (1) understand the evidence OR (2) determine a fact in issue and

reliable – the testimony is (1) based on sufficient facts or data AND (2) the product of reliable principles and methods that the expert has reliably applied to the facts of the case.

But the expert's opinion must relate to his/her field of expertise. And since the engineer's area of expertise is managing reservoirs, the court is most likely to admit his opinion that the company could have marked the island in a day at a cost of $300.

(Choice A) A qualified expert may offer an opinion as to how an accident probably occurred and may use demonstrative evidence (eg, computer animation) to do so. But since there is no indication that the engineer is an expert in the cause or manner of accidents, the court is unlikely to admit this opinion.

(Choice C) An expert may offer a legal opinion in certain circumstances—eg, when testifying in a legal-malpractice case—if that opinion relates to the expert's field of expertise (not seen here).

(Choice D) A qualified expert may testify as to a plaintiff's contributory negligence (or lack thereof), but there is no indication that the engineer is qualified to give such an opinion in this case.

Educational objective A qualified expert witness may offer an opinion on a disputed issue if that opinion relates to the witness's field of expertise.



专家证人是指在与诉讼争议问题相关的某一领域拥有专业知识、技能、经验、教育或培训的人。一旦获得专家资格，证人可以就有争议的问题作证，前提是其证词：

具有相关性 – 证词将有助于事实审理者（1）理解证据 或（2）确定争议事实，并且

具有可靠性 – 证词是（1）基于充分的事实或数据，并且（2）是专家已可靠地应用于本案事实的可靠原则和方法的产物。

但是，专家的意见必须与其专业领域相关。由于该工程师的专业领域是水库管理，法院最有可能采纳他的意见，即该公司本可以在一天内以300美元的成本标记该暗礁。

（选项A）合格的专家可以就事故可能如何发生提供意见，并可以使用实物证据（例如，电脑动画）来这样做。但由于没有迹象表明该工程师是事故原因或方式方面的专家，法院不太可能采纳这一意见。

（选项C）在某些情况下——例如，在法律不当执业案件中作证时——如果法律意见与专家的专业领域相关（本案并非如此），专家可以提供法律意见。

（选项D）合格的专家可以就原告是否存在与有过失作证，但没有迹象表明该工程师有资格在本案中发表此类意见。

教学目的 合格的专家证人可以就有争议的问题提供意见，前提是该意见与证人的专业领域相关。

References

Fed. R. Evid. 702 (expert witness testimony).

MBE 考点解析

Evidence / 证据法
⚖️ 核心考点：专家证言的范围 (FRE 702)

根据《联邦证据规则》第702条，专家证人 (Expert Witness) 必须具备特定的知识、技能、经验、培训或教育背景。最关键的是，专家的意见必须严格限制在其专业领域 (Field of Expertise) 内。

正确答案 B “该公司本可以在一天内以300美元的成本标记该暗礁。”

解析逻辑：
题目明确指出该专家是“水库管理专家” (Expert in managing reservoirs)。

1. 专业相关性： 水库管理工作自然包括维护设施安全、设置警示浮标等日常运营事务。评估标记一个危险区域所需的时间和金钱成本，完全属于“管理”的范畴。
2. 证明目的： 该证言有助于证明过失 (Negligence) 中的“注意义务的违反” (Breach of Duty)。如果预防措施成本极低（$300/1天）而风险很高，这符合汉德公式 (Hand Formula, B < PL) 中证明被告未尽合理注意义务的逻辑。

为什么其他选项是错的？

选项 A (电脑动画/事故重现)

虽然专家可以使用演示性证据 (Demonstrative Evidence)，但这需要专家具备事故重建 (Accident Reconstruction) 或生物力学方面的专业知识。仅仅是“水库管理”专家，并不意味着他有资格分析人体如何撞击水下物体或潜水的物理过程。

选项 C (法律义务)

这是典型的法律结论 (Legal Conclusion)。专家通常不能直接告诉陪审团法律是什么（例如“联邦法律要求...”）。这是法官的职责。此外，工程师不是法律专家，无权解释联邦法规。

选项 D (与有过失)

虽然《联邦证据规则》第704条允许专家就“最终争议点” (Ultimate Issue) 发表意见，但前提是该意见必须在其专业范围内。判断原告是否疏忽 (Contributory Negligence) 涉及对人类行为标准的判断，这超出了“水库设施管理”的专业范畴。

💡 MBE 解题锦囊

在处理专家证人题目时，请玩一个“连连看”游戏：

  1. 在题干中圈出专家的具体头衔（本题是“水库管理”）。
  2. 检查选项中的意见是否直接依赖于该特定领域的知识。

切记： 专家不能越界。工程师不能谈法律，医生不能谈路况设计，除非题干赋予了他们额外的双重资格。

questions.question:
A defendant was charged with stealing fur coats from a van. At trial, a witness testified she saw the defendant take the furs.
The jurisdiction in which the defendant is being tried does not allow in evidence lie-detector results. On cross-examination by the defendant's attorney, the witness was asked, "The light was too dim to identify the defendant, wasn't it?" She responded, "I'm sure enough that it was the defendant that I passed a lie-detector test administered by the police." The defendant's attorney immediately objects and moves to strike.
Should the trial court grant the motion?

choices.a: No, because it is proper rehabilitation of an impeached witness.
choices.b: No, because the defendant's attorney "opened the door" by asking the question.
choices.c: Yes, because the probative value of the unresponsive testimony is substantially outweighed by the danger of unfair prejudice.
choices.d: Yes, because the question was leading.

data.questionStem:
Q87190

A defendant was charged with stealing fur coats from a van. At trial, a witness testified she saw the defendant take the furs.

The jurisdiction in which the defendant is being tried does not allow in evidence lie-detector results. On cross-examination by the defendant's attorney, the witness was asked, "The light was too dim to identify the defendant, wasn't it?" She responded, "I'm sure enough that it was the defendant that I passed a lie-detector test administered by the police." The defendant's attorney immediately objects and moves to strike.

Should the trial court grant the motion?

一名被告被指控从一辆货车中盗窃毛皮大衣。在审判中，一名证人作证称她看到被告拿走了毛皮大衣。

审理该被告的司法管辖区不允许将测谎仪结果作为证据。在被告律师的交叉询问中，证人被问到：“当时光线太暗，无法辨认被告，不是吗？”她回答说：“我非常确定就是被告，我还通过了警方进行的测谎仪测试。”被告律师立即提出反对并提出排除该证言的动议。

审判法院是否应批准该动议？
options:
A. No, because it is proper rehabilitation of an impeached witness.
不应批准，因为这是对已被弹劾的证人进行的恰当的信誉修复。

B. No, because the defendant's attorney "opened the door" by asking the question.
不应批准，因为被告律师的提问为该证言“打开了方便之门”。

C. Yes, because the probative value of the unresponsive testimony is substantially outweighed by the danger of unfair prejudice.
应批准，因为该非回答性证言的证明价值，实质上被其不公正偏见的危险所超越。

D. Yes, because the question was leading.
应批准，因为该问题是诱导性提问。
data.explanation:
A motion to strike is a request for the court to order that (1) inadmissible evidence (eg, testimony) be removed from the trial record and (2) the jury disregard that evidence. Even relevant evidence may be stricken if it is inadmissible under a specific rule, law, or constitutional provision. For example, relevant evidence is inadmissible if its probative value is substantially outweighed by a danger of unfair prejudice to the opposing party. This danger exists when the evidence would encourage the jury to decide the case on an improper basis.

Here, when the witness was asked if the light was too dim to identify the defendant, she responded, "I'm sure enough that it was the defendant that I passed a lie-detector test." Although that nonresponsive testimony is relevant, its probative value is substantially outweighed by the danger of unfair prejudice to the defendant. That is because the testimony referenced inadmissible lie-detector test results - an improper basis on which the jury might base its decision. Therefore, the court should grant the defendant's motion to strike.

(Choice A) A witness's truthful character may only be rehabilitated if it has been impeached (ie, discredited). But here, the defendant's attorney questioned the witness's ability to perceive the defendant in the dim light, not her truthfulness .

(Choice B) A party "opens the door" when it refers to evidence that has previously been ruled inadmissible. The opposing party may then introduce that evidence. But here, the attorney's question did not "open the door" to the witness's statement since he did not ask her about the inadmissible lie-detector test.

(Choice D) A party generally may not ask leading questions - ie, questions that suggest the desired response - during direct examination of a witness. But leading questions are allowed on cross -examination (as seen here).

Educational objective: Relevant evidence should be excluded if its probative value is substantially outweighed by a risk of unfair prejudice to the opposing party. Unfair prejudice arises when evidence would encourage the jury to decide the case on an improper basis.



选项正确率统计：A选项 9%，B选项 15%，C选项 70%（正确选项），D选项 5%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

排除动议是向法院提出的一项请求，要求法院命令（1）将不可采纳的证据（例如，证言）从审判记录中移除，以及（2）陪审团忽略该证据。即使是相关证据，如果根据特定规则、法律或宪法条款是不可采纳的，也可能被排除。例如，如果相关证据的证明价值实质上被对对方当事人造成不公正偏见的危险所超越，则该证据是不可采纳的。当证据可能鼓励陪审团基于不正当的理由来裁决案件时，这种危险就存在。

在本案中，当证人被问及光线是否太暗以至于无法辨认被告时，她回答说：“我非常确定就是被告，我还通过了测谎仪测试。”尽管该非回答性证言是相关的，但其证明价值实质上被对被告造成不公正偏见的危险所超越。这是因为该证言提及了不可采纳的测谎仪测试结果——这是一个陪审团可能赖以作出裁决的不正当基础。因此，法院应批准被告的排除动议。

(选项A) 证人的诚信品格只有在受到弹劾（即信誉受损）后才能被修复。但在本案中，被告律师质疑的是证人在昏暗光线下感知被告的能力，而不是她的诚信度。

(选项B) 当一方提及先前已被裁定为不可采纳的证据时，该方就“打开了方便之门”。于是，对方当事人就可以引入该证据。但在本案中，律师的问题并未为证人的陈述“打开方便之门”，因为他没有问及不可采纳的测谎仪测试。

(选项D) 一方在对证人进行直接询问时，通常不得提出诱导性问题——即暗示期望答案的问题。但在交叉询问中，诱导性提问是允许的（如本案所示）。

教学目标：如果相关证据的证明价值实质上被对对方当事人造成不公正偏见的风险所超越，则应排除该证据。当证据可能鼓励陪审团基于不正当的理由来裁决案件时，就会产生不公正偏见。

References

Fed. R. Evid. 401 (test for relevant evidence).

Fed. R. Evid. 403 (excluding relevant evidence).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Evidence: Rule 403 & Motion to Strike
Federal Rules of Evidence (FRE) 403 Unfair Prejudice Motion to Strike
⚖️ 核心法律依据 (FRE 403)

即使证据是相关的 (Relevant)，如果其证明价值 (Probative Value) 实质上被不公正偏见 (Unfair Prejudice) 的危险所超越，法院可以排除该证据。

Motion to Strike (排除动议)：当证人给出了不可采纳 (Inadmissible) 或答非所问 (Non-responsive) 的回答时，律师应立即提出此动议，要求法官指示陪审团忽略该证言。

🔍 为什么选 C？(正确答案解析)

本题的关键在于权衡证据的价值与风险。

  1. 答非所问 (Non-responsive): 律师问的是“光线是否太暗”，证人却回答“我通过了测谎”。这属于非回答性证言。
  2. 不可采纳的内容: 题目明确指出该司法管辖区禁止测谎仪结果作为证据。
  3. Rule 403 平衡测试:
    • 证明价值: 证人通过测谎确实能某种程度上佐证她是诚实的。
    • 不公正偏见: 陪审团往往倾向于过度迷信“科学”的测谎仪，认为其绝对准确，从而放弃自己判断证人可信度的职责。

结论： 提及测谎仪造成的偏见实质上超越 (Substantially Outweighed) 了其证明价值。因此，法院必须批准 Motion to Strike。

❌ 为什么其他选项错误？
选项 A (Rehabilitation):
错误。只有当证人的“诚实品格” (Character for truthfulness) 被攻击时，才能进行信誉修复。本案中，律师攻击的是证人的感知能力 (Perception)（即光线太暗看不清），而非她在撒谎。此外，不能用不可采纳的证据来修复信誉。
选项 B (Open the Door):
错误。“打开方便之门”通常是指律师主动询问了某个话题，导致对方可以引入原本不可采纳的证据来反驳。这里律师只问了“光线”，是证人自己抢答 (Blurted out) 了测谎仪的事，律师并没有打开这扇门。
选项 D (Leading Question):
错误。在交叉询问 (Cross-examination) 中，诱导性提问 (Leading questions) 是完全允许的，甚至是标准的提问方式。
💡 MBE 实战技巧

1. 警惕“抢答”： 当题目中证人的回答超出了问题的范围（特别是提及保险、和解谈判、测谎等敏感话题时），通常会触发 Motion to Strike。

2. 区分弹劾类型： 仔细分辨律师是在攻击证人的“眼睛”（感知能力）还是“良心”（诚实度）。攻击感知能力并不允许引入支持诚实度的品格证据。

3. 诱导性问题： 记住口诀：Direct Exam (直接询问) 🚫 No Leading; Cross Exam (交叉询问) ✅ Leading OK。

questions.question:
A defendant is on trial for the murder of his father. The defendant's defense is that he shot his father accidentally.
The prosecutor calls a police officer to testify that on two occasions in the year prior to this incident, he had been called to the defendant's home because of complaints of loud arguments between the defendant and his father, and had found it necessary to stop the defendant from beating his father.
Is this evidence admissible?

choices.a: No, because it is improper character evidence.
choices.b: No, because the police officer lacks firsthand knowledge of who started the quarrels.
choices.c: Yes, to show that the defendant is a violent person.
choices.d: Yes, to show that the defendant killed his father intentionally.

The prosecutor calls a police officer to testify that on two occasions in the year prior to this incident, he had been called to the defendant's home because of complaints of loud arguments between the defendant and his father, and had found it necessary to stop the defendant from beating his father.

Is this evidence admissible?

一名被告因涉嫌谋杀其父而受审。被告的辩护理由是他意外射中其父。

检察官传唤一名警官作证，该警官称，在本案发生前的一年内，他曾两次因接到关于被告与其父激烈争吵的投诉而被传唤至被告家中，并发现有必要阻止被告殴打其父。

该证据是否可采纳？
options:
A. No, because it is improper character evidence.
否，因为这是不当的品格证据。

B. No, because the police officer lacks firsthand knowledge of who started the quarrels.
否，因为该警官对争吵由谁挑起缺乏第一手认知。

C. Yes, to show that the defendant is a violent person.
是，旨在证明被告是一个有暴力倾向的人。

D. Yes, to show that the defendant killed his father intentionally.
是，旨在证明被告是故意杀害其父。
data.explanation:
Noncharacter purposes for admitting crime or bad act


(MIMIC) MotiveTo show purpose for committing charged crime
IntentTo establish guilty mind or negate good faith
Absence of MistakeTo negate mistake or accident & prove deliberate act
IdentityTo connect defendant to crime with unique pattern of behavior (ie, criminal signature)
Common plan or schemeTo show preparation or planning
OtherTo show knowledge of crime, opportunity to commit crime, consciousness of guilt, etc.
Evidence of a criminal defendant's prior crimes or bad acts is improper character evidence, and is inadmissible, when it is offered to prove that the defendant:

  • has a particular character trait (eg, a violent disposition) and
  • acted in accordance with that trait on the occasion at issue (eg, committed the charged murder because of that violent disposition).


But evidence of prior crimes or bad acts may be admissible for relevant, noncharacter purposes (ie, MIMIC ). This includes proving the defendant's absence of mistake or accident. Therefore, evidence that the police officer stopped the defendant from beating his father twice in the prior year is admissible to show that the defendant killed his father intentionally - not accidentally (Choices A & C).

(Choice B) The beatings can be used to show lack of accident on the occasion at issue regardless of who started the quarrels, so the fact that the police officer lacks firsthand knowledge of who did so is irrelevant.

Educational objective: Evidence of a criminal defendant's prior crimes or bad acts may be admissible for relevant, noncharacter purposes (ie, MIMIC). This includes proving the defendant's absence of mistake or accident.

选项正确率统计：A选项 36%，B选项 0%，C选项 13%，D选项 49%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

为采纳犯罪或不当行为的非品格目的


(MIMIC) Motive (动机)旨在证明犯下被控罪行的目的
Intent (意图)旨在确立犯罪意图或否定善意
Absence of Mistake (排除过失)旨在否定过失或意外并证明是故意行为
Identity (身份)旨在通过独特的行为模式（即犯罪特征）将被告与犯罪联系起来
Common plan or scheme (共同计划或方案)旨在证明准备或策划
Other (其他)旨在证明对犯罪的知情、犯罪机会、罪恶感意识等
关于刑事被告先前犯罪或不当行为的证据，当其被用以证明被告具有以下情形时，属于不当的品格证据，不予采纳：

  • 具有特定的品格特质（例如，暴力倾向）并且
  • 在涉案事件中依据该特质行事（例如，因该暴力倾向而犯下被控的谋杀罪）。


然而，先前犯罪或不当行为的证据，可以因相关的非品格目的（即 MIMIC）而被采纳。这包括证明被告并非过失或意外。因此，警官在前一年中两次阻止被告殴打其父的证据是可采纳的，旨在证明被告是故意——而非意外地——杀害其父(选项 A & C)。

(选项 B) 无论争吵由谁挑起，殴打行为本身都可以用来证明涉案事件并非意外，因此，警官对挑起争吵者缺乏第一手认知这一事实并不重要。

教学目标： 关于刑事被告先前犯罪或不当行为的证据，可以因相关的非品格目的（即 MIMIC）而被采纳。这包括证明被告并非过失或意外。

References

Fed. R. Evid. 404(b) (admissibility of crimes, wrongs, or other acts).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Evidence: Character Evidence & MIMIC Rule

FRE 404(b) Relevancy
核心考点：品格证据规则 (Character Evidence Rule) 根据 Federal Rules of Evidence (FRE) 404(b)：

❌ 一般禁止： 证据不能用来证明一个人具有某种品格（Character），并据此推断他在特定场合依据该品格行事（Propensity Argument）。

✅ 例外允许： 如果证据是用于非品格目的（Non-character purpose），则是可采纳的。
MIMIC 记忆法则

先前的不当行为 (Prior Bad Acts) 可用于证明：

  • M Motive (动机)
  • I Intent (意图)
  • M Mistake (Absence of) (排除过失/意外)
  • I Identity (身份/作案手法)
  • C Common Plan (共同计划)
本题逻辑链分析

1. 辩护理由 (Defense)： 被告声称枪击是意外 (Accident)。
2. 检方证据 (Evidence)： 过去一年内，警察曾两次阻止被告殴打其父。
3. 法律适用 (Application)： 之前的暴力行为表明被告对受害者怀有敌意。这直接反驳了“意外”的说法，证明了意图 (Intent) 或 排除过失 (Absence of Mistake/Accident)。
4. 结论： 该证据符合 MIMIC 规则中的 "Absence of Mistake"，因此可采纳。

选项解析
选项 D (正确)：
"Yes, to show that the defendant killed his father intentionally."
这是典型的 MIMIC 用途。证据不是为了说“他是个坏人所以他杀了人”（这是禁止的），而是为了说“因为他以前打过父亲，所以这次开枪不太可能是手滑，而是故意的”。
选项 A (错误)：
虽然这是“品格证据”的一种形式（Specific Acts），但因为它有合法的非品格目的（证明意图），所以根据 404(b) 是允许的。
选项 C (错误)：
"To show that the defendant is a violent person."
这是致命错误。这就是所谓的“倾向性推论” (Propensity Inference)。法律禁止用证据证明被告是“暴力的人”从而推断他实施了本次暴力行为。必须指向具体的意图或动机，而非一般的人格特质。
选项 B (错误)：
警官亲眼看到了殴打行为（Personal Knowledge）。至于谁先吵架（Who started it）与证明“被告对父亲有暴力行为从而排除意外”这一逻辑点无关。
💡 考试技巧 (Exam Tip) 当题目中被告辩称 "Accident" (意外) 或 "Self-Defense" (自卫) 时，检方通常可以引入被告针对同一受害者的过往暴力史。

这不被视为攻击被告的人格，而是为了证明被告当时的心态 (State of Mind) 或反驳意外说。

questions.question:
A prominent investment advisor sued a former client for slander. In his complaint, the investment advisor alleged that the client publicly accused him of being a con artist. The client timely filed an answer whereby she admitted to making the statement but also asserted that the statement was true.
At trial, the client offers evidence that the investment advisor had knowingly managed a fraudulent investment fund commonly referred to as a Ponzi scheme.
Is evidence of the investment advisor's management of the fraudulent investment fund admissible?

choices.a: No, because character must be shown by reputation or opinion.
choices.b: No, because its relevance is substantially outweighed by the danger of unfair prejudice.
choices.c: Yes, because specific instances of conduct may be proved when character is directly in issue.
choices.d: Yes, because the investment advisor's action constituted a felony.

data.questionStem:
Q87195

A prominent investment advisor sued a former client for slander. In his complaint, the investment advisor alleged that the client publicly accused him of being a con artist. The client timely filed an answer whereby she admitted to making the statement but also asserted that the statement was true.

At trial, the client offers evidence that the investment advisor had knowingly managed a fraudulent investment fund commonly referred to as a Ponzi scheme.

Is evidence of the investment advisor's management of the fraudulent investment fund admissible?

一位著名的投资顾问因诽谤（slander）起诉了一位前客户。在他的诉状中，该投资顾问声称，客户公开指控他是一个骗子（con artist）。客户及时提交了答辩状，承认她做出了该陈述，但同时也主张该陈述是真实的。

在庭审中，客户提供了证据，证明该投资顾问曾明知（knowingly）地管理一个通常被称为庞氏骗局（Ponzi scheme）的欺诈性投资基金。

关于该投资顾问管理欺诈性投资基金的证据是否可采纳？
options:
A. No, because character must be shown by reputation or opinion.
不可采纳，因为品格必须通过声誉或意见来证明。

B. No, because its relevance is substantially outweighed by the danger of unfair prejudice.
不可采纳，因为其相关性被不公正偏见的风险实质性地超过。

C. Yes, because specific instances of conduct may be proved when character is directly in issue.
可采纳，因为当品格是直接争议点时，可以通过具体的行为事例来证明。

D. Yes, because the investment advisor's action constituted a felony.
可采纳，因为该投资顾问的行为构成了重罪（felony）。
data.explanation:
Examples of character as essential element


DefinitionCharacter at issue
DefamationInjuring plaintiff's reputation with spoken (slander) or written (libel) false statementPlaintiff
Negligent entrustmentInjuring plaintiff by negligently entrusting dangerous article to reckless or incompetent personPerson entrusted
Child custodyModifying child custody, visitation, or other parental rightsParent or guardian
EntrapmentCriminal defense alleging government inducement & defendant's lack of predisposition to commit crimeDefendant
Negligent hiringInjuring plaintiff by negligently hiring person of dangerous or untrustworthy characterHiree
Evidence of a person's character is generally inadmissible to prove that the person acted in conformity with that character on the occasion in question. But such evidence is admissible when the person's character is directly in issue - ie, is an essential element of a charge, claim, or defense. Character may then be proved by reputation or opinion testimony as well as specific instances of conduct (Choice A).

Here, the investment advisor sued a former client for slander after she publicly accused him of being a con artist. The investment advisor's character is directly in issue because truth is an absolute defense to slander, and his actual character will determine whether the client's statement was true. Therefore, evidence that the investment advisor knowingly managed a fraudulent investment fund (a specific instance of conduct) is admissible to prove his actual character as a con artist.

(Choice B) Relevant evidence may be excluded if its probative value is substantially outweighed by a danger of unfair prejudice. This danger exists when the evidence may cause the jury to decide the case on an improper basis (eg, emotion). But here, any danger of unfair prejudice posed by the evidence does not substantially outweigh its probative value because the evidence is essential to the client's truth defense.

(Choice D) When character is directly in issue, any specific acts that show this character are admissible. So the fact that the investment advisor's action constituted a felony is irrelevant.

Educational objective:

Character evidence is admissible when a person's character is an essential element of a charge, claim, or defense (ie, when character is directly in issue). Character can then be proved by evidence of reputation, opinions, or specific instances of conduct.

选项正确率统计：A选项 5%，B选项 4%，C选项 87%（正确选项），D选项 3%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

品格作为核心要素的例子


定义争议中的品格
Defamation（诽谤）通过口头（slander，口头诽谤）或书面（libel，书面诽谤）的虚假陈述损害原告的声誉原告
Negligent entrustment（过失委托）因过失地将危险物品委托给鲁莽或无能力的人而损害原告被委托人
Child custody（子女监护权）变更子女监护权、探视权或其他父母权利父母或监护人
Entrapment（圈套抗辩）主张政府诱导及被告缺乏犯罪倾向的刑事抗辩被告
Negligent hiring（过失雇佣）因过失雇佣具有危险或不可信赖品格的人而损害原告被雇佣者
关于一个人品格的证据，通常不可采纳用于证明该人在特定场合的行为与该品格相符。但当一个人的品格是直接争议点时——即，是控告、诉求或抗辩的核心要素时，此类证据是可采纳的。品格可以通过声誉或意见证言以及具体的行为事例来证明（选项A）。

在本案中，投资顾问因前客户公开指控他为骗子而以诽谤罪起诉她。该投资顾问的品格是一个直接争议点，因为事实真相是诽谤指控的绝对抗辩理由，而他的真实品格将决定客户的陈述是否属实。因此，证明该投资顾问明知并管理了一个欺诈性投资基金的证据（一个具体的行为事例），是可采纳的，用以证明他作为骗子的真实品格。

（选项B） 如果相关证据的证明价值被不公正偏见的风险实质性地超过，则该证据可能被排除。当证据可能导致陪审团基于不当理由（例如，情绪）对案件作出裁决时，这种风险就存在。但在本案中，该证据带来的任何不公正偏见的风险并没有实质性地超过其证明价值，因为该证据对于客户的事实真相抗辩是必不可少的。

（选项D） 当品格是直接争议点时，任何显示该品格的具体行为都是可采纳的。因此，该投资顾问的行为是否构成重罪是无关紧要的。

教学目标：

当一个人的品格是控告、诉求或抗辩的核心要素时（即，当品格是直接争议点时），品格证据是可采纳的。品格可以通过声誉、意见或具体行为事例的证据来证明。

References

Fed. R. Evid. 405 (methods of proving character).

MBE 考点解析

证据法：品格证据 (Character Evidence)
✅ 正确答案：C

证据是可采纳的，因为当品格是案件的核心要素 (Essential Element) 时，可以通过具体的行为事例 (Specific Instances of Conduct) 来证明。

⚖️ 法律规则解析

在联邦证据规则 (FRE) 下，品格证据的可采性取决于其用途：

1. 一般规则 (General Rule)：
在民事案件中，通常禁止使用品格证据来证明某人在特定场合的行为与其品格相符（即“倾向性推论”，Propensity Argument）。

2. 例外情况 (The Exception - FRE 405(b))：
当一个人的品格本身就是案件中的直接争议点 (Directly in Issue)，即它是索赔、指控或抗辩的核心要素 (Essential Element) 时，品格证据是可采纳的。

在这种情况下，可以通过以下三种方式证明品格：

  • 声誉 (Reputation)
  • 意见 (Opinion)
  • 具体的行为事例 (Specific Instances of Conduct) ← 本题考点
🔍 本案分析

案由：诽谤 (Slander)。
指控：客户称投资顾问是“骗子” (Con artist)。
抗辩：客户主张该陈述是真实的 (Truth)。

逻辑链条：
在诽谤案中，“真相”是绝对抗辩理由。为了证明她说的是真话，客户必须证明投资顾问确实是一个骗子。因此，投资顾问的诚实品格成为了案件的核心要素。

结论：
因为品格是核心要素，所以客户可以引入“管理庞氏骗局”这一具体行为来证明投资顾问确实是骗子。

📚 常见“品格作为核心要素”的情形

在 MBE 考试中，以下几类民事案件通常涉及品格作为核心要素：

案件类型 谁的品格是争议点？
诽谤 (Defamation)
抗辩方主张真相 (Truth defense)		 原告 (Plaintiff)
过失委托 (Negligent Entrustment)
明知对方无能力仍委托		 被委托人 (Person Entrusted)
过失雇佣 (Negligent Hiring)
雇佣了危险人物		 被雇佣者 (Employee)
子女监护权 (Child Custody)
判断父母是否适格		 父母 (Parent)

❌ 为什么其他选项错误？

选项 A (错误)：
虽然通常品格由声誉或意见证明，但 FRE 405(b) 明确规定，当品格是核心要素时，具体行为 (Specific Instances) 也是允许的。

选项 B (错误)：
虽然 FRE 403 允许排除不公正偏见 (Unfair Prejudice) 超过证明价值的证据，但在本案中，该证据对于确立“真相抗辩”至关重要，其证明价值极高，不会被排除。

选项 D (错误)：
是否构成重罪 (Felony) 并不是关键。关键在于该行为本身证明了相关的品格特征（欺诈/不诚实）。

Reference: Fed. R. Evid. 404, 405

questions.question:
A woman sued a delivery driver for injuries sustained during a car collision. The woman called her treating physician to testify as to the nature and extent of her injuries. The woman now seeks to introduce several color printouts of photographs taken on a smartphone at the accident scene by a witness. The photographs depict the gruesome nature of the woman's injuries.
What is the strongest basis for an objection to the admission of the photographs?

choices.a: The photographs are not relevant in light of the physician's testimony.
choices.b: The photographs' probative value is substantially outweighed by the danger of unfair prejudice.
choices.c: The photographs violate the best evidence rule.
choices.d: The woman did not take the photographs and therefore cannot authenticate them.

data.questionStem:
Q87217

A woman sued a delivery driver for injuries sustained during a car collision. The woman called her treating physician to testify as to the nature and extent of her injuries. The woman now seeks to introduce several color printouts of photographs taken on a smartphone at the accident scene by a witness. The photographs depict the gruesome nature of the woman's injuries.

What is the strongest basis for an objection to the admission of the photographs?

一名女性因在一场车祸中受伤而起诉一名送货司机。该女性传唤了她的主治医生就其伤情的性质和程度作证。该女性现在试图引入一名证人用智能手机在事故现场拍摄的几张彩色打印照片。这些照片描绘了该女性伤势的恐怖惨状。

反对采纳这些照片的最有力依据是什么？
options:
A. The photographs are not relevant in light of the physician's testimony.
考虑到医生的证词，这些照片不具有相关性。

B. The photographs' probative value is substantially outweighed by the danger of unfair prejudice.
这些照片的证明价值被不公正偏见的风险实质性地超过了。

C. The photographs violate the best evidence rule.
这些照片违反了最佳证据规则。

D. The woman did not take the photographs and therefore cannot authenticate them.
该女性没有拍摄这些照片，因此无法对它们进行认证。
data.explanation:
Evidence is relevant if it has any tendency to make a material fact more or less probable than it would be without that evidence. Relevant evidence is admissible unless otherwise excluded by law or other rules. For example, Federal Rule of Evidence 403 excludes relevant evidence if its probative value is substantially outweighed by any of the following dangers:

Dangers


unfair prejudiceevidence tends to encourage the jury to decide the case on improper grounds
confusing the issuesevidence leads the jury to focus on a nonmaterial matter
misleading the juryevidence creates misconceptions in the jurors' minds
undue delay or wasting timepresenting the evidence will cause unnecessary delay or waste time
needless cumulationsimilar evidence on the same issue has already been admitted
Here, the photographs taken at the accident scene are relevant to this car-accident lawsuit because they help prove the extent of the woman's injuries. But the probative value of the photographs is diminished by the physician's testimony regarding the same issue (Choice A). And their gruesomeness poses a danger of unfair prejudice that may substantially outweigh their probative value. As a result, this is the strongest basis for an objection.

(Choice C) Under the best evidence rule, the production of an original writing, recording, or photograph (or reliable duplicate) is generally required to prove the item's contents. An original photograph includes the negative and any print made from it, so the color printouts of the accident photographs do not violate this rule.

(Choice D) The photographs, like all tangible evidence, must be authenticated before they can be admitted at trial. This can be done by presenting testimony from any witness with personal knowledge of the accident scene - not just the person who took the photographs - to confirm that the photographs fairly and accurately depict that scene.

Educational objective: A court may exclude relevant evidence when its probative value is substantially outweighed by a danger of unfair prejudice, confusing the issues, misleading the jury, undue delay, wasting time, or needless cumulation of evidence.



选项正确率统计：A选项 7%，B选项 74%（正确选项），C选项 3%，D选项 14%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

如果证据具有任何使一个关键事实比没有该证据时更有可能或更没有可能的倾向，那么该证据就具有相关性。相关证据是可采纳的，除非被法律或其他规则排除。例如，《联邦证据规则》(Federal Rule of Evidence) 第403条规定，如果相关证据的证明价值被以下任何风险所实质性地超过，则该证据应被排除：

风险


不公正的偏见证据倾向于鼓励陪审团基于不正当的理由来裁决案件
混淆争议点证据导致陪审团关注非关键性事项
误导陪审团证据在陪审员心中造成误解
不当延误或浪费时间出示证据将导致不必要的延误或浪费时间
不必要的证据累积就同一争议点，类似的证据已经被采纳
在此案中，事故现场拍摄的照片与这场车祸诉讼相关，因为它们有助于证明该女性伤势的程度。但是，由于医生就同一问题作了证，这些照片的证明价值有所降低（选项A）。并且，这些照片的恐怖惨状构成了不公正偏见的风险，这种风险可能实质性地超过其证明价值。因此，这是提出反对的最有力依据。

（选项C）根据最佳证据规则，通常需要出示原始的书面文件、录音或照片（或可靠的副本）来证明其内容。原始照片包括底片和由其冲洗出的任何照片，因此事故照片的彩色打印件并未违反此规则。

（选项D）这些照片与所有有形证据一样，在庭审中被采纳前必须经过认证。认证可以通过传唤对事故现场有亲身了解的任何证人——不仅仅是拍照者本人——作证，以确认照片公正、准确地描绘了该场景。

教学目标：当相关证据的证明价值被不公正的偏见、混淆争议点、误导陪审团、不当延误、浪费时间或不必要的证据累积等风险实质性地超过时，法院可以排除该证据。

References

Fed. R. Evid. 403 (excluding relevant evidence).

MBE 考点解析

Evidence Law (证据法)
核心规则：FRE 403 平衡测试

即便证据具有相关性 (Relevant)，如果其证明价值 (Probative Value) 被不公正偏见 (Unfair Prejudice) 的风险实质性地超过 (Substantially Outweighed)，法院可以排除该证据。

✅ 正确答案分析 (选项 B)

本题考察的是 Federal Rule of Evidence (FRE) 403 的应用。这是反对采纳该照片的最有力依据。

1. 证明价值降低 (Diminished Probative Value)
虽然照片与伤情相关，但医生已经就伤情的性质和程度作证了。这意味着照片作为证据是累积性的 (Cumulative)，其边际证明价值因此降低。
2. 不公正偏见 (Unfair Prejudice)
题目强调照片描绘了“恐怖惨状” (Gruesome nature)。这类证据极易激起陪审团的非理性情绪（如极度同情原告或对被告的愤怒），导致陪审团基于情绪而非事实做出裁决。
3. 权衡结果 (Balancing Test)
当证明价值因已有证词而降低，而不公正偏见的风险极高时，偏见风险很可能“实质性地超过”证明价值，从而满足 FRE 403 的排除标准。
❌ 为什么其他选项不是“最有力”的？
选项 A 相关性 (Relevancy)
错误。相关性的门槛极低（FRE 401）。只要证据有任何倾向证明关键事实即可。照片显然能证明伤情，因此它们是相关的。不能因为有其他证据就说它“不相关”。
选项 C 最佳证据规则 (Best Evidence Rule)
错误。该规则（FRE 1001-1008）要求证明内容时提供原件。但在数字时代，打印出来的照片通常被视为“原件”或完全可接受的“副本” (Duplicate)，除非对其真实性有真正疑问。
选项 D 认证 (Authentication)
错误。认证照片不需要摄影师本人出庭。任何对拍摄场景有亲身了解 (Personal Knowledge) 的证人（如路人、警察、甚至原告本人）都可以作证说：“是的，这张照片准确地描绘了当时的场景。”
💡 MBE 答题技巧
当题目问“最有力依据 (Strongest basis for objection)”时，通常意味着该证据在技术层面上可能符合基础规则（如相关性、认证），但在自由裁量权 (Discretionary) 的规则下（如 FRE 403）容易被排除。

看到“恐怖照片 (Gruesome photos)” + “已有其他证词 (Testimony exists)”，立刻联想 FRE 403。

questions.question:
A woman is on trial for nighttime breaking and entering of a warehouse. The warehouse owner had set up a camera to take infrared pictures of any intruders and testifies that a picture taken at the time of the burglary is a fair and accurate depiction of the warehouse. After an expert establishes the reliability of infrared photography, the prosecutor offers the authenticated infrared picture of the intruder to show the similarities to the woman.
Is the photograph admissible?

choices.a: No, because infrared photography deprives a defendant of the right to confront witnesses.
choices.b: No, because there was no eyewitness to the scene available to authenticate the photograph.
choices.c: Yes, provided an expert witness points out to the jury the similarities between the person in the photograph and the woman.
choices.d: Yes, to allow the jury to compare the person in the photograph and the woman.

data.questionStem:
Q87176

A woman is on trial for nighttime breaking and entering of a warehouse. The warehouse owner had set up a camera to take infrared pictures of any intruders and testifies that a picture taken at the time of the burglary is a fair and accurate depiction of the warehouse. After an expert establishes the reliability of infrared photography, the prosecutor offers the authenticated infrared picture of the intruder to show the similarities to the woman.

Is the photograph admissible?

一名女性因夜间闯入并进入一间仓库而受审。仓库所有者安装了一台摄像机，用于拍摄任何入侵者的红外线照片，并作证称，在入室犯法罪发生时拍摄的一张照片是对仓库的公正且准确的描绘。在一名专家证实了红外线摄影技术的可靠性之后，检察官出示了经过认证的入侵者红外线照片，以展示其与该名女性的相似之处。

该照片可采纳为证据吗？
options:
A. No, because infrared photography deprives a defendant of the right to confront witnesses.
不可以，因为红外线摄影剥夺了被告对质证人的权利。

B. No, because there was no eyewitness to the scene available to authenticate the photograph.
不可以，因为现场没有可用的目击证人来认证该照片。

C. Yes, provided an expert witness points out to the jury the similarities between the person in the photograph and the woman.
可以，前提是有一名专家证人向陪审团指出照片中人物与该名女性之间的相似之处。

D. Yes, to allow the jury to compare the person in the photograph and the woman.
可以，以便让陪审团比较照片中的人物和该名女性。
data.explanation:
Authenticating physical objects (FRE 901)


Personal knowledgeTestimony by witness with personal knowledge of object (or that reproduction depicts original object). Most common method of authentication.
ComparisonComparison of object or writing against authenticated specimen by expert or trier of fact.
Distinctive characteristicsTestimony on object's appearance, contents, substance, internal patterns, or other distinctive characteristics.
Chain of custodySubstantially unbroken account of object's whereabouts from time it was obtained until introduction at trial. Required method for authenticating objects that could easily be tampered with or confused with similar item (eg, blood sample).
X-ray images & electrocardiogramsEvidence showing accurate process was used, machine was working properly, machine operator was qualified & chain of custody. Required method for authenticating physical representations of things that cannot otherwise be seen.
FRE = Federal Rule of Evidence.

All tangible evidence must be authenticated before it can be admitted at trial. This requires a prima facie showing that the object is what the proponent claims it to be. For a photograph , authentication is often done by having a witness with personal knowledge of the thing depicted testify that the photograph fairly and accurately depicts that thing - just as the warehouse owner testified here (Choice B).

But since the photograph was taken at night with an infrared camera, it is a representation of something that could not otherwise be seen (similar to an X-ray image). As a result, it requires evidence that the process for taking that photograph was reliable - just as the expert testified here. Since the photograph was authenticated, it is admissible to allow an expert witness or the trier of fact (here, the jury) to compare the person depicted in that photograph to the woman (Choice C).

(Choice A) The Sixth Amendment confrontation clause secures a defendant's right to confront witnesses offering testimonial evidence against him/her in a criminal case. Evidence is testimonial if it was made primarily for use in a criminal investigation or prosecution, so a photograph taken before a criminal investigation commenced is not testimonial. And even if it was, the defendant can confront the warehouse owner and expert.

Educational objective: A photograph is generally authenticated when a witness with personal knowledge of the thing depicted testifies that the photograph fairly and accurately depicts that thing. But if the photograph depicts something that could not otherwise be seen, the process for taking that photograph (eg, infrared camera) must be proven reliable.

选项正确率统计：A选项 0%，B选项 1%，C选项 10%，D选项 87%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

实物证据的认证 (FRE 901)


亲身认知由对物证有亲身认知的证人作证（或证明复制品描绘了原始物证）。这是最常见的认证方法。
比较由专家或事实审理者将物证或文书与经认证的样本进行比较。
独有特征关于物证外观、内容、实质、内部模式或其他独有特征的证言。
监管链从物证获取到在审判中出示期间，对其下落的实质上不间断的记录。这是认证容易被篡改或与相似物品混淆的物证（例如，血样）所要求的方法。
X光图像和心电图证明所用程序准确、机器工作正常、机器操作员具备资格以及监管链完整的证据。这是认证那些无法通过其他方式看到的物理表征所要求的方法。
FRE = 《联邦证据规则》。

所有有形证据在审判中被采纳之前都必须经过认证。这要求初步证明，该物证确如其提交者所声称的那样。对于照片，认证通常通过让对所描绘之物有亲身认知的证人作证，证明该照片公正且准确地描绘了该物——正如本案中仓库所有者所作证的那样 (选项B)。

但由于该照片是在夜间用红外线摄像机拍摄的，它所呈现的是无法通过其他方式看到的景象（类似于X光图像）。因此，需要有证据证明拍摄该照片的过程是可靠的——正如本案中专家所作证的那样。由于照片已经过认证，因此可以采纳，以允许专家证人或事实审理者（在本案中为陪审团）将照片中描绘的人物与该名女性进行比较 (选项C)。

(选项A) 《第六修正案》的对质条款保障了被告在刑事案件中对质提供不利于其的证言证据的证人的权利。如果证据主要是为了用于刑事调查或起诉而制作的，那么它就是证言性质的，因此，在刑事调查开始之前拍摄的照片不属于证言性质。而且，即使它是证言性质的，被告也可以对质仓库所有者和专家。

教学目标： 通常，当一名对所描绘之物有亲身认知的证人作证，证明照片公正且准确地描绘了该物时，该照片即获认证。但是，如果照片描绘的是无法通过其他方式看到的景象，那么拍摄该照片的过程（例如，使用红外线摄像机）必须被证明是可靠的。

References

Fed. R. Evid. 901 (authenticating or identifying evidence).

MBE 考点解析：照片证据的认证

本题考察的核心是实物证据的认证（Authentication of Physical Evidence），特别是针对无人操作的监控设备所拍摄的照片。

核心考点 (FRE 901)
在联邦证据规则下，照片的认证通常有两种方式：
  1. 图示证言 (Pictorial Testimony)： 证人亲眼见过现场，并作证照片“公正且准确”地描绘了其所见。
  2. 沉默证人理论 (Silent Witness Theory)： 当没有目击证人时（如自动监控、X光、红外摄影），通过证明拍摄过程或系统的可靠性来认证。

✅ 正确答案分析：选项 D

答案： Yes, to allow the jury to compare the person in the photograph and the woman.

法律推理：

  • 认证已完成： 题目中提到，专家已经证实了红外摄影技术的可靠性（Reliability of the process），这满足了“沉默证人”理论的要求；同时仓库所有者也证实了照片是对仓库背景的准确描绘。因此，照片已具备可采性（Admissibility）。
  • 陪审团的职能： 一旦照片被认证并采纳，事实审理者（Trier of Fact，即陪审团）有权查看照片，并将其与坐在法庭上的被告进行比较。这是陪审团作为事实认定者的核心职能，不需要额外的专家来告诉他们“这两人长得像”。

❌ 干扰选项排除

选项 A (Confrontation Clause) 错误：
第六修正案的对质条款主要针对“证言性陈述”（Testimonial Statements）。机器自动生成的照片通常不被视为证言。此外，负责认证照片的证人（仓库所有者和专家）都已出庭，被告有机会对他们进行交叉询问（Cross-examination）。

选项 B (No Eyewitness) 错误：
这是本题最大的陷阱。虽然通常照片由目击者认证，但对于X光、红外线或自动监控，法律允许通过证明机器运作正常和过程可靠来替代目击者。否则，所有夜间监控录像都将无法作为证据，这显然不符合法律逻辑。

选项 C (Expert Required) 错误：
虽然专家可以作证指出相似之处（根据 FRE 702），但这并不是照片被采纳的前提条件（Condition Precedent）。只要照片本身被认证了，陪审团就可以自己看。选项C用了 "Provided"（前提是）这个词，使其成为错误的陈述。

🎓 考试技巧 (Exam Tip)
在 MBE 证据法题目中，区分“可采性” (Admissibility) 和 “证明力” (Weight) 至关重要。

只要满足了基础的认证要求（Authentication），证据通常就是可采的。至于是否需要专家来解释照片内容，或者照片是否模糊，通常属于陪审团判断证据分量（Weight）的问题，而不影响其可采性。
Reference: Federal Rules of Evidence 901(b)(9)

questions.question:
A defendant was charged with attempted murder of a man in a sniping incident in which the defendant allegedly shot at the man from ambush as the man drove his car along an expressway.
The prosecutor offers evidence that seven years earlier the defendant had fired a shotgun into a woman's home and that the defendant had once pointed a handgun at another driver while driving on the street.
Is this evidence admissible?

choices.a: No, because it is improper character evidence.
choices.b: No, because such evidence can be elicited only during cross-examination.
choices.c: Yes, as evidence of the defendant's propensity toward violence.
choices.d: Yes, as relevant evidence of defendant's identity, plan, or motive.

data.questionStem:
Q87229

A defendant was charged with attempted murder of a man in a sniping incident in which the defendant allegedly shot at the man from ambush as the man drove his car along an expressway.

The prosecutor offers evidence that seven years earlier the defendant had fired a shotgun into a woman's home and that the defendant had once pointed a handgun at another driver while driving on the street.

Is this evidence admissible?

一名被告在一起狙击事件中被指控犯有谋杀一名男子未遂罪，据称当该男子驾车沿高速公路行驶时，被告从埋伏处向其开枪。

检察官提供证据，指出七年前该被告曾向一名女性的住宅开了一枪，并且有一次在街上开车时用手枪指向另一名司机。

该证据是否可采纳？
options:
A. No, because it is improper character evidence.
否，因为这是不当的品格证据。

B. No, because such evidence can be elicited only during cross-examination.
否，因为此类证据只能在交叉询问中提出。

C. Yes, as evidence of the defendant's propensity toward violence.
是，可作为被告有暴力倾向的证据。

D. Yes, as relevant evidence of defendant's identity, plan, or motive.
是，可作为证明被告身份、计划或动机的相关证据。
data.explanation:
The prosecution cannot introduce evidence of a criminal defendant's prior crime or bad act to show the defendant's propensity to commit the charged crime and establish his/her guilt. This ensures that the jury convicts the defendant for committing the charged crime - not for having a bad character. But evidence of a prior crime or bad act is admissible for noncharacter purposes (ie, MIMIC).

Here, the prosecutor offered evidence that the defendant had pointed or shot a gun at others in the past. But these prior bad acts are not admissible to show that the defendant had a propensity for violence that likely caused him to shoot at the man on the expressway (Choice C). And there is no indication that this evidence was offered for a noncharacter purpose - eg, to prove the defendant's intent, plan, or motive for attempted murder (Choice D). As a result, the defendant's prior bad acts are improper and inadmissible character evidence.

(Choice B) If a criminal defendant introduces testimony regarding his/her good character, then the prosecution can only impeach that witness during cross-examination - eg, by inquiring about the defendant's prior bad acts. But the prosecution can offer evidence of a defendant's prior bad acts for noncharacter purposes at any time - not just during cross-examination.

Educational objective: A criminal defendant's prior crime or bad act is inadmissible when it is offered to show the defendant's propensity to commit the charged crime. But such evidence is admissible for noncharacter purposes (ie, MIMIC).





选项正确率统计：A选项 53%（正确选项），B选项 5%，C选项 5%，D选项 34%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

检察方不能为了显示被告有犯下被指控罪行的倾向并证实其有罪，而提出该刑事被告先前罪行或不法行为的证据。这确保了陪审团是因被告犯下被指控的罪行而定其罪，而不是因为其品格不好。但先前罪行或不法行为的证据，若为非品格目的（即MIMIC）则是可采纳的。

在本案中，检察官提供了证据，证明被告过去曾用枪指向他人或向他人开枪。但这些先前的不法行为不可被采纳，以证明被告有暴力倾向，并可能因此导致他在高速公路上向该男子开枪（选项C）。并且，没有迹象表明此证据是为非品格目的而提出的——例如，为了证明被告在谋杀未遂案中的意图、计划或动机（选项D）。因此，被告的先前不法行为属于不当且不可采纳的品格证据。

（选项B）如果刑事被告提出了关于其良好品格的证言，那么检察方只能在交叉询问中弹劾该证人——例如，通过询问被告的先前不法行为。但是，检察方可以在任何时候为非品格目的提出被告先前不法行为的证据，而不仅仅是在交叉询问期间。

教学目标：当为了显示刑事被告有犯下被指控罪行的倾向而提出其先前罪行或不法行为的证据时，该证据是不可采纳的。但此类证据若为非品格目的（即MIMIC）则是可采纳的。

References

Fed. R. Evid. 404(b) (crimes, wrongs, or other acts).

MBE 考点解析

Evidence Law: Character Evidence
✅ 正确答案解析 (选项 A)

本题的核心考点是品格证据 (Character Evidence) 在刑事案件中的可采性，具体涉及 Federal Rules of Evidence (FRE) 404(b)。

⚖️ 法律规则 (The General Ban) 在刑事案件中，检方不能引入被告先前的罪行、错误或行为 (Prior Crimes, Wrongs, or Acts) 来证明被告具有某种品格 (Character)，并以此推断被告在本次案件中依照该品格行事 (Propensity Argument)。

本案分析：

  • 检察官试图引入被告7年前向房屋开枪和另一次路怒拔枪的证据。
  • 这些证据的逻辑是：“因为他过去很暴力，所以他这次也很可能实施了狙击谋杀。”
  • 这就是典型的倾向性推论 (Propensity Inference)，即“一次做贼，永远是贼”。这种证据在联邦证据规则下是被严格禁止的，因为它会导致陪审团因被告是“坏人”而定罪，而非基于本案事实。
❌ 为什么排除其他选项？

选项 C 错误
这直接违反了规则。你不能为了证明被告有“暴力倾向 (Propensity toward violence)”而引入先前的坏行为。

选项 D 错误 (MIMIC Rule)
虽然先前行为可以用于非品格目的 (Non-character purposes)，但本案事实不支持这些例外。

MIMIC 例外原则：
  • M - Motive (动机)
  • I - Intent (意图)
  • M - Mistake (Absence of) (无误)
  • I - Identity (身份)
  • C - Common Plan (共同计划)

在本案中：

  • Identity (身份/作案手法): 先前的行为（向房子开枪、路怒）与本次“高速公路狙击埋伏”没有独特的相似性 (No unique "Signature" or Modus Operandi)。仅仅是“使用枪支”不足以构成独特的作案特征。
  • Plan/Motive: 没有证据显示以前的事件与本次受害者有任何关联。

选项 B 错误
检方可以在主案举证阶段 (Case-in-chief) 引入 MIMIC 证据，不需要等到交叉询问 (Cross-examination)。选项 B 的陈述在程序上是不准确的，且本案证据本身因性质问题不可采，而非时间问题。

💡 MBE 备考锦囊

遇到“先前的坏行为 (Prior Bad Acts)”题目时，请按以下步骤思考：
  1. 目的何在？ 是为了证明他是坏人（Propensity）？还是为了证明动机、身份等（MIMIC）？
  2. 如果是为了证明Identity (身份)，要求先前的行为与本次犯罪必须具有极高的相似性和独特性 (Signature quality)。
  3. 如果只是普通的暴力史，通常选 "Inadmissible character evidence"。
© MBE Study Guide | Based on NCBE Standards

questions.question:
A defendant has been charged with murder. At trial, the defendant testified that he and the victim were discussing politics when the victim became enraged and lunged at him with a knife. The defendant further testified that he feared for his life and had no choice but to kill the victim. On rebuttal, the prosecution seeks to call a witness to testify that the victim had a reputation in the community as a peaceful and nonviolent person.
Is the witness's testimony admissible?

choices.a: No, because the defendant has not offered evidence of his own pertinent trait.
choices.b: No, because the defendant has not offered evidence of the victim's bad character.
choices.c: Yes, because the defendant introduced evidence of the victim's violent character.
choices.d: Yes, because the defendant testified that the victim was the first aggressor.

data.questionStem:
Q87165

A defendant has been charged with murder. At trial, the defendant testified that he and the victim were discussing politics when the victim became enraged and lunged at him with a knife. The defendant further testified that he feared for his life and had no choice but to kill the victim. On rebuttal, the prosecution seeks to call a witness to testify that the victim had a reputation in the community as a peaceful and nonviolent person.

Is the witness's testimony admissible?

一名被告被指控犯有谋杀罪。在庭审中，被告作证称，当他和受害人讨论政治时，受害人勃然大怒，并持刀向他冲来。被告进一步作证称，他当时担心自己的生命安全，别无选择只能杀死受害人。在反驳环节，控方试图传唤一名证人，以证明受害人在社区中享有和平、非暴力的声誉。

该证人的证言是否可采纳？
options:
A. No, because the defendant has not offered evidence of his own pertinent trait.
不可采纳，因为被告未提供关于其自身相关特质的证据。

B. No, because the defendant has not offered evidence of the victim's bad character.
不可采纳，因为被告未提供关于受害人不良品格的证据。

C. Yes, because the defendant introduced evidence of the victim's violent character.
可采纳，因为被告引入了关于受害人暴作品格的证据。

D. Yes, because the defendant testified that the victim was the first aggressor.
可采纳，因为被告作证称受害人是首先攻击者。
data.explanation:
Evidence of a person's character is generally inadmissible to prove that the person acted in accordance with that character on a particular occasion. However, the character of a victim in a criminal case is admissible in two circumstances:
  • In any criminal case, a defendant may offer evidence of the victim's pertinent trait,† and the prosecution may then offer (1) evidence to rebut that trait and (2) evidence that the defendant has the same trait.
  • In a homicide case, if the defendant offers evidence that the victim was the first aggressor, the prosecutor may offer evidence of the victim's character for peacefulness to rebut that evidence.
Evidence of a victim's character must be introduced through reputation or opinion testimony - except on cross-examination of a character witness, where relevant specific instances of the victim's conduct may also be introduced.

In this homicide case, the defendant testified that the victim became enraged and attacked the defendant with a knife - evidencing that the victim was the first aggressor. The defendant thereby opened the door for the prosecution to rebut this testimony by introducing evidence of the victim's peaceful and nonviolent character. Therefore, the witness's reputation testimony is admissible.

†Under Federal Rule of Evidence 412, evidence offered to prove (1) that a victim engaged in other sexual behavior or (2) a victim's sexual predisposition is inadmissible in civil or criminal proceedings involving sexual misconduct - with some exceptions.

(Choice A) The fact that the defendant has not offered testimony of his own pertinent trait is irrelevant since doing so would merely open the door for the prosecution to rebut the defendant's character - not the victim's character.

(Choices B & C) The defendant did not offer evidence of the victim's bad or violent character - traits pertinent to the defendant's self-defense claim. That is because his testimony referred only to one instance of violence as opposed to the victim's general propensity for violence. Had the defendant offered such character evidence, the prosecution could have introduced evidence to rebut it.

Educational objective: Evidence of a victim's character is generally inadmissible. But in criminal cases, a defendant may offer evidence of the victim's pertinent trait, which the prosecution may then rebut. And in homicide cases, the prosecutor may offer evidence of the victim's peaceful character to rebut evidence that the victim was the first aggressor.



选项正确率统计：A选项 3%，B选项 17%，C选项 23%，D选项 55%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

关于个人品格的证据通常不可采纳，以用于证明该人在特定场合的行为与其品格相符。然而，在刑事案件中，受害人的品格证据在两种情况下可以采纳：
  • 在任何刑事案件中，被告可以提供关于受害人相关特质的证据†，随后控方可以提供 (1) 反驳该特质的证据，以及 (2) 证明被告具有相同特质的证据。
  • 在谋杀案件中，如果被告提供证据证明受害人是首先攻击者，控方可以提供关于受害人平和品格的证据来反驳该证据。
关于受害人品格的证据必须通过名誉或意见证言来引入——但在对品格证人进行交叉询问时除外，此种情况下，可以引入与受害人行为相关的具体事例。

在本谋杀案中，被告作证称受害人勃然大怒并持刀攻击被告——这证明了受害人是首先攻击者。被告因此为控方打开了引入受害人平和、非暴力品格证据的大门，以反驳其证词。因此，该证人的名誉证言是可采纳的。

†根据《联邦证据规则》(Federal Rule of Evidence) 第412条，在涉及性不当行为的民事或刑事诉讼中，为证明(1)受害人曾有其他性行为或(2)受害人的性倾向而提出的证据是不可采纳的——但有一些例外情况。

(选项A) 被告未提供关于其自身相关特质的证言，这一点无关紧要，因为这样做只会为控方反驳被告的品格——而非受害人的品格——打开大门。

(选项B和C) 被告并未提供关于受害人不良或暴作品格的证据——这些特质与被告的正当防卫主张相关。这是因为他的证词仅涉及一次暴力事件，而非受害人总体的暴力倾向。如果被告提供了此类品格证据，控方本可以引入证据来反驳它。

教学目标： 关于受害人品格的证据通常是不可采纳的。但在刑事案件中，被告可以提供关于受害人相关特质的证据，控方随后可以对此进行反驳。在谋杀案件中，控方可以提供关于受害人平和品格的证据，以反驳证明受害人是首先攻击者的证据。

References

  • Fed. R. Evid. 404(a)(2) (character evidence regarding victim in criminal cases).
  • Fed. R. Evid. 405 (methods of proving character).

MBE 证据法考点解析

Character Evidence in Homicide Cases
正确答案：D
可采纳，因为被告作证称受害人是首先攻击者。
⚖️ 核心考点：FRE 404(a)(2) 根据《联邦证据规则》(Federal Rules of Evidence)，品格证据通常不可用于证明某人在特定场合的行为。但是，在刑事案件中有重要例外：

特别是在杀人案件 (Homicide Case) 中，如果被告提供证据声称受害人是首先攻击者 (First Aggressor)，控方可以直接引入受害人性格平和 (Peacefulness) 的品格证据进行反驳。
1. 为什么选 D？
本案是被告被控谋杀（Homicide Case）。被告作证称受害人先拿刀冲向他，这实质上是在主张正当防卫，并指认受害人是“首先攻击者”。
一旦被告打开了这扇门（声称受害人先动手），根据 FRE 404(a)(2)(C)，控方就被允许传唤证人证明受害人享有“和平、非暴力”的声誉，以此来反驳被告的说法。
2. 为什么 C 是错误的？（高频陷阱）
选项 C 认为被告引入了受害人的“暴作品格证据”。这是一个关键的误解。
被告作证说“受害人这次拿刀冲向我”，这是对具体行为 (Specific Act) 的描述，属于案件事实证言，而不是品格证据 (Character Evidence)。
如果被告找证人说“受害人一贯是个暴力狂”，那才是引入品格证据。

注意：虽然被告没有直接攻击受害人的“品格”，但因为这是杀人案且涉及“首先攻击者”认定，控方依然享有特殊的反驳权。
3. 排除 A 和 B
  • 选项 A： 被告不需要先证明自己是好人。控方反驳受害人品格的权利不取决于被告是否证明了自己的品格。
  • 选项 B： 理由同 C。被告确实没有提供受害人“不良品格”的证据（只是陈述了事实），但这并不阻碍控方在杀人案中针对“首先攻击者”的主张进行反驳。
🎓 MBE 提分技巧：
遇到 Self-Defense（正当防卫）的题目，立即检查是否为 Homicide（杀人案）。

如果是杀人案，只要被告说“是他先动手的”，控方就可以直接用“受害人是和平的”来反驳。这是证据法中针对杀人案的特殊规则，不需要被告先攻击受害人的“人品”。
MBE Evidence Review | Q87165

questions.question:
A defendant is on trial for arson. In its case-in-chief, the prosecution offers evidence that the defendant had secretly obtained duplicate insurance from two companies on the property that burned and that the defendant had threatened to kill his ex-wife if she testified for the prosecution.
What evidence should the court admit?

choices.a: Neither the defendant's obtaining duplicate insurance nor threatening to kill his ex-wife.
choices.b: The defendant's obtaining duplicate insurance only.
choices.c: The defendant's threatening to kill his ex-wife only.
choices.d: Both the defendant's obtaining duplicate insurance and threatening to kill his ex-wife.

data.questionStem:
Q87175

A defendant is on trial for arson. In its case-in-chief, the prosecution offers evidence that the defendant had secretly obtained duplicate insurance from two companies on the property that burned and that the defendant had threatened to kill his ex-wife if she testified for the prosecution.

What evidence should the court admit?

一名被告因纵火罪正在受审。在控方主案举证阶段，控方提出证据，证明该被告曾就失火的财产秘密地从两家保险公司获得双重保险，并且该被告曾威胁其前妻，如果她为控方作证，就要杀死她。

法院应采纳何种证据？
options:
A. Neither the defendant's obtaining duplicate insurance nor threatening to kill his ex-wife.
被告获得双重保险和威胁杀死其前妻的证据，两者皆不采纳。

B. The defendant's obtaining duplicate insurance only.
仅采纳被告获得双重保险的证据。

C. The defendant's threatening to kill his ex-wife only.
仅采纳被告威胁杀死其前妻的证据。

D. Both the defendant's obtaining duplicate insurance and threatening to kill his ex-wife.
被告获得双重保险和威胁杀死其前妻的证据，两者皆采纳。
data.explanation:
Noncharacter purposes for admitting crime or bad act


(MIMIC) MotiveTo show purpose for committing charged crime
IntentTo establish guilty mind or negate good faith
Absence ofMistakeTo negate mistake or accident & prove deliberate act
IdentityTo connect defendant to crime with unique pattern of behavior (ie, criminal signature)
Common plan or schemeTo show preparation or planning
OtherTo show knowledge of crime, opportunity to commit crime, consciousness of guilt, etc.
The prosecution cannot introduce evidence of a criminal defendant's prior crimes or bad acts to prove that the defendant has a criminal disposition (ie, bad character) and likely committed the charged crime as a result. But evidence of prior crimes or bad acts may be admissible for relevant, noncharacter purposes (ie, MIMIC ). This includes proving the defendant's motive for committing the charged crime or consciousness of guilt.

Here, evidence that the defendant obtained duplicate insurance policies on the property before it burned down can be used to show his motive for committing arson - to collect insurance proceeds. And evidence that he threatened to kill his ex-wife to dissuade her from testifying against him can be used to show that he was aware of his guilt. Therefore, evidence of both should be admitted (Choices A, B & C).

Educational objective: The prosecution may offer evidence of a criminal defendant's prior crimes or bad acts for a relevant, noncharacter purpose - eg, to prove the defendant's motive or consciousness of guilt.

选项正确率统计：A选项 3%，B选项 28%，C选项 8%，D选项 59%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

为采纳犯罪或不当行为证据的非品格目的


(MIMIC) Motive (动机)用以显示实施被控罪行的目的
Intent (意图)用以确立犯罪意图或否定善意
Absence ofMistake (不存在过失)用以否定过失或意外，并证明是故意行为
Identity (身份)用以通过独特的行为模式（即犯罪特征）将被告与犯罪联系起来
Common plan or scheme (共同计划或方案)用以显示准备或策划过程
Other (其他)用以显示知晓犯罪、犯罪机会、犯罪意识等
控方不得引入刑事被告先前的犯罪或不当行为证据，以证明被告具有犯罪倾向（即不良品格），并因此可能实施了被指控的罪行。但是，先前犯罪或不当行为的证据，若为相关的、非品格目的（即MIMIC），则可以被采纳。这包括证明被告实施被控罪行的动机或其犯罪意识。

在本案中，被告在财产被烧毁前获得双重保险单的证据，可用于显示其纵火的动机——即骗取保险赔偿金。而他威胁杀死前妻以阻止她作证指控他的证据，可用于显示他知晓自己有罪（即犯罪意识）。因此，两项证据均应被采纳（选项A、B和C均不正确）。

教学目的：控方可以为相关的、非品格目的而提出刑事被告先前犯罪或不当行为的证据——例如，用以证明被告的动机或犯罪意识。

References

Fed. R. Evid. 404(b) (crimes, wrongs, other acts).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Evidence: Relevancy & Bad Acts

⚖️ 核心法律规则

本题考查的是联邦证据规则 404(b) (Fed. R. Evid. 404(b))。

一般原则 (General Rule)：
不能引入被告先前的犯罪、错误或其他行为（Crimes, Wrongs, or Other Acts）来证明其品格 (Character)，从而推断其在本次事件中也是按照该品格行事（即“一次做贼，永远是贼”的推论是被禁止的）。
例外情况 (Exception)：
如果这些证据是用于非品格目的 (Non-character Purpose)，则是可以采纳的。

🧠 记忆口诀：MIMIC

在 MBE 考试中，判断“非品格目的”最常用的记忆法是 MIMIC，此外还包括“犯罪意识”。

缩写 含义 (Meaning) 本题相关性
M Motive (动机) ✅ 骗保是纵火的动机
I Intent (意图)
M Mistake (Absence of) (无过失)
I Identity (身份/特征)
C Common Plan (共同计划)

注：除了 MIMIC，Consciousness of Guilt (犯罪意识/畏罪心理) 也是极为重要的非品格目的。

🔍 本题具体分析

我们需要分析控方提供的两项证据是否符合上述例外：

1
证据一：秘密获得双重保险
Secretly obtained duplicate insurance

分析：这虽然可能被视为“不当行为”，但它直接解释了被告为什么要纵火。这是为了证明动机 (Motive)——即为了骗取双份保险金。
结论：可采纳 (Admissible)。
2
证据二：威胁杀死前妻若其作证
Threatened to kill ex-wife if she testified

分析：威胁证人是一个典型的“坏行为”。但控方引入它不是为了证明被告是个暴力狂，而是为了证明被告知晓自己有罪 (Consciousness of Guilt)。无辜的人通常不会威胁证人。
结论：可采纳 (Admissible)。

✅ 正确答案：D

由于两项证据均具有相关的非品格目的 (Relevant Non-character Purpose)，因此法院应采纳这两项证据。

  • 双重保险 ➡️ 证明 Motive (动机)
  • 威胁证人 ➡️ 证明 Consciousness of Guilt (畏罪心理)

🎓 考试技巧 (Exam Tip)

在处理 MBE 证据法题目时，看到“先前的坏行为”或“犯罪记录”，请按以下步骤思考：

  1. 这是为了证明被告是坏人吗？ (Propensity)
    👉 如果是，通常不可采纳。
  2. 这是为了解释为什么、怎么做、或者是谁做的吗？ (MIMIC + Guilt)
    👉 如果是，通常可采纳。

陷阱提示：不要因为行为看起来很恶劣（如威胁杀人）就直接认为它会被排除（Prejudicial）。只要它对证明案情（如畏罪）有很高的证明价值（Probative Value），通常会通过 Rule 403 的平衡测试。
